children.text: Chapter 1
śrīkṣetragokarṇapurāṇam
children.translated_text: The Purāṇa of the holy field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: gokarṇakṣetranilayaṃ dvibhujaṃ varadaṃ satām
children.translated_text: Dwelling in the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, two-armed, bestowing boons on the good,

children.text: sarvābhīṣṭaprasiddhyarthaṃ taṃ namāmi gajānanam
children.translated_text: I bow to that <s>Gajānana</s>, so that every desired aim may be accomplished.

children.text: kurūṇām anvaye jāto rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
children.translated_text: There was a most righteous king, born in the lineage of the <s>Kurus</s>,

children.text: śaunakādyair munivaraiḥ kṛtasatpraśnasatkathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who held noble questioning and holy discourse with eminent sages such as <s>Śaunaka</s>.

children.text: ṛṣibhiḥ sahitaś cāpi śatānīko mahāmatiḥ
children.translated_text: The wise <s>Śatānīka</s>, accompanied also by the seers,

children.text: āste kṛtābhiṣeko 'tha saṃnyāsāya kṛtakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sat there after his consecration, having fixed the proper time for renunciation.

children.text: athājagāma dharmātmā vyāsaśiṣyo mahāmatiḥ
children.translated_text: Then a righteous and very wise disciple of <s>Vyāsa</s> arrived,

children.text: tīrthayātrāṃ paricaran sūtaḥ paurāṇiko 'rthavit ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s>, the Purāṇic narrator, versed in meaning, as he was making a pilgrimage to <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred fords).

children.text: ugraśravāḥ śatānīkaṃ jayāśīrbhir avardhayat
children.translated_text: <s>Ugraśravas</s> strengthened <s>Śatānīka</s> with blessings of victory,

children.text: abhivādya munīn sarvān śaunakādīṃs tapodhanān ||
children.translated_text: after greeting all the ascetically rich sages headed by <s>Śaunaka</s>.

children.text: papraccha kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ tapaḥsvādhyāyakarmasu
children.translated_text: He asked about all their welfare in austerity, recitation, and ritual works.

children.text: tataḥ sa rājā dharmātmā yudhiṣṭhirakulodbhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then that righteous king, born from the family of <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>,

children.text: sūtam āha mahāprājñam āsyatām iti sādaram
children.translated_text: respectfully said to the very wise <s>Sūta</s>, "Please be seated."

children.text: āsanaṃ kalpayāmāsa śaunakasya tadā nṛpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The king then had a seat arranged for him in <s>Śaunaka</s>'s assembly.

children.text: anujñāṃ prāpya sūtas tu munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām
children.translated_text: Having obtained permission from the sages whose minds were purified, <s>Sūta</s>

children.text: upaviṣṭaḥ sabhāmadhye kṛtātithyo mahāmatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: sat in the middle of the assembly, the wise man having been honored as a guest.

children.text: viśrānto 'bhūc ciraṃ tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ sūtanandanaḥ
children.translated_text: The son of <s>Sūta</s> rested for a long while in that assembly.

children.text: tato 'bravīd idaṃ vākyaṃ śaunakaḥ sūtam ādarāt ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śaunaka</s> respectfully spoke these words to <s>Sūta</s>.

children.text: śaunaka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaunaka</s> said:

children.text: kuta āgamyate vidvann idānīṃ sūtanandana
children.translated_text: From where are you coming now, learned son of <s>Sūta</s>?

children.text: kva gato 'si bhavān pūrvaṃ kim uddiśya prayojanam ||
children.translated_text: Where had you gone before, sir, and with what purpose in view?

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: tīrthayātrāṃ gato brahman triḥ parītya dharām imām
children.translated_text: I went on a pilgrimage to <s>tīrthas</s>, O brahman, after circling this earth three times.

children.text: bhavantaṃ draṣṭumāyātaḥ śatānīkaṃ ca pārthivam ||
children.translated_text: I have come to see you and King <s>Śatānīka</s>,

children.text: pārikṣitaṃ ca rājarṣiṃ saṃnyāsāya kṛtakṣaṇam
children.translated_text: and the <s>Pārikṣita</s> royal sage, who has fixed the time for renunciation.

children.text: saha sthitvā dvijavarair gokarṇe suciraṃ dvija ||
children.translated_text: After staying for a very long time at <s>Gokarṇa</s> with excellent twice-born men, O twice-born one,

children.text: ihāgato 'smi viprarṣe kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām
children.translated_text: I have come here, O seer among brahmans. What shall I do? Command me.

children.text: śaunaka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaunaka</s> said:

children.text: tīrthānāṃ darśane puṇyaṃ snāne dāne ca yat phalam ||
children.translated_text: Tell us the merit in seeing <s>tīrthas</s>, and whatever fruit comes from bathing and giving gifts,

children.text: upavāse jape home tīrthe devārcane ca yat
children.translated_text: whatever there is from fasting, recitation, fire-offering, and worship of deities at a <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: tīrthānām api cotpattiṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: and also the origin of the <s>tīrthas</s>, their sanctity, and the fruit of their sanctity.

children.text: tat sarvaṃ kathayāsmākaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
children.translated_text: Tell us all that, for we have the highest curiosity.

children.text: ity ukte muninā tatra śatānīko 'pi pārthivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the sage had spoken thus there, King <s>Śatānīka</s> too

children.text: papracchedaṃ sabhāmadhye sūtaṃ vai romaharṣaṇim
children.translated_text: asked this of <s>Sūta</s>, the son of <s>Romaharṣaṇa</s>, in the middle of the assembly.

children.text: śatānīka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śatānīka</s> said:

children.text: gokarṇād āgatam iti śrutaṃ te vadatāṃ vara ||
children.translated_text: O best of speakers, I have heard you say that you have come from <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: kasmin deśe sa gokarṇaṃ tīrtharājaḥ praśasyate
children.translated_text: In what land is that <s>Gokarṇa</s>, praised as the king of <s>tīrthas</s>?

children.text: kim artham uṣitaṃ tatra kair vā viprarṣibhiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: For what reason did you stay there, and with which brahman-seers?

children.text: brūhy aśeṣeṇa naḥ sūta yasmād adyāgato hy asi
children.translated_text: Tell us completely, O <s>Sūta</s>, since you have come from there today.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: śrūyatāṃ kuruśārdūla sahaibhir munipuṅgavaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Listen, tiger of the <s>Kurus</s>, together with these foremost sages.

children.text: vyāsaprasādād vakṣyāmi sarvaṃ pratyakṣadarśivat
children.translated_text: By the favor of <s>Vyāsa</s>, I shall tell everything as if I had seen it directly.

children.text: purā provāca kailāse ṣaṇmukhāya maheśvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Long ago, on <s>Kailāsa</s>, <s>Maheśvara</s> spoke to <s>Ṣaṇmukha</s>,

children.text: gokarṇakṣetramāhātmyaṃ nārado 'gnisutāya ca
children.translated_text: telling the greatness of the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>; and <s>Nārada</s> told it to <s>Agnisuta</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ tad varṇayiṣyāmi śṛṇu rājan mahāmate ||
children.translated_text: I shall describe that; listen, O great-minded king.

children.text: siddhikṣetrāṇi trīṇy āhūrahasyāni sureṣv api
children.translated_text: They say there are three <s>siddhi</s>-fields, secret even among the gods:

children.text: śālagrāmaṃ puṣkaraṃ ca gokarṇaṃ ca narādhipa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śālagrāma</s>, <s>Puṣkara</s>, and <s>Gokarṇa</s>, O lord of men.

children.text: śālagrāmāt puṣkarāc ca gokarṇaṃ śīghrasiddhidam
children.translated_text: More than <s>Śālagrāma</s> and <s>Puṣkara</s>, <s>Gokarṇa</s> grants quick attainment.

children.text: yad yad icchati gokarṇe tat tad āpnoti niścayāt ||
children.translated_text: Whatever one desires at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, that very thing one certainly obtains.

children.text: ekārṇave jagaty asmin sṛṣṭikāla upasthite
children.translated_text: When this world was a single ocean and the time of creation had arrived,

children.text: brahmā caturmukhaḥ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ tapa āsthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: four-faced <s>Brahmā</s> first undertook austerity for the sake of creation.

children.text: tadā tasya bhruvor madhyād rudraḥ prādurabhūt prabhuḥ
children.translated_text: Then the lord <s>Rudra</s> appeared from between his eyebrows.

children.text: brahmā provāca taṃ dṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru mahāmate ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him, <s>Brahmā</s> said, "Create, great-minded one."

children.text: tathety uktvā tadā rudro jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ
children.translated_text: Saying, "So be it," <s>Rudra</s> then resolved to create beings free from old age and death,

children.text: sattvaikaguṇasampannāḥ samaprakṛtayaḥ prajāḥ ||
children.translated_text: creatures endowed solely with the quality of <s>sattva</s> and having the same nature.

children.text: srakṣyāmīty eva niścitya pātāle tapasi sthitaḥ
children.translated_text: Having determined, "I shall create them," he remained in austerity in <s>Pātāla</s>.

children.text: evaṃ tapasyatas tasya vyatīyāya yugatrayam ||
children.translated_text: While he was practicing austerity in this way, three <s>yugas</s> passed.

children.text: tato vilambitaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudrasargaṃ prajāpatiḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Prajāpati</s>, seeing <s>Rudra</s>'s creation delayed,

children.text: tatra kāraṇam anvicchan yathāpūrvaṃ sasarja ha ||
children.translated_text: sought the reason there and created just as before.

children.text: śrutvedaṃ prakṛter vākyāt tayā rudraḥ sahotthitaḥ
children.translated_text: Having heard this speech from <s>Prakṛti</s>, <s>Rudra</s> rose up together with her.

children.text: dadṛśe medinīṃ viṣvagāvṛtāṃ cakravatsthitām ||
children.translated_text: He saw the earth all around, covering him and standing like a disk.

children.text: kruddhaḥ provāca tāṃ mārgam udgantuṃ mama darśaya
children.translated_text: Angered, he said to her, "Show me the path by which I may come up."

children.text: bhūr uvāca
children.translated_text: The Earth said:

children.text: viśvātman praṇatāṃ trāhi strībhāvād api vihvalām ||
children.translated_text: O soul of the universe, protect me as I bow to you; I am distressed even because of my female nature.

children.text: nirāgasaṃ bhedayituṃ nocitaṃ te kṛpānidhe
children.translated_text: O treasure of compassion, it is not proper for you to split open one who is blameless.

children.text: karṇacchidreṇa me deva hrasvo bhūtvordhvam utpata ||
children.translated_text: O god, become small and fly upward through the opening of my ear.

children.text: tatheti tāṃ samāśvāsyāṅguṣṭhamātravapurdharaḥ ūrdhvam etyāha giriśo bhadre matsaṅgamā tvayi
children.translated_text: Saying, "So be it," <s>Giriśa</s> reassured her, assumed a body the size of a thumb, went upward, and said, "Good lady, through my contact with you,

children.text: bhavitā tanayaś caṇḍavīryo 'ṅgārakanāmakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there will be a son, fierce in power, named <s>Aṅgāraka</s>."

children.text: gośabdenākhyāyase tvaṃ karṇasthānam idaṃ hy ataḥ
children.translated_text: "You are named by the word go, and this is the place of the ear; therefore,

children.text: gokarṇam iti nāmnā tat trailokye parigīyate ||
children.translated_text: it is celebrated throughout the three worlds by the name <s>Gokarṇa</s>."

children.text: pātālād ūrdhvagamane yonikalpam abhūd yataḥ
children.translated_text: "Because, in the upward movement from <s>Pātāla</s>, it became like a womb,

children.text: rudrayonir iti khyātaṃ puṇyakṣetreṣu gaṇyate ||
children.translated_text: it is known as <s>Rudrayoni</s> and is counted among holy fields."

children.text: kalpānte 'py āvartarūpaṃ varuṇālayamadhyabhāk
children.translated_text: "Even at the end of a <s>kalpa</s>, it remains in the middle of <s>Varuṇa</s>'s abode in the form of a whirlpool,

children.text: na vinaśyati tasmāc ca varuṇāvartasaṃjñakam ||
children.translated_text: and does not perish; therefore it has the designation <s>Varuṇāvarta</s>."

children.text: ye smariṣyanti gokarṇaṃ prātar utthāya nityaśaḥ
children.translated_text: "Those who remember <s>Gokarṇa</s> every day after rising in the morning,

children.text: teṣāṃ rātrikṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
children.translated_text: their sin committed during the night perishes at that very instant."

children.text: evaṃ divā kṛtaṃ pāpam aparāhṇe praṇaśyati
children.translated_text: "Likewise, sin committed during the day perishes in the afternoon.

children.text: pañcakrośaparīmāṇaṃ kṣetrāṇām uttamottamam ||
children.translated_text: Its measure is five <s>krośas</s>; it is the very best of sacred fields."

children.text: ye paśyanti mahākṣetraṃ gokarṇaṃ surapūjitam
children.translated_text: Those who behold the great sacred field <s>Gokarṇa</s>, worshiped by the gods,

children.text: janmaprabhṛti yat teṣāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati ||
children.translated_text: whatever sin has been committed by them from birth onward is destroyed.

children.text: snānaṃ kurvanti ye tatra gokarṇe tīrthasattame
children.translated_text: Those who bathe there at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, the best of tīrthas,

children.text: teṣāṃ trijanmācaritaṃ pāpaṃ naśyaty asaṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: their sin practiced through three births is destroyed, without doubt.

children.text: yathā kailāsaśikhare yathā mandaramūrdhani
children.translated_text: As on the peak of <s>Kailāsa</s>, as on the summit of <s>Mandara</s>,

children.text: nivasāmi sadā devyā tathā gokarṇamaṇḍale ||
children.translated_text: so I dwell always with the goddess in the region of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: śrīśailakāśyor api rāmasetau gokarṇamukhyeṣv api puṇyabhūmiṣu
children.translated_text: Among sacred lands such as <s>Śrīśaila</s> and <s>Kāśī</s>, at <s>Rāmasetu</s>, and those headed by <s>Gokarṇa</s>,

children.text: ārabhya tasmād api mukhyadeśāt sad yojanair dvādaśabhiś ca maṇḍalam ||
children.translated_text: from that foremost place extends a maṇḍala of twelve yojanas.

children.text: ity uktvā dharaṇīṃ rudro dṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭiṃ svayaṃbhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus to the earth, <s>Rudra</s>, seeing the creation of <s>Svayaṃbhū</s>,

children.text: kruddhaḥ san tāṃ saṃjihīrṣuḥ kiṃcid īśānabhāgagaḥ ||
children.translated_text: became angry and, wishing to destroy it, went somewhat toward the north-eastern quarter.

children.text: pramathān sasṛje tatra tāvad viṣṇur upāgataḥ
children.translated_text: He created the <s>Pramathas</s> there; meanwhile <s>Viṣṇu</s> arrived.

children.text: uvāca rudraṃ bho deva kṣamyatāṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: He said to <s>Rudra</s>, "O god, let what has been done by <s>Brahmā</s> be forgiven.

children.text: ante tvam eva saṃhartā krodham adyopasaṃhara
children.translated_text: At the end you alone are the destroyer; restrain your anger today."

children.text: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān prāhānugrāhakaṃ vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the blessed Lord, pleased, spoke a gracious word.

children.text: didhakṣor mama saṃsthityā bhūyād īśānabhūr iyam
children.translated_text: "Since I stood here while wishing to burn it, may this be the land of <s>Īśāna</s>.

children.text: rudrabhūmir iti khyātā mokṣadā dahanān nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: Known as <s>Rudrabhūmi</s>, may it grant liberation to men through cremation.

children.text: prakṛtyā pārṣadaiḥ sākam atra viṣṇo vasāmy aham
children.translated_text: By my own nature, together with my attendants, I dwell here, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>."

children.text: ity ukte śambhunā viṣṇus tathāstv iti yayau divam ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Śambhu</s> had spoken thus, <s>Viṣṇu</s> said, "So be it," and went to heaven.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: gokarṇe sarvadā vāsaṃ maraṇam muktimaṇḍape
children.translated_text: Residence always in <s>Gokarṇa</s>, death in the pavilion of liberation,

children.text: rudrabhūmyāṃ tu dahanaṃ kāṅkṣante vibudhā api ||
children.translated_text: and cremation in <s>Rudrabhūmi</s>: even the gods desire these.

children.text: tataḥ rudraś cintayitvā bhaviṣyat kāryaṃ gauravam
children.translated_text: Then <s>Rudra</s>, reflecting on the weighty work that would arise in the future,

children.text: svapratijñā vṛthā mā bhūd iti brahmādiṣu svayam ||
children.translated_text: thought, "May my own promise not become vain," with regard to <s>Brahmā</s> and the others.

children.text: sthāvarānteṣu yat sattvaṃ tad ākṛṣya maheśvaraḥ
children.translated_text: Drawing out whatever vital essence there was in beings down to the immovable ones, <s>Maheśvara</s>

children.text: tena sattvena sauvarṇaṃ nirmame mṛgam uttamam ||
children.translated_text: made from that essence an excellent golden deer.

children.text: svasya viṣṇor brahmaṇaś ca sattvāc chṛṅgatrayaṃ tathā
children.translated_text: From the essence of himself, of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and of <s>Brahmā</s>, he likewise made three horns,

children.text: aśeṣaprāṇināṃ sattvāc catuṣpādaṃ trinetrakam ||
children.translated_text: and from the essence of all living beings he made it four-footed and three-eyed.

children.text: tanmṛgeṇa hy agāt svāmī saha kailāsamandiram
children.translated_text: The Lord then went with that deer to the abode of <s>Kailāsa</s>.

children.text: tataḥ prajāḥ prajāpālāḥ sarve sattvavivarjitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then all creatures and guardians of creatures, bereft of their vital essence,

children.text: surāsuramanuṣyāś ca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
children.translated_text: the gods, asuras, and humans, went to <s>Brahmā</s> for refuge.

children.text: tataḥ svayaṃbhuvā sārdhaṃ surā viṣṇum upāgaman ||
children.translated_text: Then the gods, together with <s>Svayaṃbhū</s>, approached <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: uvāca viṣṇus tān devān sattvaṃ rudreṇa vai hṛtam
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> said to those gods, "The vital essence has indeed been taken by <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: taṃ gatvā vibudhaśreṣṭhā yāciṣyāmaḥ kṛpānidhim ||
children.translated_text: Let us go to him, O best of gods, and beseech that treasury of compassion."

children.text: iti niścitya te sarve kailāsam agaman surāḥ
children.translated_text: Having resolved thus, all those gods went to <s>Kailāsa</s>.

children.text: pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ prārthayāmāsur īhitam ||
children.translated_text: After worshiping <s>Mahādeva</s>, they asked for what they desired.

children.text: tatas tuṣṭaḥ śivaḥ prādāt tebhyaḥ sattvamayaṃ mṛgam
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śiva</s>, pleased, gave them the deer made of vital essence.

children.text: prītāḥ surās tad vibhajya jagṛhuḥ sattvam ātmanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Delighted, the gods divided it and took back their own vital essence.

children.text: brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca svīyaṃ śṛṅgaṃ samādade
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Rudra</s> each took up his own horn.

children.text: tacchṛṅgaṃ pūjayann āste rudro bhaktyānukampayā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> remains worshiping that horn with devotion and compassion.

children.text: etad eva prāṇaliṅgaṃ cātmaliṅgam itīryate
children.translated_text: This very thing is called the <s>Prāṇaliṅga</s> and the <s>Ātmaliṅga</s>.

children.text: ya etat pūjayed bhaktyā sa prāpnotīpsitaṃ dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: Whoever worships it with devotion certainly obtains what he desires.

children.text: śṛṇudhvam asya māhātmyaṃ sarvalokaikaviśrutam
children.translated_text: Listen to its greatness, renowned throughout all the worlds.

children.text: trailokyasyādhipatyāya devadānavayoḥ purā ||
children.translated_text: Long ago, for sovereignty over the three worlds, between the gods and the dānavas

children.text: yuddho babhūva tumulo devās tatra parājitāḥ
children.translated_text: a fierce battle took place, and there the gods were defeated.

children.text: dānavair hṛtasarvasvā īśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their possessions all seized by the dānavas, they went to <s>Īśvara</s> for refuge.

children.text: tadādeśāl liṅgam etad ārādhya punar āhave
children.translated_text: At his command, after worshiping this <s>liṅga</s>, again in battle

children.text: nirjitya dānavān devā alabhanta manorathān ||
children.translated_text: the gods defeated the dānavas and obtained their desires.

children.text: evamādikathāḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo 'sya jighṛkṣayā
children.translated_text: Having heard such stories, <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, wishing to seize it,

children.text: kailāsaparvataṃ gatvā tapa ugraṃ samācarat ||
children.translated_text: went to Mount <s>Kailāsa</s> and performed severe austerity.

children.text: atrāntare nāradas tu gataḥ kailāsaparvatam
children.translated_text: Meanwhile <s>Nārada</s> went to Mount <s>Kailāsa</s>.

children.text: tatra rāvaṇam anvīkṣya svargam etyāha vajriṇam ||
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Rāvaṇa</s> there, he went to heaven and spoke to <s>Vajrin</s>.

children.text: kailāse rāvaṇas tīvraṃ tapaś carati duścaram
children.translated_text: "On <s>Kailāsa</s>, <s>Rāvaṇa</s> is practicing intense, difficult austerity,

children.text: mṛgaśṛṅgaṃ netukāmaḥ purā yuṣmābhir arcitam ||
children.translated_text: wishing to carry off the deer's horn formerly worshiped by you.

children.text: nīte liṅge rāvaṇena niḥśrīkāḥ syur dhruvaṃ surāḥ
children.translated_text: If the <s>liṅga</s> is taken away by <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, the gods will surely be stripped of splendor.

children.text: tasmād vighnaṃ kuru kṣipram ity uktvāgād yathāgatam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore make an obstacle quickly." Having said this, he departed as he had come.

children.text: tataḥ saṃmantrya guruṇā sākaṃ śakro 'maraiḥ saha
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, after consulting with the <s>Guru</s> and together with the immortals,

children.text: paulastyatapase vighnaṃ kartuṃ kailāsam abhyagāt ||
children.translated_text: went to <s>Kailāsa</s> to make an obstacle to the austerity of the descendant of <s>Pulastya</s>.

children.text: atrāntare rāvaṇo 'pi toṣayitvā maheśvaram
children.translated_text: Meanwhile <s>Rāvaṇa</s> too, having pleased <s>Maheśvara</s>,

children.text: pañcabrahmātmakam idaṃ na nidhehi bhuvi kvacit ||
children.translated_text: was told, "This is composed of the five <s>Brahmans</s>; do not set it down anywhere upon the earth."

children.text: iti tenāpy anujñāto liṅgaṃ sampādya sādaram
children.translated_text: Thus permitted by him, he respectfully obtained the <s>liṅga</s>

children.text: svapuraṃ pādacāreṇa niryayau dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and set out on foot toward his own city, facing south.

children.text: athātra devāḥ kailāsagirim etya maheśvaram
children.translated_text: Then the gods came there to Mount <s>Kailāsa</s> and to <s>Maheśvara</s>,

children.text: papracchur abhivādyeśaṃ rāvaṇasya viceṣṭitam ||
children.translated_text: and, after bowing to the Lord, asked about <s>Rāvaṇa</s>'s actions.

children.text: sa tān uvāca bho devā liṅgaṃ sampādya rāvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: He said to them, "O gods, <s>Rāvaṇa</s> has obtained the <s>liṅga</s>

children.text: niragāt pādacāreṇa laṅkāṃ dakṣiṇadiṅmukhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and set out on foot toward <s>Laṅkā</s>, facing the southern direction.

children.text: gānena tapasā lubdho liṅgaṃ tasmai dadāv aham
children.translated_text: Won over by his singing and austerity, I gave him the <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: parantv ayam apātro 'tiduṣṭātmā iti niścayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But he is unworthy and extremely wicked in nature: this is certain.

children.text: atas tasya karāl liṅgaṃ galitaṃ sad yathā bhuvi
children.translated_text: Therefore strive so that the <s>liṅga</s> may slip from his hand onto the earth

children.text: pratiṣṭhitaṃ bhavec chīghraṃ prayatadhvaṃ tathā surāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and quickly become established there, O gods."

children.text: ity avāpya śivasyājñām anviṣyanto daśānanam
children.translated_text: Having received <s>Śiva</s>'s command in this way, and searching for <s>Daśānana</s>,

children.text: saptakoṭīśvaraṃ jagmur devā nāradabodhitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the gods, instructed by <s>Nārada</s>, went to <s>Saptakoṭīśvara</s>.

children.text: daśānano 'pi madhyāhne tatra sthitvāhnikaṃ caran
children.translated_text: <s>Daśānana</s> too stopped there at midday and, performing his daily rite,

children.text: pūjāṃ nirvartayāmāsa saptakoṭīśvarasya ca ||
children.translated_text: completed the worship of <s>Saptakoṭīśvara</s> as well.

children.text: tatra devān nirīkṣyaiva śaṅkitaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
children.translated_text: Seeing the gods there, he at once became suspicious and faint with anger.

children.text: gokarṇābhimukhaḥ prāgād rāvaṇo meghagarjanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, whose roar was like thunder, set out toward <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tam anvayātāḥ śakrādyā liṅgasya sthāpane tadā
children.translated_text: At that time <s>Śakra</s> and the others followed him, intent on the installation of the <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: viṣṇuṃ samprārthayāmāsur upāyaś cintyatām iti ||
children.translated_text: They entreated <s>Viṣṇu</s>, saying, "Let a stratagem be considered."

children.text: tato viṣṇuḥ kāryam etad upadiśya gajānanam
children.translated_text: Then <s>Viṣṇu</s>, after explaining this task to <s>Gajānana</s>,

children.text: prāhiṇod rāvaṇam anu svayaṃ cāgāt sahāyakṛt ||
children.translated_text: sent him after <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, and he himself went along as a helper.

children.text: pitṛsthālīsamīpe tu yāvad gacchati rāvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Now while <s>Rāvaṇa</s> was going near <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>,

children.text: tāvac ca viṣṇur bhagavān alaukikyātmamāyayā ||
children.translated_text: just then the blessed <s>Viṣṇu</s>, by his own superhuman māyā,

children.text: cakreṇa sūryam ācchādya sandhyām evāvabhāsayat
children.translated_text: covered the sun with his discus and made twilight appear.

children.text: astaṃ gato 'rka ity evaṃ manyamāno daśānanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Daśānana</s>, thinking, "The sun has set,"

children.text: kathaṃ sandhyām upāsiṣye dhṛtvā liṅgaṃ kare 'dhunā
children.translated_text: wondered, "How shall I now perform the <s>sandhyā</s> rite while holding the <s>liṅga</s> in my hand?"

children.text: iti cintākulas tāvad gajāsyaṃ baṭurūpiṇam ||
children.translated_text: While he was thus troubled by thought, he saw <s>Gajāsya</s> in the form of a young brahmin student,

children.text: dṛṣṭvā tasya kare liṅgaṃ ditsur evam uvāca tam
children.translated_text: and, wishing to place the <s>liṅga</s> in his hand, spoke to him as follows:

children.text: muniputra gṛhāṇedaṃ liṅgaratnaṃ muhūrtakam ||
children.translated_text: "Son of a sage, take this jewel of a <s>liṅga</s> for a moment.

children.text: nadyām asyāṃ vidhiṃ sāndhyaṃ samāpyādāsya āśv aham
children.translated_text: When I have completed the twilight rite in this river, I shall quickly take it back.

children.text: pañcabrahmātmakaṃ caitan na nidhehi mahītale ||
children.translated_text: But this is composed of the five Brahmans; do not set it down on the ground."

children.text: evam ukto rāvaṇena gajāsyaḥ pratyuvāca tam
children.translated_text: Thus addressed by <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, <s>Gajāsya</s> replied to him:

children.text: aho gurutamaṃ hy etatkāryārthī vaṭur apy aham ||
children.translated_text: "Ah, this is extremely heavy, and I too am a young student with business to do.

children.text: avaśyam eva vāhyaṃ cen na saheya ciraṃ kvacit
children.translated_text: If it must indeed be carried, I cannot bear it anywhere for long.

children.text: tad ahaṃ tvāṃ trir āhūya nidhāsye tvayy anāgate ||
children.translated_text: So I will call you three times, and if you do not come, I will set it down."

children.text: ity uktvā jagṛhe liṅgaṃ sandhyāṃ dadhyau ca rāvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Saying this, he took the <s>liṅga</s>, while <s>Rāvaṇa</s> meditated on the twilight rite.

children.text: tāvad devāḥ prāṇaliṅge trilokībhāram ādadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Meanwhile the gods placed the weight of the three worlds into the life-bearing <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: tadā voḍhum aśaktas trir uccair udghuṣya rāvaṇam
children.translated_text: Then, unable to bear it, <s>Gajāsya</s> loudly called <s>Rāvaṇa</s> three times

children.text: gajāsyaḥ sthāpayāmāsa liṅgaṃ śleṣmātake vane ||
children.translated_text: and set the <s>liṅga</s> down in the <s>Śleṣmātaka</s> forest.

children.text: vaivasvate 'ntare rājan trayoviṃśatime śubhe
children.translated_text: In the auspicious twenty-third division of the <s>Vaivasvata</s> manvantara, O king,

children.text: tretāyuge tv īśvarābde śaratkāle nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: in the <s>Tretāyuga</s>, in the year called <s>Īśvara</s>, in autumn, O best of kings,

children.text: ūrjaśuklapratipadi vyatīpāte raverdine
children.translated_text: on the bright first day of the month <s>Ūrja</s>, with the <s>Vyatīpāta</s> conjunction, on Sunday,

children.text: tulāmāse mīnalagne viśākhāyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: in the month of <s>Tulā</s>, with <s>Mīna</s> rising, under <s>Viśākhā</s>, it was established.

children.text: tato viṣṇuḥ svakaṃ cakram upasaṃhṛtavān raveḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Viṣṇu</s> withdrew his own discus from the sun,

children.text: atha devagaṇā liṅge puṣpāṇi vavṛṣur mudā ||
children.translated_text: and the hosts of gods joyfully rained flowers upon the <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: śaśaṃsuśca stavair divyaiḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ gajānanam
children.translated_text: With divine hymns they praised <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Gajānana</s>,

children.text: vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādyair nanṛtuś cāpsarogaṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and bands of <s>Apsaras</s> danced to vīṇās, flutes, mṛdaṅgas, and the like.

children.text: iti śrīskānde gokarṇakhaṇḍe śrīgokarṇamāhātmye sāroddhāre prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the first chapter in the epitome of the holy <s>Gokarṇa Māhātmya</s>, in the <s>Gokarṇa-khaṇḍa</s> of the blessed <s>Skanda Purāṇa</s>.

children.text: Chapter 2
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: tato daśānanaḥ sūryaṃ gagane dīptatejasam
children.translated_text: Then <s>Daśānana</s> saw the sun, blazing with radiance in the sky,

children.text: dadarśa ca gajāsyena bhūmyāṃ liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: and saw the <s>liṅga</s> set upon the ground by <s>Gajāsya</s>.

children.text: kopena mahatā viṣṭo liṅgasyāntikam āyayau
children.translated_text: Filled with great anger, he came near the <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: dorbhyāṃ liṅgaṃ pragṛhyāśu jānubhyām avaniṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seizing the <s>liṅga</s> quickly with both arms, he sank to the ground on his knees.

children.text: cakarṣa sarvabalato rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, lord of the rākṣasas, pulled with all his strength,

children.text: na śaśāka tad uddhartuṃ nyapatan mūrchitaḥ svayam ||
children.translated_text: but he could not lift it, and himself fell down senseless.

children.text: tataḥ kalakalaḥ śabdas tatrātyantam abhūn nṛpa
children.translated_text: Then, O king, a tremendous tumultuous sound arose there.

children.text: tatra devāś ca ṛṣayaḥ sthāpayāmāsur uttamam ||
children.translated_text: There the gods and sages established that excellent one,

children.text: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ liṅgaṃ kalakaleśvaram
children.translated_text: a <s>liṅga</s> famous in the three worlds as <s>Kalakaleśvara</s>.

children.text: yasya darśanamātreṇa mahāpāpaṃ vinaśyati ||
children.translated_text: By the mere sight of it, great sin is destroyed.

children.text: tasya liṅgasya savidhe hy udīcyāṃ diśi saṃsthitaḥ
children.translated_text: Near that <s>liṅga</s>, situated in the northern direction,

children.text: vaivāhiko nāma giriḥ sarvasiddhaniṣevitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: is the mountain named <s>Vaivāhika</s>, attended by all siddhas.

children.text: tatra gatvā yas tu rājan dakṣiṇāśāṃ vilokayan
children.translated_text: Whoever goes there, O king, and looks toward the southern quarter,

children.text: pradakṣiṇīkṛtya giriṃ sthitvā tasya tale śubhe ||
children.translated_text: circumambulates the mountain, and stands at its auspicious foot,

children.text: aṣṭākṣaraṃ japen mantram ṛṣichandaḥ sadaivatam
children.translated_text: should recite the eight-syllabled mantra, complete with its seer, meter, and deity,

children.text: uccaiḥ śabdaṃ prakurvīta hara3 ity athavā hare3 ||
children.translated_text: and cry out loudly, "Hara3" or "Hare3."

children.text: mūrdhni tasyākāśagaṅgābhiṣiñcati na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Ākāśagaṅgā</s> bathes his head, without doubt.

children.text: evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājann amṛtatvaṃ sa gacchati ||
children.translated_text: Whoever acts thus, O king, attains immortality.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: labdhasaṃjño muhūrtena rāvaṇaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ
children.translated_text: After a moment <s>Rāvaṇa</s> regained consciousness, overwhelmed with anger,

children.text: gajāsyaṃ tāḍayāmāsa mastake dṛḍhamuṣṭinā ||
children.translated_text: and struck <s>Gajāsya</s> on the head with a hard fist.

children.text: evaṃ vitathayatno 'sau rāvaṇo vañcitaḥ suraiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, his effort frustrated and having been deceived by the gods,

children.text: lajjito gūḍham ambhodhiṃ tīrtvā svapuram āviśat ||
children.translated_text: was ashamed, secretly crossed the ocean, and entered his own city.

children.text: gajānano 'pi liṅgasya āgneyāṃ diśi pṛṣṭhataḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Gajānana</s> too, behind the <s>liṅga</s> in the southeastern direction,

children.text: paścimābhimukho bhūtvā catvāriṃśatpade sthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: stood forty paces away, facing west.

children.text: devāś ca gaṇḍakīkṣetrāc chālagrāmaśilāmayam
children.translated_text: And the gods brought from the <s>Gaṇḍakī</s> region a pedestal made of <s>śālagrāma</s> stone

children.text: pīṭham ānāyya liṅgasya yojayāmāsur uttamam ||
children.translated_text: and fitted that excellent pedestal to the <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: atha vāyumukhāt sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ śrutvā maheśvaraḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Maheśvara</s>, having heard the whole event from <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: gokarṇam etya tal liṅgaṃ gajāsyena pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: came to <s>Gokarṇa</s>, to that <s>liṅga</s> established by <s>Gajāsya</s>.

children.text: rāvaṇasya nakhakṣuṇṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā cātmany atītapat
children.translated_text: Seeing it scratched by <s>Rāvaṇa</s>'s nails, he was distressed within himself.

children.text: aparādho mamaivātra yad duṣṭasya vaśe kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: "The fault here is mine alone, since it was put into the control of a wicked one.

children.text: tatredaṃ nu mahadbhāgyaṃ gokarṇe supratiṣṭhitam
children.translated_text: Yet in this there is indeed great good fortune: it has been well established at <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: janmabhūmitvabudhyā hi mamāpy asty atra gauravam ||
children.translated_text: For, considering it my birthplace, I too have honor here.

children.text: ato mama kare eva sthitam etan na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore it stands in my own hand, without doubt."

children.text: evaṃ manaḥ samādhāya devān provāca śaṅkaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having settled his mind in this way, <s>Śaṅkara</s> said to the gods:

children.text: liṅgaratnam idaṃ devā ajaiṣīd rāvaṇaṃ balāt
children.translated_text: "Gods, this jewel of a <s>liṅga</s> has conquered <s>Rāvaṇa</s> by its strength.

children.text: trailokye balinaṃ tasmād asya nāma mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, since it overcame the mighty one in the three worlds, its name shall be <s>Mahābala</s>."

children.text: ity uktvā praṇanāmātha pārvatyā saha pārṣadaiḥ
children.translated_text: Having said this, he then bowed together with <s>Pārvatī</s> and his attendants,

children.text: mahābalaṃ pratuṣṭāva śaṅkaro bharatarṣabha ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Śaṅkara</s> praised <s>Mahābala</s>, O bull of the <s>Bharatas</s>.

children.text: namaste rājaliṅgāya liṅgaratnāya te namaḥ
children.translated_text: "Homage to you, royal <s>liṅga</s>; homage to you, jewel of <s>liṅga</s>s.

children.text: namaste rāvaṇabhujagarvasarvasvahāriṇe ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you, who took away the entire pride of <s>Rāvaṇa</s>'s arms.

children.text: namo 'smadbhāgadheyāya namaste triguṇātmane
children.translated_text: Homage to our good fortune; homage to you whose nature is the three <s>guṇa</s>s.

children.text: dantāvalānanakṛtapratiṣṭhāya namo namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Repeated homage to you, installed by the elephant-faced one.

children.text: namo vedaśirovedyajyotirānandamūrtaye
children.translated_text: Homage to you whose form is light and bliss, knowable through the heads of the Vedas.

children.text: namas triśirase tubhyaṃ bhavarogabhayacchide ||
children.translated_text: Homage to you, the three-headed one, who cuts away the fear born of the disease of worldly existence.

children.text: gokarṇakṣetravāsāya mahābala namo namaḥ
children.translated_text: Again and again homage to you, O <s>Mahābala</s>, who dwell in the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: stutvaivaṃ sa gajāsyasyāntikam etya tam āśliṣan ||
children.translated_text: Having praised him in this way, he came near the elephant-faced <s>Gajāsya</s> and embraced him.

children.text: mūrdhni tasya vraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāntvayann idam abravīt
children.translated_text: Seeing the wound on his head, he consoled him and said this:

children.text: ādau tvām arcayitvā yo 'rcayatīha mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: Whoever, after first honoring you, worships <s>Mahābala</s> here,

children.text: vāñchitārthaṃ sa labhatāṃ matprasādād asaṃśayam
children.translated_text: let him obtain the object he desires, without doubt, by my favor.

children.text: ity uktvā pūjayāmāsa vighneśaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he worshipped <s>Vighneśa</s> according to rule.

children.text: tato mahābalaṃ rājan pūjayitvāha śaṅkaraḥ
children.translated_text: Then, O king, after worshipping <s>Mahābala</s>, <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: bho devāḥ kārtike māse liṅgam etat pratiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: O gods, this <s>liṅga</s> was established in the month of <s>Kārtika</s>.

children.text: tasmād ahaṃ vasāmy atra kārtike svagaṇaiḥ saha
children.translated_text: Therefore I dwell here in <s>Kārtika</s>, together with my own hosts.

children.text: bhavanto 'pi vasantv atra pūjayāmo mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: You too should dwell here; let us worship <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: yas tadā koṭitīrthe 'tra snātvā liṅgaṃ prapūjayet
children.translated_text: Whoever, at that time, bathes here in <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> and worships the <s>liṅga</s>,

children.text: śaktyā ca kiṃcid dadyāc cet karmabandhāt sa mucyate ||
children.translated_text: and gives even something according to his ability, is released from the bond of karma.

children.text: yad yad dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ kṛtaṃ karma surottamāḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever is given, offered in fire, recited, or performed as a rite, O best of gods,

children.text: tad anantaphalaṃ cāstu narāṇāṃ matprasādataḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that bear infinite fruit for people, by my favor.

children.text: tatra gokarṇayātrāyāṃ viṣuyuk kārtiko varaḥ
children.translated_text: There, for the pilgrimage to <s>Gokarṇa</s>, a viṣuyuk <s>Kārtika</s> is best.

children.text: māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ niśīthe yo mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: On the fourteenth day of the dark half of <s>Māgha</s>, at midnight, whoever worships <s>Mahābala</s>

children.text: ekena bilvapatreṇāpy aṇumātrajalena vā
children.translated_text: with even a single bilva leaf or with water as small as an atom,

children.text: pūjayet tasya māhātmyaṃ nālaṃ brahmāpi varṇitum ||
children.translated_text: even <s>Brahmā</s> is not able to describe that person's greatness.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ bilvapatraṃ ca liṅgaratnamahābalam
children.translated_text: <s>Gokarṇa</s>, the bilva leaf, the jewel-like <s>liṅga</s> <s>Mahābala</s>,

children.text: śivarātriś ceti devā durlabhaṃ hi catuṣṭayam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Śivarātri</s>, O gods: this set of four is indeed hard to obtain.

children.text: tasmin kāle tu yad dattam ekaṃ koṭiphalapradam
children.translated_text: Whatever is given at that time, even one thing, yields the fruit of ten million.

children.text: ity uktvā sa prasannātmā yayau kailāsaparvatam ||
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he, glad at heart, went to <s>Kailāsa</s> mountain.

children.text: tadā prabhṛti gokarṇe vāsaṃ cakrur divaukasaḥ
children.translated_text: From then on the dwellers in heaven made their abode in <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: mahābalam iti prāhur liṅgaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram ||
children.translated_text: They call the <s>liṅga</s>, the god who is lord of the three worlds, <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: devaṃ mahābalaṃ rājan pūjayanti surarṣayaḥ
children.translated_text: O king, the gods and divine seers worship the god <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: tasmāt puṇyatamaṃ liṅgam anyan nāsti jagattraye ||
children.translated_text: Therefore in the three worlds there is no other <s>liṅga</s> more supremely holy.

children.text: mahābalasamaṃ liṅgaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: A <s>liṅga</s> equal to <s>Mahābala</s> has not existed and will not exist.

children.text: kṛte mahābalaṃ śvetaṃ tretāyām atilohitam ||
children.translated_text: In the <s>Kṛta</s> age <s>Mahābala</s> is white; in the <s>Tretā</s> age it is deep red.

children.text: dvāpare pītavarṇaṃ ca kalau śyāmaṃ bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: In the <s>Dvāpara</s> age it is yellow in color, and in the <s>Kali</s> age it will be dark.

children.text: ghore kaliyuge prāpte mṛdutām upayāsyati ||
children.translated_text: When the terrible <s>Kali</s> age has arrived, it will become soft.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā vā divyaliṅgaṃ ca śrutvā vā sāgaradhvanim
children.translated_text: Whether a person sees the divine <s>liṅga</s> or hears the sound of the ocean,

children.text: koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā punarjanma na vindate ||
children.translated_text: after bathing in <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, he does not find rebirth.

children.text: sarvāṇy aśmāni liṅgāni tīrthāny ambhāṃsi sarvaśaḥ
children.translated_text: All stones there are <s>liṅgas</s>, and all waters everywhere are tīrthas (sacred fords).

children.text: sarve tapasvino rājan gokarṇe surapūjite ||
children.translated_text: All ascetics, O king, dwell in god-honored <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: api pāpaśataṃ kṛtvā brahmahatyādi mānavaḥ
children.translated_text: Even if a human being has committed hundreds of sins, such as brahmahatyā (killing a brahmin),

children.text: sakṛt praviśya gokarṇaṃ sadyo mucyeta pātakaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: having once entered <s>Gokarṇa</s>, he would at once be released from sins.

children.text: yatrendrabrahmaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ prītikāmyayā
children.translated_text: There, in order to please gods such as <s>Indra</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, and <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: mahābalābhidhānena śivaḥ saṃnihitaḥ svayam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> himself is present under the name <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: atraikena dinenāpi yat kṛtaṃ karma cottamam
children.translated_text: Whatever excellent rite is performed here even in a single day,

children.text: tad anyatrābdalakṣeṇa bhaviṣyati susambhṛtam ||
children.translated_text: elsewhere will be fully accomplished only in a hundred thousand years.

children.text: indro brahmā mukundaś ca viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Mukunda</s>, the <s>Viśvedevas</s>, and the hosts of <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ śaśāṅkaś ca satārakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Vasus</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and the moon with the stars,

children.text: ete vimānagatayaḥ sahitāḥ pārṣadaiḥ svakaiḥ
children.translated_text: these, moving in aerial cars and accompanied by their own attendants,

children.text: pūrvadvāri niṣevante devadevaṃ mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: serve <s>Mahābala</s>, the god of gods, at the eastern gate.

children.text: kālo mṛtyur yamaḥ sākṣāc citraguptaś ca pālakaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Kāla</s>, <s>Mṛtyu</s>, <s>Yama</s> himself, and <s>Citragupta</s> the guardian,

children.text: pitṛbhiḥ saha rudraiś ca dakṣiṇadvāram āśritāḥ ||
children.translated_text: together with the ancestors and the <s>Rudras</s>, have taken station at the southern gate.

children.text: vibhāvasuś citrarathaś citraseno mahābalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vibhāvasu</s>, <s>Citraratha</s>, <s>Citrasena</s>, and <s>Mahābala</s>,

children.text: ete gandharvavargeṇa gāyantaḥ paścime sthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: these stand in the west, singing with the class of gandharvas.

children.text: rambhā kṛtasthalā menā pūrvacittis tilottamā
children.translated_text: <s>Rambhā</s>, <s>Kṛtasthalā</s>, <s>Menā</s>, <s>Pūrvacitti</s>, and <s>Tilottamā</s>,

children.text: nṛtyanti ca puraḥ śambhor urvaśyādyāḥ surastriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the heavenly women beginning with <s>Urvaśī</s> dance before <s>Śambhu</s>.

children.text: vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇvo viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, <s>Kaśyapa</s>, <s>Kaṇva</s>, and <s>Viśvāmitra</s> of great austerity,

children.text: jaiminiś ca bharadvājo jābāliḥ kratur aṅgirāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jaimini</s>, <s>Bharadvāja</s>, <s>Jābāli</s>, <s>Kratu</s>, and <s>Aṅgiras</s>,

children.text: gautamo jamadagniś ca bhārgavo 'triḥ parāśaraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Gautama</s>, <s>Jamadagni</s>, <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Atri</s>, and <s>Parāśara</s>,

children.text: vyāsaḥ satyavatīputraḥ śukena saha kaurava ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vyāsa</s>, the son of <s>Satyavatī</s>, together with <s>Śuka</s>, O Kaurava,

children.text: ete cānye ca rājendra sarve brahmarṣayo 'malāḥ
children.translated_text: these and others, O great king, all stainless brahmarṣis,

children.text: devaṃ mahābalaṃ bhaktyā uttaraṃ dvāram āśritāḥ ||
children.translated_text: have taken station at the northern gate, worshipping the god <s>Mahābala</s> with devotion.

children.text: nārado vālakhilyāś ca marīcyādyāḥ prajeśvarāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Nārada</s>, the <s>Vālakhilyas</s>, and the lords of creatures beginning with <s>Marīci</s>,

children.text: sanakādyā mahātmāna upariṣṭād upāsate ||
children.translated_text: and the great-souled ones beginning with <s>Sanaka</s> worship him above.

children.text: tathānye munayo 'saṅkhyā jaṭino valkalāmbarāḥ
children.translated_text: Likewise, countless other sages with matted hair and garments of bark

children.text: sevante parayā bhaktyā devadevaṃ mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: serve <s>Mahābala</s>, the god of gods, with supreme devotion.

children.text: evaṃ devāḥ sagandharvā ye sarve devayonayaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus all the gods together with the gandharvas, all beings of divine birth,

children.text: nāgāḥ piśācā vetālā daiteyāś cāpare nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: nāgas, piśācas, vetālas, daityas, and others, O king,

children.text: nānāvibhavasampannā nānāvāhanabhūṣaṇāḥ
children.translated_text: endowed with various kinds of splendor and adorned with various vehicles and ornaments,

children.text: mahābalasya nikaṭam āgatya bharatarṣabha ||
children.translated_text: come near <s>Mahābala</s>, O bull of the Bharatas.

children.text: prastuvanti pragāyanti nṛtyanti praṇamanti ca
children.translated_text: They praise, sing loudly, dance, and bow down;

children.text: labhante 'bhīpsitān kāmān namante ca yathāsukham ||
children.translated_text: they obtain the desires they long for and bow as they please.

children.text: tatra ye ye tapas taptum āvasan devatādayaḥ
children.translated_text: There, whichever deities and others took up residence to perform austerities,

children.text: teṣāṃ teṣām āśramaś ca tīrthaṃ liṅgaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
children.translated_text: each of them has a separate hermitage, tīrtha, and <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: tat tan nāmnaiva vikhyātaṃ vidyate gaṇitaṃ ca tat
children.translated_text: Each is renowned by that one's own name, and it is recorded as existing there.

children.text: trayastriṃśatkoṭitīrthaṃ liṅgaṃ ceti viniścitam ||
children.translated_text: The number of tīrthas and <s>liṅgas</s> is definitively known as thirty-three crores.

children.text: sarveṣāṃ śivaliṅgānāṃ sārvabhaumo mahābalam
children.translated_text: Among all <s>Śiva</s>-<s>liṅgas</s>, <s>Mahābala</s> is the universal sovereign;

children.text: koṭitīrthaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ mukhyatāṃ gatam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> has attained primacy among all tīrthas.

children.text: ye mātṛpitṛhantāro ye vā bhūtadruhaḥ śaṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: Those who have killed mother or father, or who are deceitful harmers of living beings,

children.text: goghnāś caiva kṛtaghnāś ca paradāraratāś ca ye ||
children.translated_text: and those who kill cows, who are ungrateful, and who delight in others' wives,

children.text: te sarve prāpya gokarṇaṃ snātvā tīrthajale śubhe
children.translated_text: all of them, reaching <s>Gokarṇa</s> and bathing in the auspicious tīrtha-water,

children.text: mahābalaṃ ca sampūjya prayānti śivamandiram ||
children.translated_text: And, having worshiped <s>Mahābala</s>, they proceed to the temple of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: tatra puṇyāsu tithiṣu puṇyarkṣe puṇyavāsare
children.translated_text: There, on holy lunar dates, under an auspicious lunar mansion, and on a holy weekday,

children.text: vyatīpātādiyogeṣu ravisaṃkramaṇeṣu ca ||
children.translated_text: in conjunctions such as <s>Vyatīpāta</s> and at the transitions of the sun,

children.text: mahāpradoṣavelāsu śivapūjā vimuktidā
children.translated_text: at the times of the great <s>pradoṣa</s>, worship of <s>Śiva</s> grants liberation;

children.text: phalādhikyaṃ jape home dvijārcādau vrateṣu ca ||
children.translated_text: there is greater fruit in <s>japa</s>, <s>homa</s>, worship of Brahmins, vows, and the like.

children.text: sadā kṛtayugaś cātra sadā caivottarāyaṇam
children.translated_text: Here it is always the <s>Kṛta</s> age, and always indeed the northern course of the sun;

children.text: mahābalālaye puṇye puṇyaṃ puṇyasamṛddhikṛt ||
children.translated_text: at the holy abode of <s>Mahābala</s>, a meritorious act produces an abundance of merit.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ sā mahākāśī viśvanātho mahābalaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Gokarṇa</s> is that great <s>Kāśī</s>; <s>Mahābala</s> is <s>Viśvanātha</s>.

children.text: koṭitīrthaṃ tatra gaṅgā samudro'tra viśiṣyate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> there is the <s>Gaṅgā</s>; the ocean here is especially eminent.

children.text: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni gaṅgādisaritaś ca yāḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>tīrthas</s> are on earth, and whatever rivers beginning with the <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: viśanti sāgaraṃ yasmād gokarṇaṃ tad viśiṣyate ||
children.translated_text: because they enter the ocean, therefore <s>Gokarṇa</s> is distinguished.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ rāmasetuś ca kāśīti tristhalī smṛtā
children.translated_text: <s>Gokarṇa</s>, <s>Rāmasetu</s>, and <s>Kāśī</s> are remembered as the three sacred places;

children.text: tristhalīṣu kṛtaṃ karma śeṣeṇāpi na gaṇyate ||
children.translated_text: the rite performed at the three places cannot be counted even by <s>Śeṣa</s>.

children.text: yadā prāpnoti gokarṇaṃ yo vā ko vāpi mānavaḥ
children.translated_text: Whenever any human being at all reaches <s>Gokarṇa</s>,

children.text: muṇḍanaṃ copavāsaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca vidhivac caret ||
children.translated_text: he should duly perform shaving, fasting, and <s>śrāddha</s>.

children.text: gaṅgāyāṃ bhāskarakṣetre caule caivopanāyane
children.translated_text: At the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, in the field of <s>Bhāskara</s>, at tonsure and at initiation,

children.text: śrīśaile yajñadīkṣāyāṃ prāyaścittavrateṣu ca ||
children.translated_text: at <s>Śrīśaila</s>, at consecration for a sacrifice, and in vows of expiation,

children.text: mahāgurumṛtau caiva mahāsvāmimṛtāv api
children.translated_text: and at the death of a great guru, and also at the death of a great lord,

children.text: jīvatpitāpi kurvīta vapanaṃ śrāddham eva ca ||
children.translated_text: even one whose father is living should perform shaving and <s>śrāddha</s>.

children.text: navamāsāt paraṃ caiva punaḥ kṣetraṃ viśed yadi
children.translated_text: And if after nine months he again enters the sacred field,

children.text: kṣauropoṣaṇakādīni kuryād eva na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should indeed perform shaving, fasting, and the like; there is no doubt.

children.text: rudreṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāskarakṣetram ucyate
children.translated_text: The holy field presided over by <s>Rudra</s> is called <s>Bhāskarākṣetra</s>.

children.text: kāśī puṣpagiriḥ kāñcī nivṛttākhyā hy alaṃpurī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśī</s>, <s>Puṣpagiri</s>, <s>Kāñcī</s>, and <s>Alaṃpurī</s>, known as <s>Nivṛtta</s>,

children.text: śrīśailaḥ śrīvirūpākṣaḥ setuḥ kedāra eva ca
children.translated_text: <s>Śrīśaila</s>, <s>Śrīvirūpākṣa</s>, <s>Setu</s>, and <s>Kedāra</s> too,

children.text: gokarṇaṃ ca daśaitāni bhāskarāṇy āhur uttamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Gokarṇa</s>: these ten are said to be the best <s>Bhāskara</s> fields.

children.text: ādau snātvā koṭitīrthe sthāpayed brahmadaṇḍakam
children.translated_text: First, having bathed in <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, he should set up the <s>Brahmadaṇḍaka</s>.

children.text: kṣauraṃ kṛtvā vidhānena snānaṃ daśavidhaṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: Having shaved according to the rule, he should perform the tenfold bath.

children.text: bhasmagomayamṛdvādi pañcagavyaṃ tathaiva ca
children.translated_text: Ashes, cow-dung, earth, and so on, and likewise the five products of the cow,

children.text: malāpakarṣaṇaṃ caiva snānaṃ daśavidhaṃ smṛtam ||
children.translated_text: as well as the cleansing away of impurity: this is remembered as the tenfold bath.

children.text: evaṃ snātvā vidhānena śrāddhaṃ kuryāc ca bhaktitaḥ
children.translated_text: Having bathed in this way according to the rule, he should devoutly perform <s>śrāddha</s>;

children.text: tataḥ samudre vidhivat snātvā piṇḍādikaṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: then, having bathed in the ocean as prescribed, he should perform the offering of <s>piṇḍas</s> and the rest.

children.text: pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni samudraṃ praviśanti hi
children.translated_text: For all the <s>tīrthas</s> on earth enter the ocean.

children.text: tasmāt samudro hy adhikaḥ snānamātrāddhi muktidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore the ocean is superior and grants liberation by bathing alone.

children.text: ravīndusaumyavāreṣu yadā darśo bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: When the new-moon day falls on Sunday, Monday, or Wednesday,

children.text: tadā jalanidhau snānam anantaphaladaṃ smṛtam ||
children.translated_text: then bathing in the ocean is remembered as bestowing endless fruit.

children.text: setau sindhau sarasvatyāṃ gokarṇe puruṣottame
children.translated_text: At <s>Setu</s>, in the <s>Sindhu</s>, in the <s>Sarasvatī</s>, at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, and at <s>Puruṣottama</s>,

children.text: udanvadambhasi snānaṃ sārvakālaṃ vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: bathing in ocean-water is prescribed at all times.

children.text: kṣetreṣv anyeṣu sarveṣu parvaṇy eva vidhīyate
children.translated_text: In all other sacred fields it is prescribed only on festival days;

children.text: gokarṇe sarvakālaṃ ca sindhusnānaṃ samācaret ||
children.translated_text: but at <s>Gokarṇa</s> one should perform ocean-bathing at all times.

children.text: pippalādaṃ kaviṃ kaṇvaṃ kṛtāntaṃ jīviteśvaram
children.translated_text: <s>Pippalāda</s>, <s>Kavi</s>, <s>Kaṇva</s>, <s>Kṛtānta</s>, and <s>Jīviteśvara</s>,

children.text: manyuṃ ca kālarātriṃ ca vidyāṃ durgāṃ gaṇādhipam ||
children.translated_text: as well as <s>Manyu</s>, <s>Kālarātrī</s>, <s>Vidyā</s>, <s>Durgā</s>, and <s>Gaṇādhipa</s>,

children.text: devān ṛṣīn pitṝṃś caiva tarpayitvā vidhānataḥ
children.translated_text: having ritually satisfied the gods, seers, and ancestors,

children.text: punaḥ snānaṃ ca kṛtvaiva brāhmaṇebhyo yathāvidhi ||
children.translated_text: and then having bathed again, to the Brahmins, according to rule,

children.text: gobhūtilahiraṇyādidānaṃ dadyāt sadakṣiṇam
children.translated_text: he should give gifts of cows, land, sesame, gold, and the like, together with <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.

children.text: pitṛsthālīṃ samāsādya pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍado bhavet ||
children.translated_text: Having approached <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>, he should become a giver of <s>piṇḍas</s> to the ancestors.

children.text: svargaṃ prayānti pitaraḥ kulakoṭisamanvitāḥ
children.translated_text: The ancestors go to heaven, accompanied by ten million members of the family.

children.text: snātvā rudrapade caivam arcayitvā mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: Having bathed at <s>Rudrapada</s> in this way and worshiped <s>Mahābala</s>,

children.text: śṛṇuyāt tīrthamāhātmyaṃ kuryāc ca niśi jāgaram
children.translated_text: he should listen to the greatness of the <s>tīrtha</s> and keep vigil at night.

children.text: brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścāt svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Afterwards he should feed Brahmins and himself eat while restraining his speech.

children.text: evaṃ kṣetravidhiṃ kurvan snāyāt tīrtheṣu ca kramāt
children.translated_text: Performing the procedure of the sacred field in this way, he should bathe at the <s>tīrthas</s> in order,

children.text: trayastriṃśatsu mukhyeṣu trayastriṃśaddinair nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: at the thirty-three principal ones over thirty-three days, O king.

children.text: tatra sthaṃ cārcayel liṅgaṃ tīrthanāmāni me śṛṇu
children.translated_text: He should worship the <s>liṅga</s> situated there; hear from me the names of the <s>tīrthas</s>.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ guhatīrthaṃ ca tāmragaurī ca nimnagā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Gokarṇa</s>, <s>Guhatīrtha</s>, and the river <s>Tāmragaurī</s>,

children.text: gāyatraṃ ca tathā brāhmaṃ brahmakuṇḍam ataḥ param
children.translated_text: <s>Gāyatra</s>, then <s>Brāhma</s>, and after that <s>Brahmakuṇḍa</s>,

children.text: viśvāmitraṃ saṅgamaṃ ca cakraṃ kāpilam eva ca ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, <s>Saṅgama</s>, <s>Cakra</s>, and <s>Kāpila</s>,

children.text: araṇyam agnitīrthaṃ ca vaināyakam ataḥ param
children.translated_text: <s>Araṇya</s>, <s>Agnitīrtha</s>, and after that <s>Vaināyaka</s>,

children.text: kauberaṃ nādatīrthaṃ ca tataḥ sāṃvartakaṃ śubham ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kaubera</s>, <s>Nādatīrtha</s>, and then the auspicious <s>Sāṃvartaka</s>,

children.text: sūryaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca pāpanāśanatīrthakam
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>, and the <s>Pāpanāśana</s> <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: durgākuṇḍaṃ nāgatīrthaṃ koṭitīrtham ataḥ param ||
children.translated_text: <s>Durgākuṇḍa</s>, <s>Nāgatīrtha</s>, and after that <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>,

children.text: unmajjanaṃ mahātīrthaṃ nadī vaitaraṇī tathā
children.translated_text: <s>Unmajjana</s>, the great <s>tīrtha</s>, and likewise the river <s>Vaitaraṇī</s>,

children.text: aśokapañcakaṃ caiva gaṅgādhāram ataḥ param ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aśokapañcaka</s>, and after that <s>Gaṅgādhāra</s>,

children.text: bhīmakuṇḍaṃ tathāgastyaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ garuḍaṃ tathā
children.translated_text: <s>Bhīmakuṇḍa</s>, then <s>Agastya</s>, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, and <s>Garuḍa</s>,

children.text: māliny ākhyā nadī śuklā śiṃśumāram ihocyate ||
children.translated_text: the river called <s>Mālinī</s>, <s>Śuklā</s>, and <s>Śiṃśumāra</s> are mentioned here.

children.text: ekabindvādibindūnāṃ catuṣkaṃ tv ekam ucyate
children.translated_text: The group of four beginning with <s>Ekabindu</s> and <s>Ādibindu</s> is spoken of as one.

children.text: etāny ekaikakoṭīnāṃ tīrthānāṃ nāyakāni tu ||
children.translated_text: These are the leaders of tens of millions of individual <s>tīrthas</s>.

children.text: brahmāṇḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni te rave
children.translated_text: "The <s>tīrthas</s> within the cosmic egg have been touched by your hands, O Sun;

children.text: tena satyena gokarṇe tīrtheṣv āvāhito bhava ||
children.translated_text: by that truth, be invoked among the <s>tīrthas</s> at <s>Gokarṇa</s>."

children.text: imaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya snāyāt tīrtheṣu ca kramāt
children.translated_text: Having uttered this mantra, he should bathe in the <s>tīrthas</s> in order.

children.text: snātum eteṣv aśaktaś cet snāyād aṣṭasu vā nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: But if he is unable to bathe in these, he may bathe in eight, O king:

children.text: gokarṇaṃ guhatīrthaṃ ca tāmragaurī ca nimnagā
children.translated_text: <s>Gokarṇa</s>, <s>Guhatīrtha</s>, and the river <s>Tāmragaurī</s>,

children.text: gāyatraṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca brahmakuṇḍam ataḥ param ||
children.translated_text: <s>Gāyatra</s>, <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, and after that <s>Brahmakuṇḍa</s>,

children.text: rāmatīrthaṃ saṅgamaṃ cety aṣṭau tīrthāny anukramāt
children.translated_text: <s>Rāmatīrtha</s> and <s>Saṅgama</s>: these are the eight <s>tīrthas</s> in order.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ śataśṛṅgaṃ ca tāmragaurīṃ ca nimnagām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Gokarṇa</s>, <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>, and the river <s>Tāmragaurī</s>,

children.text: tīrtharājaṃ samudraṃ ca saṃsmaret puṇyapañcakam
children.translated_text: <s>Tīrtharāja</s> and the ocean: he should remember these as the sacred pentad.

children.text: ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā kṣetram āsādya yatnataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whoever, having reached the sacred field, does this with devotion and care...

children.text: mahābalaprasādena labdhvā puṇyam anantakam
children.translated_text: Through the grace of <s>Mahābala</s>, having obtained endless merit,

children.text: bhuktveha bhogān vividhān śivalokaṃ vrajed asau ||
children.translated_text: and having enjoyed various pleasures here, that person goes to the world of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: iti śrīskānde gokarṇamāhātmye dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the second chapter in the <s>Gokarṇa</s>-māhātmya of the glorious <s>Skanda</s> Purāṇa.

children.text: Chapter 3
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi śataśṛṅgagireḥ kathām
children.translated_text: Listen, O king; I shall tell the story of Mount <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>

children.text: koṭitīrthasya cotpattiṃ māhātmyam api puṇyadam ||
children.translated_text: and also the origin and merit-giving greatness of <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>.

children.text: āsan himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe trīṇi sthānāni pārthiva
children.translated_text: On the back of <s>Himavat</s> there were three places, O ruler:

children.text: pūrvasyām indranīlādrir viṣṇoḥ sthānam anuttamam ||
children.translated_text: in the east was Mount <s>Indranīla</s>, the unsurpassed place of <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: paścime śaṅkarasthānaṃ kailāsādrir abhūn nṛpa
children.translated_text: in the west, O king, Mount <s>Kailāsa</s> was the place of <s>Śaṅkara</s>;

children.text: brahmaṇo vasatir madhye śataśṛṅgagirir mahān ||
children.translated_text: in the middle was the great Mount <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>, the dwelling of <s>Brahmā</s>.

children.text: campakādyair vṛto vṛkṣaiḥ sarvartukusumānvitaiḥ
children.translated_text: It was surrounded by trees such as campakas, bearing flowers in every season,

children.text: devagandharvasiddhādyaiḥ puṇyais tīrthaiḥ samanvitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and was endowed with gods, gandharvas, siddhas, and other holy <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred bathing places).

children.text: athaikadā tu garuḍaḥ sarpaṃ durmukhanāmakam
children.translated_text: Now one day <s>Garuḍa</s>, having seized a serpent named <s>Durmukha</s>,

children.text: gṛhītvā khe caraṃs tasya śataśṛṅgasya mūrdhani ||
children.translated_text: was moving through the sky above the summit of that <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>.

children.text: sarpaṃ tam attukāmaḥ sann adho vṛkṣān vyalokayat
children.translated_text: Wishing to eat that serpent, he looked down at the trees below;

children.text: tāvat tasya mukhād bhraṣṭo durmukho bilam āviśat ||
children.translated_text: just then <s>Durmukha</s> slipped from his mouth and entered a hole.

children.text: tam anviṣyan na labdhvaiva krodhād utpāṭya taṃ girim
children.translated_text: Searching for him and not finding him, he angrily uprooted that mountain;

children.text: gṛhītvākāśamārgeṇa yayau khagapatir balī ||
children.translated_text: taking it, the mighty lord of birds went along the path of the sky.

children.text: anekair ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmā tatrāvasad girau
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> lived on that mountain together with many seers,

children.text: āsan dvikoṭitīrthāni śṛṅge himavataḥ śubhe ||
children.translated_text: and there were two crores of <s>tīrthas</s> on the auspicious peak of <s>Himavat</s>.

children.text: athedaṃ gāruḍaṃ karma buddhvā brahmā cukopa ha
children.translated_text: Then <s>Brahmā</s>, realizing this deed of <s>Garuḍa</s>, became angry.

children.text: trailokyabhāraṃ bhagavān ātmany ādhāya satvaram ||
children.translated_text: The blessed Lord quickly placed the burden of the three worlds upon himself,

children.text: dadhānaṃ śataśṛṅgaṃ taṃ pīḍayāmāsa vai dvijam
children.translated_text: and pressed down that bird as he was carrying <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>.

children.text: tasmin kāle sa garuḍo gokarṇasyopari sthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At that time <s>Garuḍa</s> was stationed above <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: bhāreṇa duḥkhito'tyantaṃ dṛṣṭvādhastāt tapovane
children.translated_text: Extremely distressed by the weight, he saw below him, in a grove of austerity,

children.text: agastyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāce kṛpālo rakṣa mām iti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agastya</s>, and begged for refuge: "Compassionate one, protect me!"

children.text: agastyas tadvacaḥ śrutvā mā bhaiṣīr iti ca bruvan
children.translated_text: Hearing those words, <s>Agastya</s> said, "Do not be afraid,"

children.text: majjantam abdhau sagiriṃ garuḍaṃ vīkṣya suvrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: and, O virtuous one, seeing <s>Garuḍa</s> sinking into the ocean together with the mountain,

children.text: avatārya giriṃ tatra rudrayonyās tu dakṣiṇe
children.translated_text: he lowered the mountain there to the south of <s>Rudrayoni</s>,

children.text: nidhāyāmbhonidhau tārkṣyaṃ mocayāmāsa līlayā ||
children.translated_text: set it in the ocean, and easily released <s>Tārkṣya</s>.

children.text: tato dhyānena vijñāya brahmā tatrāgamat prabhuḥ
children.translated_text: Then the lord <s>Brahmā</s>, knowing this through meditation, came there;

children.text: agastyaṃ ślāghayitvātha garuḍaṃ cedam abravīt ||
children.translated_text: after praising <s>Agastya</s>, he then spoke these words to <s>Garuḍa</s>:

children.text: bho vatsa śaṅkarasyaiva manasā cintitaṃ tv idam
children.translated_text: "Dear child, this very matter was conceived in the mind of <s>Śaṅkara</s>;

children.text: nimittamātraṃ tvam asi tatprīto 'smi varaṃ vṛṇu ||
children.translated_text: you are only the occasion. I am pleased by that; choose a boon."

children.text: garuḍa uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Garuḍa</s> said:

children.text: trailokyabhāraṃ bhagavan voḍhum icchāmy ayatnataḥ
children.translated_text: "Blessed Lord, I wish to bear the burden of the three worlds without effort;

children.text: na matto 'nyo 'dhiko loke bhavitavyaḥ parākrame ||
children.translated_text: no one other than me should be greater in strength in the world."

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: trailokyabhāravahane śaktis te syād ayatnataḥ
children.translated_text: "May you have the power to bear the burden of the three worlds without effort;

children.text: tattrilokaguruṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvadā vaha suvrata ||
children.translated_text: therefore always carry <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the lord of the three worlds, O virtuous one.

children.text: nākramiṣyanty āyudhāni tvāṃ sarvebhyo 'dhiko 'py asi
children.translated_text: Weapons will not strike you, and you are greater than all."

children.text: iti tasmai varaṃ datvā rudram ārādhya tadgirau ||
children.translated_text: Having thus given him the boon and having worshiped <s>Rudra</s> on that mountain,

children.text: kamaṇḍaluṃ ca saṃsthāpya sarvatīrtham ayaṃ svakam
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> established his own water-pot, consisting of all <s>tīrthas</s>,

children.text: brahmā brahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ satyalokaṃ jagāma ha ||
children.translated_text: and went to <s>Satyaloka</s> together with the brahmarṣis.

children.text: garuḍo'pi varaṃ labdhvā tapasārādhya śaṃkaram
children.translated_text: <s>Garuḍa</s> too, having received the boon, worshiped <s>Śaṃkara</s> with austerity;

children.text: svanāmnā tīrtham utpādya sthāpayitvā svavigraham ||
children.translated_text: he brought forth a <s>tīrtha</s> in his own name and established his own image.

children.text: agastyam abhivādyātha yato viṣṇus tato gataḥ
children.translated_text: Then, after bowing to <s>Agastya</s>, he went to where <s>Viṣṇu</s> was.

children.text: tad etadbhuvi vikhyātaṃ gāruḍaṃ tīrtham uttamam ||
children.translated_text: This, renowned on earth, is that excellent <s>Gāruḍa</s> <s>tīrtha</s>.

children.text: āśramo 'pi ca tasyaiva nāmnā garuḍamaṇḍapam
children.translated_text: His hermitage also, called <s>Garuḍamaṇḍapa</s> by his name,

children.text: agastyatīrthād vāyavyāṃ vartate nṛpa tatra yaḥ ||
children.translated_text: lies to the northwest of <s>Agastyatīrtha</s>, O king; there a man who

children.text: snātvā garuḍagāyatrīṃ caturlakṣaṃ japen naraḥ
children.translated_text: bathes and recites the <s>Garuḍa-gāyatrī</s> four hundred thousand times

children.text: so 'ṇimādimahāsiddhiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: obtains the great siddhis beginning with aṇimā; there is no doubt about this.

children.text: agastyo'pi mahātejāḥ svanāmnā tīrtham uttamam
children.translated_text: <s>Agastya</s> too, of great splendor, made an excellent <s>tīrtha</s> in his own name,

children.text: vidhāya liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya varadeśvaranāmakam ||
children.translated_text: established a <s>liṅga</s> named <s>Varadeśvara</s>,

children.text: bahukālaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prāpya maheśvarāt
children.translated_text: performed austerity for a long time, and obtained siddhi from <s>Maheśvara</s>;

children.text: yathākāmaṃ sa gokarṇe sthitavān munisattamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that best of sages remained in <s>Gokarṇa</s> as he wished.

children.text: śataśṛṅgaṃ girivaraṃ nākapṛṣṭhaṃ vidur budhāḥ
children.translated_text: The wise know the excellent Mount <s>Śataśṛṅga</s> as <s>Nākapṛṣṭha</s>;

children.text: brahmaloka iti prokto brahmāvāsaṃ ca taṃ viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: it is called <s>Brahmaloka</s>, and they know it as the dwelling of <s>Brahmā</s>.

children.text: rudrājñayā sārabhūtaṃ sarvaṃ tatrāgataṃ hy abhūt
children.translated_text: By <s>Rudra</s>'s command, all that was essential had indeed come there.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: garuḍenānīyamāne girau tasya bhayād iva ||
children.translated_text: As the mountain was being brought by <s>Garuḍa</s>, as if from fear of him,

children.text: tatratyakoṭitīrthāni ekībhūtāni vai nṛpa
children.translated_text: the crore of <s>tīrthas</s> located there truly became one, O king;

children.text: koṭitīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
children.translated_text: it is known as <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, the destroyer of all sins.

children.text: tad adya dṛśyate rājañchataśṛṅgottare taṭe
children.translated_text: That is seen today, O king, on the northern shore of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>.

children.text: tasmin snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A human being who bathes in it has bathed in all <s>tīrthas</s>.

children.text: daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena sāmyaṃ vadanty āptāḥ koṭitīrthe dvijāgryāḥ
children.translated_text: Trustworthy foremost Brahmins say that at <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> it equals the final bath of ten horse sacrifices;

children.text: mahat puṇyaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ variṣṭhaṃ snātās tasmin nākapṛṣṭhaṃ vrajanti ||
children.translated_text: it is great merit, supreme among meritorious acts, and those who bathe there go to <s>Nākapṛṣṭha</s>.

children.text: anyāni koṭitīrthāni paryastāny atha sāgare
children.translated_text: Other crores of <s>tīrthas</s> were then scattered in the ocean,

children.text: śataśṛṅgagires tasya taṭe dakṣiṇapaścime ||
children.translated_text: on the southwestern shore of that Mount <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>.

children.text: api pāpaśataṃ kṛtvā brahmahatyādi mānavaḥ
children.translated_text: Even after committing a hundred sins, such as brahmin-murder, a human being

children.text: koṭitīrthe snānamātrān mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: is released from all transgressions merely by bathing in <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>.

children.text: atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam
children.translated_text: Right here they cite this ancient account:

children.text: avantiviṣaye rājā viṣṇuvarmeti cābhavat ||
children.translated_text: in the region of <s>Avanti</s> there was a king named <s>Viṣṇuvarman</s>.

children.text: purā kṛtayuge so 'pi svarājyaṃ pratipālayan
children.translated_text: Long ago, in the <s>Kṛta</s> age, while he was governing his own kingdom,

children.text: dāsīrajasvalādyāś ca kāmayāmāsa durmatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: that wicked-minded man lusted after servant-women, menstruating women, and the like.

children.text: brahmahatyādipāpāni bahūni kṛtavān asau
children.translated_text: He committed many sins, beginning with brahmin-murder;

children.text: tena cākṛtapāpāni na santi dharaṇītale ||
children.translated_text: there were no sins on the surface of the earth that he had not committed.

children.text: atīva pāpasaṃdohād rājayakṣmābhavat tataḥ
children.translated_text: Then, from an excessive mass of sin, <s>rājayakṣmā</s> (consumption) arose.

children.text: na bhiṣak na ca vā bandhus trātā ko 'pi na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: No physician, nor any relative either, was found as a protector.

children.text: na mitraṃ na ca vā rājyaṃ na śaktās tan nivāritum
children.translated_text: Neither friend nor kingdom was able to ward it off.

children.text: tasminn evaṃvidhe rājñi daivayogāt kurūdvaha ||
children.translated_text: When the king was in such a state, by the working of fate, O scion of <s>Kuru</s>,

children.text: sanako nāma yogīndras tasya geham upāgamat
children.translated_text: a foremost yogin named <s>Sanaka</s> came to his house.

children.text: nṛpabhāryā puṇyaśīlā natvā yoginam āgatam ||
children.translated_text: The king's virtuous wife bowed to the yogin who had arrived

children.text: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā pāhi māṃ patidānataḥ
children.translated_text: and spoke with gentle words: "Protect me by granting me my husband."

children.text: tam āgatam abhipretya viṣṇuvarmā mahāmatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Recognizing that he had come, the wise <s>Viṣṇuvarmā</s>

children.text: pūjayāmāsa vidhivad uvāca vacanaṃ tadā
children.translated_text: worshiped him according to rule and then spoke these words:

children.text: kṛtārtho 'smi mahābhāga bhavaddarśanamātrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "I am fulfilled, O illustrious one, merely by the sight of you.

children.text: anāthaṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ vimukhaṃ puṇyakarmaṇi
children.translated_text: I am without a protector, a doer of sinful deeds, turned away from meritorious action.

children.text: durācārarataṃ kāmalolupaṃ pāhi māṃ mune ||
children.translated_text: I am devoted to bad conduct and unsteady with desire; protect me, O sage.

children.text: janmāntarārjitāt puṇyād bhavato darśanaṃ hy abhūt
children.translated_text: Surely through merit gained in another birth the sight of you has occurred.

children.text: ity uktvā virarāmātha sanakaḥ pratyuvāca tam ||
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he fell silent; then <s>Sanaka</s> answered him:

children.text: bho rājañchṛṇu vakṣyāmi tvayā yat pūrvasaṃcitam
children.translated_text: "O king, listen. I shall tell you what was accumulated by you before.

children.text: bhujyate vivaśeneha trātā nānyo 'sti kaścana ||
children.translated_text: Here it is being experienced helplessly; there is no other protector at all.

children.text: yatra vṛndāvanaṃ nāsti śālagrāmādipūjanam
children.translated_text: Where there is no <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, no worship of <s>śālagrāma</s> stones and the like,

children.text: vedaśāstrādivādo vā nāsti sajjanasaṅgamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: no discussion of the Vedas and śāstras, and no association with good people,

children.text: svācārasya parityāgaḥ paradharmaparigrahaḥ
children.translated_text: where one's own right conduct is abandoned and another's dharma is adopted,

children.text: sadā pāparatir yatra tatra syuḥ sakalā rujaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and where there is constant delight in sin, there all diseases arise.

children.text: pūrvajanmani vā pāpam iha janmani vā kṛtam
children.translated_text: Sin committed either in a previous birth or in this birth

children.text: avaśyam eva bhoktavyaṃ rājan karma śubhāśubham ||
children.translated_text: must necessarily be experienced, O king, as auspicious or inauspicious karma.

children.text: tvaṃ tu janmāntare jāto veśyāyāṃ śūdrapūruṣāt
children.translated_text: But you, in another birth, were born from a śūdra man in a courtesan.

children.text: dharmadhvaja iti khyāto lubdhakaḥ prāṇihiṃsakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Known as <s>Dharmadhvaja</s>, you were a hunter, a killer of living beings.

children.text: pāpakarmarato nityaṃ devabrahmasvahārakaḥ
children.translated_text: You were always devoted to sinful deeds, stealing the property of gods and Brahmins.

children.text: tvam ekadā māghamāse gaṅgātīram upāgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Once, in the month of <s>Māgha</s>, you came to the bank of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>.

children.text: tatra svabhartrā snānārtham āgatāṃ dvijavallabhām
children.translated_text: There you saw the beloved wife of a Brahmin, who had come with her husband for bathing.

children.text: dṛṣṭvaiva kāmasan taptas tām evālakṣayan tataḥ ||
children.translated_text: As soon as you saw her, you were tormented by desire and then kept watching only her.

children.text: vyājena yāpayan kālam avatīrṇaḥ svayaṃ jale
children.translated_text: Passing the time under a pretext, you yourself descended into the water.

children.text: snānadānādikaṃ karma cakre vipras tayā saha ||
children.translated_text: The Brahmin performed bathing, gifts, and the other rites together with her.

children.text: tat sarvaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃs tvaṃ tu madavihvalito bhṛśam
children.translated_text: You saw all of that, greatly overwhelmed by intoxicated passion.

children.text: tataḥ svabhavanaṃ yāte dvije tasmin svabhāryayā ||
children.translated_text: Then, when that Brahmin had gone to his own house with his wife,

children.text: tvam apy anugato rātrau chidraṃ kṛtvā tu tadgṛhe
children.translated_text: you too followed at night, made a breach in that house,

children.text: praviśyāntar nidritāyās tasyā aṅgaṃ parāmṛśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: entered inside, and touched the limbs of her as she slept.

children.text: hā cora iti cukrośa sā prabuddhā satī tadā
children.translated_text: Awakened then, that chaste woman cried out, 'Alas, a thief!'

children.text: militās tatra baddhvā tvāṃ ninyū rājāntikaṃ carāḥ ||
