children.translated_text: The guards gathered there, bound you, and led you before the king.

children.text: rājāpi hastapādaṃ te chedayitvā purād bahiḥ
children.translated_text: The king too had your hands and feet cut off

children.text: niryāpayāmāsa girer mūrdhni nirjanabhīkare ||
children.translated_text: and drove you out of the city to the summit of a lonely, terrifying mountain.

children.text: tena duḥkhena mahatā mṛtas tvaṃ parvatopari
children.translated_text: Through that great suffering you died on the mountaintop.

children.text: tadvāsanābalenehāpy asi pāparataḥ sadā ||
children.translated_text: By the force of that latent disposition, here too you are always devoted to sin.

children.text: māghasnānamahimnādya pārthiva tvam avāptavān
children.translated_text: Yet through the greatness of the <s>Māgha</s> bath, O lord of earth, today you have obtained

children.text: maddarśanam amoghaṃ ca viprasnānādidarśanāt ||
children.translated_text: my unfailing sight, because you saw the Brahmin's bathing and other rites.

children.text: pūrvajanmārjitāt pāpād bhuṅkṣe rogādikaṃ tv iha
children.translated_text: Because of sin accumulated in a previous birth, you suffer disease and the like here.

children.text: pāpaṃ nirayabhogāya puṇyaṃ svargasukhāya hi ||
children.translated_text: Sin indeed leads to experience in hell, while merit leads to the happiness of heaven."

children.text: rājovāca
children.translated_text: The king said:

children.text: bhagavan tapyate antar me śrutvā pūrvakathām imām
children.translated_text: "Blessed one, my heart is tormented after hearing this tale of the past

children.text: smṛtvā ca pāpacaritam iha janmani yat kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: and after remembering the sinful conduct that was done in this birth.

children.text: dhig jīvitaṃ mamaitasya dhruvaṃ narakagāminaḥ
children.translated_text: Shame on this life of mine, which is certainly bound for hell.

children.text: brahmann evaṃvidhasyāpi niṣkṛtiś ced vada prabho ||
children.translated_text: O Brahmin, if there is expiation even for one such as I am, tell it, lord."

children.text: sanaka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sanaka</s> said:

children.text: niṣkṛtiṃ sampravakṣyāmi tīvrataptasya te adhunā
children.translated_text: "I shall now declare the expiation for you, who are severely tormented,

children.text: sarvapāpaviśuddhaḥ san yena tvaṃ nīrujo bhaveḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which, purified from all sin, you may become free from disease.

children.text: paścimāmbudhitīrasthe gokarṇe kṣetrasattame
children.translated_text: On the shore of the western ocean, in the excellent sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>,

children.text: koṭitīrtham iti khyātaṃ vidyate vimalaṃ saraḥ ||
children.translated_text: there is a pure lake known as <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>.

children.text: snānena tatra pāpāni naśyanty eva na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: By bathing there, sins surely perish; there is no doubt.

children.text: bho rājan tava pāpasya yadi niṣkṛtim icchasi ||
children.translated_text: O king, if you desire expiation for your sin,

children.text: gokarṇakṣetram āsādya māghamāse 'ruṇodaye
children.translated_text: reach the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> in the month of <s>Māgha</s> at dawn,

children.text: koṭitīrthe vidhānena snātvārcaya mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: bathe according to rule in <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, and worship <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: tadā pāpaviśuddhaḥ san modase suciraṃ nṛpa
children.translated_text: Then, purified from sin, you will rejoice for a long time, O king.

children.text: purā tu vighaso nāma brāhmaṇo bhṛguvākyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Long ago, a Brahmin named <s>Vighasa</s>, following the word of <s>Bhṛgu</s>,

children.text: tatra gatvā koṭitīrthe snātvā devaṃ mahābalam
children.translated_text: went there, bathed in <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, and worshiped the god <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: abhyarcya mahataḥ pāpāt pūtaḥ śivam avāptavān ||
children.translated_text: Purified from a great sin, he attained <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: ity uktvā sanako yogī yathākāmaṃ jagāma ha
children.translated_text: Having said this, the yogin <s>Sanaka</s> went away as he wished.

children.text: tataḥ sa rājā gokarṇaṃ māghādau samapadyata ||
children.translated_text: Then that king set out for <s>Gokarṇa</s> at the beginning of <s>Māgha</s>.

children.text: prātaḥ snātvā koṭitīrthe pūjayitvā mahābalam
children.translated_text: In the morning, he bathed in <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> and worshiped <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: kṛtvā dānāni bahuśaḥ kiṃcit kālaṃ nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: After making many gifts, O best of kings, for some time

children.text: sthitvā tatrasthatīrtheṣu nimajya ca yathāvidhi
children.translated_text: he stayed at the tīrthas there and plunged into them according to rule.

children.text: tataḥ svarājyam āsādya bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān ||
children.translated_text: Then he returned to his own kingdom and enjoyed pleasures as he wished.

children.text: putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ kṛtvā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ
children.translated_text: Surrounded by sons and grandsons, he performed sacrifices and other rites.

children.text: ante vimānam āruhya patnyā saha divaṃ yayau ||
children.translated_text: At the end he mounted a heavenly vehicle and went to heaven together with his wife.

children.text: iti śrī tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus the third chapter.

children.text: Chapter 4
śataśṛṅgasya bhāgau dvau samudre patitau nṛpa
children.translated_text: Two portions of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s> fell into the ocean, O king.

children.text: durgāśṛṅgamiti khyātaṃ gokarṇasyottare 'patat ||
children.translated_text: The one known as <s>Durgāśṛṅga</s> fell to the north of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: nāgaśṛṅgamiti khyātam apatad dakṣiṇe nṛpa
children.translated_text: The one known as <s>Nāgaśṛṅga</s> fell to the south, O king.

children.text: vartante pañca tīrthāni nāgaśṛṅge mahānti ca ||
children.translated_text: On <s>Nāgaśṛṅga</s> there are five great tīrthas.

children.text: rudrakuṇḍaṃ nāgatīrthaṃ vasordhāram ataḥ param
children.translated_text: <s>Rudrakuṇḍa</s>, <s>Nāgatīrtha</s>, and thereafter <s>Vasordhāra</s>,

children.text: śaṅkhatīrthaṃ siddhakuṇḍamiti tīrthāni pañca vai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkhatīrtha</s> and <s>Siddhakuṇḍa</s>: these indeed are the five tīrthas.

children.text: tīrtheṣu teṣu yaḥ snāti so 'nantaphalam aśnute
children.translated_text: Whoever bathes in those tīrthas enjoys an endless fruit.

children.text: daśatīrthāni kauravya gaurīśṛṅge vasanti ca ||
children.translated_text: And ten <s>tīrtha</s>s (sacred fords), O <s>Kauravya</s>, are also present on <s>Gaurīśṛṅga</s>.

children.text: śatānāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ tāni mukhyāni kaurava
children.translated_text: Among the hundreds of <s>tīrtha</s>s, those are the chief ones, O <s>Kaurava</s>.

children.text: gaṅgādhāraṃ vasordhāraṃ māhiṣaṃ nāgatīrthakam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgādhāra</s>, <s>Vasordhāra</s>, <s>Māhiṣa</s>, and <s>Nāgatīrthaka</s>,

children.text: gaurīhradaṃ ca kaumāraṃ kālīhradam ataḥ param
children.translated_text: as well as <s>Gaurīhrada</s>, <s>Kaumāra</s>, and then <s>Kālīhrada</s>,

children.text: muṇḍodbhavaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca daśatīrthāni kaurava ||
children.translated_text: <s>Muṇḍodbhava</s> and <s>Vāruṇa</s>: these are the ten <s>tīrtha</s>s, O <s>Kaurava</s>.

children.text: mukhyāni tāni rājendra sahasrāṇāṃ mahānti ca
children.translated_text: They are the chief and great ones among thousands, O king of kings.

children.text: navamyāṃ teṣu yaḥ snāti sa pāpair mucyate dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: Whoever bathes in them on the ninth lunar day is certainly freed from sins.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: guhatīrthaṃ tathā liṅgaṃ kumāreśvaranāmakam
children.translated_text: Likewise, <s>Guhatīrtha</s> and the <s>liṅga</s> named <s>Kumāreśvara</s>

children.text: rudrayonyāḥ pūrvabhāge kiṃcid īśānyataḥ sthitam ||
children.translated_text: stand in the eastern part of <s>Rudrayoni</s>, a little to the northeast.

children.text: srotasām uttamā yatra tāmrācalasamudgatā
children.translated_text: There is the best of streams, arisen from <s>Tāmrācala</s>,

children.text: yāṃ copayeme bhagavān rudro gaurīvapurdharām ||
children.translated_text: whom the blessed <s>Rudra</s> married when she bore the form of <s>Gaurī</s>.

children.text: rājovāca
children.translated_text: The king said:

children.text: tāmrācale 'patat kasmād gaurīrūpaṃ dadhara sā
children.translated_text: Why did she fall on <s>Tāmrācala</s>, and why did she assume the form of <s>Gaurī</s>?

children.text: rudraḥ kathaṃ tāṃ cakame etan no vaktum arhasi ||
children.translated_text: How did <s>Rudra</s> desire her? You ought to tell us this.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā jagatpatir brahmā dhyānastho 'bhūn nṛpottama
children.translated_text: Long ago <s>Brahmā</s>, lord of the world, was absorbed in meditation, O best of kings.

children.text: baddhapadmāsano devaḥ saṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The god sat in bound lotus posture, self-controlled and with his senses conquered.

children.text: athaivaṃ dhyāyatas tasya tūttāne dakṣiṇe kare
children.translated_text: Then, as he was meditating in this way, in his upturned right hand

children.text: prādur babhūva cārvaṅgī kanyakā varavarṇinī ||
children.translated_text: there appeared a lovely-limbed maiden of excellent complexion.

children.text: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavān brahmā prītimān abhavat tadā
children.translated_text: Seeing her, the blessed <s>Brahmā</s> became pleased at that time

children.text: āha sma rudrakāntā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi varānane ||
children.translated_text: and said, "O fair-faced one, you will be the beloved of <s>Rudra</s>."

children.text: ity ukte brahmaṇā sā ca cakame rudram eva tu
children.translated_text: When <s>Brahmā</s> had spoken thus, she desired <s>Rudra</s> alone.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ tasya ca kṣetraṃ jñātvā tāmragirau tadā ||
children.translated_text: Then, knowing <s>Gokarṇa</s> to be his sacred field, she came to <s>Tāmragiri</s>;

children.text: patitākāśato gaṅgā puṇyā tripathagāminī
children.translated_text: holy <s>Gaṅgā</s>, who travels the three paths, fell from the sky,

children.text: aṃśenānyena paramaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ samāsthitā ||
children.translated_text: and with another portion she assumed a supreme, divine form.

children.text: dhyāyanty ekākinī rudraṃ girau tatra cacāra ha
children.translated_text: Meditating on <s>Rudra</s>, she wandered alone on that mountain.

children.text: tatas tatrāgato rudro vṛṣārūḍhas trilocanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Rudra</s> came there, three-eyed and mounted on the bull.

children.text: dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ śivaṃ devī bhaktyā premabhareṇa ca
children.translated_text: As soon as the goddess saw <s>Śiva</s>, with devotion and overflowing love,

children.text: vavande lajjayā caivādhomukhī maunam āsthitā ||
children.translated_text: she bowed, and from modesty she stood silent with her face lowered.

children.text: jñātvā sarvaṃ mahādevaḥ sasmāra ca pitāmaham
children.translated_text: Knowing everything, <s>Mahādeva</s> remembered the Grandfather.

children.text: brahmā devagaṇaiḥ sākam ājagāma tadāñjasā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> then came at once together with the hosts of gods.

children.text: gaurīṃ dṛṣṭvātha harṣeṇa brahmā provāca śaṅkaram
children.translated_text: Then, seeing <s>Gaurī</s>, <s>Brahmā</s> joyfully addressed <s>Śaṅkara</s>.

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: mahatā tapasā deva tvadarthe nirmitā śubhā ||
children.translated_text: O god, this auspicious woman has been fashioned for your sake through great austerity.

children.text: tvām eva varayantīyaṃ kalyāṇī jagadīśvaram
children.translated_text: This blessed woman chooses you alone, the lord of the universe.

children.text: tasmāt pāṇiṃ gṛhāṇāsyāḥ sarvalokaikamaṅgalam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore take her hand, the unique auspiciousness of all the worlds.

children.text: ity uktvā vidhivat tatra dadau gaṅgāṃ pinākine
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he duly gave <s>Gaṅgā</s> there to <s>Pinākin</s>.

children.text: āśvine kṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of <s>Āśvina</s>, O best of kings,

children.text: dadau muhūrte kalyāṇe svātyṛkṣe candravāsare
children.translated_text: he gave her at an auspicious moment, under the asterism <s>Svāti</s>, on the day of the Moon.

children.text: tato brahmā svabhavanaṃ sadevarṣigaṇo yayau ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Brahmā</s>, with the hosts of gods and sages, went to his own abode.

children.text: tadā prabhṛti rājan sa girir vaivāhiko 'bhavat
children.translated_text: From that time onward, O king, that mountain became <s>Vaivāhika</s>, "connected with marriage,"

children.text: vivāhas trijagatpitror yatas tatra girāv abhūt ||
children.translated_text: because the marriage of the parents of the three worlds took place there on the mountain.

children.text: tāmrācalasya sambandhāt tāmragaurīti sābhavat
children.translated_text: Because of her connection with <s>Tāmrācala</s>, she became known as <s>Tāmragaurī</s>.

children.text: evaṃ sā tāmragaurī tu dvidhā lakṣyā nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: Thus that <s>Tāmragaurī</s> is perceived in two forms, O best of kings.

children.text: ekena divyarūpeṇa tāmragaurīti saṃstutā
children.translated_text: In one divine form she is praised as <s>Tāmragaurī</s>;

children.text: mahābalasya nikaṭe devī prāṅmukhataḥ sthitā ||
children.translated_text: the goddess stands facing east near <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: divyarūpadharāṃ devīṃ ye 'rcayantīha bhaktitaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who worship here with devotion the goddess who bears a divine form,

children.text: teṣām abhīpsitaṃ devī dadāty eva na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to them the goddess indeed gives what they desire; there is no doubt.

children.text: nadīrūpeṇa cānyena sarvapāpāpanodinī
children.translated_text: And in another form, as a river, she drives away all sins.

children.text: nirgamya tāmrācalato bahutīrthasamanvitā ||
children.translated_text: Emerging from <s>Tāmrācala</s> and furnished with many <s>tīrtha</s>s,

children.text: vahantī dakṣiṇām āśāṃ krośārdhaṃ sā supāvanī
children.translated_text: that most purifying one flows southward for half a krośa,

children.text: āvṛtya cottare kiṃcid rudrayoniṃ gatā tataḥ ||
children.translated_text: then turns somewhat to the north and reaches <s>Rudrayoni</s>.

children.text: pitṛsthālīsamīpe tu saṅgatā saritāṃ patim
children.translated_text: Near <s>Pitṛsthālī</s> she joins the lord of rivers.

children.text: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pātālanilayāni ca ||
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>tīrtha</s>s are on earth, and those that dwell in <s>Pātāla</s>,

children.text: tāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni tāmragauryāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: all those <s>tīrtha</s>s are in <s>Tāmragaurī</s>; there is no doubt.

children.text: tasmāt tīrthavarā sā tu nadīnām uttamottamā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore she is the best of <s>tīrtha</s>s and the very highest among rivers.

children.text: piṇḍaṃ tilodakaṃ caiva snānaṃ tatra karoti yaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever performs the <s>piṇḍa</s> offering, the sesame-water offering, and bathing there,

children.text: pitaras tasya puṇyena narakasthā api dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: by his merit his ancestors, even if they are in hell, certainly

children.text: tṛptāḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyanti pūrṇimāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ
children.translated_text: will be satisfied and go to heaven, especially on the full-moon day.

children.text: paśupakṣimṛgāś cāpi tajjalasparśamātrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even domestic animals, birds, and wild beasts, merely by contact with her water,

children.text: sarvapāpavinirmuktās te'pi yānty uttamāṃ gatim
children.translated_text: are freed from all sins and also go to the highest state.

children.text: atraikāṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathām āścaryakārakām ||
children.translated_text: Here I shall tell a single story that produces wonder.

children.text: kadācit tāmragaṅgāyās taṭe kaścit kapīśvaraḥ
children.translated_text: Once, on the bank of <s>Tāmragaṅgā</s>, a certain lordly monkey

children.text: utplavan phalalobhena pramādād apatad drumāt ||
children.translated_text: leapt out of desire for fruit and, through carelessness, fell from a tree.

children.text: śilātale 'timahati tena mūrchām avāpa saḥ
children.translated_text: Striking a very great surface of rock, he became unconscious.

children.text: kṣaṇena labdhasaṃjñas tu svayam āśvasya kṛcchrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: After a moment he recovered consciousness and, with difficulty, steadied himself.

children.text: tāmragaṅgātalabhavaṃ śanair āruhya sa drumam
children.translated_text: Slowly climbing the tree that grew by the bed of <s>Tāmragaṅgā</s>,

children.text: śākhāntare niviṣṭas tu vedanām asahan mṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he settled on another branch, but died, unable to bear the pain.

children.text: tataḥ katipayāhaḥsu viklinnāt tu kalevarāt
children.translated_text: Then, after some days, from his decomposed body

children.text: śirobhāgo 'patat tasya tāmragaṅgājale 'male ||
children.translated_text: the portion of his head fell into the pure water of <s>Tāmragaṅgā</s>.

children.text: tenaiva puṇyayogena vānaraḥ sa nṛpottama
children.translated_text: By that very conjunction with merit, that monkey, O best of kings,

children.text: saṃbabhūva mahiṣyāṃ tu citrarūpākhyabhūpateḥ ||
children.translated_text: was born from the chief queen of the king named <s>Citrarūpa</s>.

children.text: mukhamātram abhūt tasya kamanīyaṃ narākṛti
children.translated_text: Only his face was lovely and human in form;

children.text: śeṣaṃ sarvāṅgam api tu vānarākāram adbhutam ||
children.translated_text: the rest of all his limbs, however, had the marvelous form of a monkey.

children.text: vicitram idam ālokya rājā cintākulo 'bhavat
children.translated_text: Seeing this strange thing, the king became filled with anxious thought.

children.text: dineṣu gacchatsu tataḥ kumāraḥ sa vyavardhata ||
children.translated_text: Then, as the days passed, that prince grew up.

children.text: kāraṇaṃ cātra rājarṣiś cintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ
children.translated_text: Distressed, the royal sage pondered the cause of this.

children.text: na mayā vañcitaḥ kaścid vidhātrāhaṃ tu vañcitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "No one has been deceived by me, but I have been deceived by the Creator.

children.text: īdṛśas tanayo jātaḥ ko vā bhāgyaviparyayaḥ
children.translated_text: Such a son has been born; what reversal of fortune can this be?"

children.text: atrāpṛcchad brāhmaṇāṃs tu na śekus te samīritum ||
children.translated_text: There he asked the Brahmins, but they were not able to explain it.

children.text: etasminn antare tatra kaścit siddhavaro 'bhyagāt
children.translated_text: Meanwhile, a certain eminent <s>siddha</s> (perfected being) arrived there.

children.text: tam arcayitvā rājā tu putravṛttaṃ vyajijñapat ||
children.translated_text: After honoring him, the king inquired about the matter of his son.

children.text: jñātvātha kāraṇaṃ siddhaḥ so 'bravīj jñānacakṣuṣā
children.translated_text: Then the <s>siddha</s>, knowing the cause with the eye of knowledge, said:

children.text: siddha uvāca
children.translated_text: The <s>siddha</s> said:

children.text: eṣa te tanayaḥ pūrvajanmany āsīt tu vānaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: This son of yours, in a former birth, was a monkey.

children.text: kadācit plavamānas tu prāpto gokarṇam uttamam
children.translated_text: Once, leaping about, he reached the excellent <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tatrāsti tāmragaurīti nadī puṇyā suviśrutā ||
children.translated_text: There is there a holy and very famous river called <s>Tāmragaurī</s>.

children.text: labhante yajjalasparśāt tiryañco 'py uttamāṃ gatim
children.translated_text: By contact with its water, even animals obtain the highest state.

children.text: tatra tīradrume daivād utplavan plavagottamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There, by fate, the best of leapers jumped onto a tree at the <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford),

children.text: mṛtas tadvṛkṣaśākhāyāṃ lagnaṃ tasya kalevaram
children.translated_text: and died; his body became caught on a branch of that tree.

children.text: śiraḥ kālena viklinnaṃ tāmragaṅgājale 'patat ||
children.translated_text: In time his head, decomposed and loosened, fell into the water of <s>Tāmragaṅgā</s>.

children.text: tatpuṇyajalasaṃsparśān mukham asya narākṛti
children.translated_text: Through contact with that holy water, his face took on a human form,

children.text: śeṣāṅgaṃ vānarākāraṃ yathāpūrvam abhūn nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: while the rest of his body remained monkey-shaped as before, O king.

children.text: tāmragaṅgāmahimnāsau vānaro 'pi nareśvara
children.translated_text: By the greatness of <s>Tāmragaṅgā</s>, even that monkey, O lord of men,

children.text: putraḥ sann adya te jāto mahiṣyāṃ bhāgyaśālinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: has now been born as your son from the queen, O fortunate one.

children.text: rājann adyāpi tac cheṣam aṅgaṃ tad vṛkṣagaṃ kapeḥ
children.translated_text: O king, even now the remaining body of that monkey is in that tree.

children.text: pātayet tāmranadyāṃ tu nṛdehaḥ syād ayaṃ tadā ||
children.translated_text: Cause it to fall into the <s>Tāmrā</s> river; then this one will have a human body.

children.text: iti siddhavacaḥ śrutvā rājā saṃpreṣya kiṅkarān
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of the <s>siddha</s>, the king sent his servants

children.text: tathaiva vṛkṣasaṃsthaṃ tat kaper aṅgam apātayat ||
children.translated_text: and caused that body of the monkey, situated in the tree, to be dropped in just that way.

children.text: sadyaḥ sa rājaputro'bhūd divyamānavadehavān
children.translated_text: At once the prince came to possess a divine human body,

children.text: rājalakṣmīnivāsaśca babhau sūrya ivāparaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and, as an abode of royal fortune, he shone like another sun.

children.text: tataḥ sarve 'pi jahṛṣuḥ siddhaś cāgād yathāgatam
children.translated_text: Then all rejoiced, and the <s>siddha</s> went away as he had come.

children.text: evaṃ tasyās tāmragauryā māhātmyaṃ paramādbhutam ||
children.translated_text: Thus the greatness of that <s>Tāmragaurī</s> is supremely wonderful,

children.text: śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ cāpi pāpaghnaṃ ca samṛddhidam
children.translated_text: destroying sin and granting prosperity to those who hear and recite it.

children.text: asthinikṣepaṇaṃ cātra pitṝṇāṃ svargakāraṇam ||
children.translated_text: And the depositing of bones here is a cause of heaven for the ancestors.

children.text: yāvad asthikaṇaṃ tiṣṭhet tāmragauryāḥ śubhe jale
children.translated_text: As long as a particle of bone remains in the auspicious water of <s>Tāmragaurī</s>,

children.text: tāvat te svarmahīyante divyabhogopabhoginaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for that long they are honored in heaven, enjoying divine pleasures.

children.text: atrārthe kathayiṣye 'ham itihāsaṃ purātanam
children.translated_text: On this point I shall tell an ancient tale.

children.text: unmūcir nāma rājāsīt purā prācetasāntare ||
children.translated_text: Long ago, in the interval of <s>Prācetasa</s>, there was a king named <s>Unmūci</s>.

children.text: sa sarvaṃ rājyam akarot prajānāṃ drohakṛtkhalaḥ
children.translated_text: That wicked man, doing harm to his subjects, ruled the whole kingdom.

children.text: tena pāpena mahatā prajā hy āsann upadrutāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Because of that great sin, the subjects were afflicted.

children.text: camaso nāma tatputro dharmātmā śaṃsitavrataḥ
children.translated_text: His son, named <s>Camasa</s>, was righteous-souled and praised for his vows.

children.text: pitary uparate so 'pi kiṃcic chokasamākulaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When his father had died, he too was somewhat overcome with grief.

children.text: saṃskāraṃ tu pituḥ kartuṃ vanaṃ prāyāc ca sartvijaḥ
children.translated_text: In order to perform his father's funeral rite, he went to the forest with officiating priests.

children.text: tatrāntarikṣe śuśrāva pitṝṇāṃ bhāratīṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: There, in the sky, O king, he heard the speech of the ancestors:

children.text: pitrā tava mahābhāga nṛśaṃsena durātmanā
children.translated_text: Because of your father, O greatly fortunate one, who was cruel and evil-minded,

children.text: prāptāḥ smo narakaṃ sarve mahārauravasaṃjñakam ||
children.translated_text: we have all reached the hell called <s>Mahāraurava</s>.

children.text: tasmād asmān uddidhīrṣuḥ paitṛkaṃ cāsthisañcayam
children.translated_text: Therefore, wishing to rescue us, take up the ancestral collection of bones

children.text: gṛhītvā yāhi gokarṇaṃ mahābalaniketanam ||
children.translated_text: and go to <s>Gokarṇa</s>, the dwelling-place of <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: tatrāste tāmragaurīti ghorapāpaharā śubhā
children.translated_text: There is the auspicious one called <s>Tāmragaurī</s>, remover of terrible sins.

children.text: tatra gatvā tu saṃskāraṃ pituḥ kuru vidhānataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having gone there, perform your father's rite according to rule.

children.text: asthinikṣepaṇaṃ tatra tāmragauryāṃ kuruṣva bhoḥ
children.translated_text: Deposit the bones there in <s>Tāmragaurī</s>, sir.

children.text: iti śrutvā tu camasaḥ pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ tadā ||
children.translated_text: Having then heard the words of the ancestors, <s>Camasa</s>

children.text: tūrṇaṃ praviśya gokarṇaṃ tāmragauryāṃ nṛpottamaḥ
children.translated_text: quickly entered <s>Gokarṇa</s>; in <s>Tāmragaurī</s>, that best of kings

children.text: asthinikṣepaṇaṃ cakre pitṝṇāṃ svargakāmyayā ||
children.translated_text: performed the depositing of bones, desiring heaven for the ancestors.

children.text: tena pāpavinirmukta unmūcis tatpitā tadā
children.translated_text: By that, his father <s>Unmūci</s> was then freed from sin,

children.text: pitṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ svargaṃ yātaḥ kurūttama ||
children.translated_text: and, together with all the ancestors, went to heaven, O best of the Kurus.

children.text: yāvad asthīni jantūnāṃ tāmragauryāṃ vasanti hi
children.translated_text: Indeed, as long as the bones of living beings remain in <s>Tāmragaurī</s>,

children.text: tāvat svarge mahīyante divyabhogaiḥ samanvitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: for that long they are honored in heaven, endowed with divine pleasures.

children.text: iti śrīskānde śrīgokarṇamāhātmye caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the fourth chapter in the sacred <s>Gokarṇamāhātmya</s> of the sacred <s>Skanda</s>.

children.text: Chapter 5
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: saṅgame tāmragaṅgāyāḥ samudrasya ca sattama
children.translated_text: At the confluence of <s>Tāmragaṅgā</s> and the ocean, O best one,

children.text: vidhūtapāpasthālīti sthānaṃ trailokya viśrutam ||
children.translated_text: there is a place famous in the three worlds called <s>Vidhūtapāpasthālī</s>.

children.text: tasyādhastād gavāṃ mātā vartate sāmṛtasravā
children.translated_text: Beneath that abides the mother of cows, flowing with nectar,

children.text: brahmaṇo mānasāttāta jātā pūrvam aninditā ||
children.translated_text: the blameless one formerly born from the mind of <s>Brahmā</s>, O dear one.

children.text: yasyāḥ kṣīrād abhūt kṣīravārdhis tasmād abhūt sudhā
children.translated_text: From her milk came the ocean of milk, and from that came nectar.

children.text: divyaṃ liṅgaṃ tato jātaṃ tad agṛhṇan divaukasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then a divine <s>liṅga</s> (emblem of Śiva) arose, and the gods took it.

children.text: brahmāṇaṃ sā tadovāca sthānaṃ me saṃpradarśyatām
children.translated_text: Then she said to <s>Brahmā</s>, "Let a place be shown to me."

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: ayi putri mahādevaḥ pātāle tapasi sthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Dear daughter, <s>Mahādeva</s> is in <s>Pātāla</s>, established in ascetic practice.

children.text: taṃ prārthayasi cet sthānaṃ sa dadāti tavānaghe
children.translated_text: If you ask him for a place, he will give one to you, O blameless one.

children.text: ity uktā sā tadā devī pātālaṃ surabhir yayau ||
children.translated_text: Thus addressed, the goddess <s>Surabhī</s> then went to <s>Pātāla</s>.

children.text: tatra sarvātmakaṃ dhenur dadarśa parameśvaram
children.translated_text: There the cow saw <s>Parameśvara</s>, the Self of all.

children.text: dṛṣṭvātha śaṅkaro dhenuṃ praṇatām agrataḥ sthitām ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śaṅkara</s>, seeing the cow bowing and standing before him,

children.text: kim icchasi varārohe tad dadāmīty uvāca tām
children.translated_text: said to her, "What do you desire, fair-hipped one? I shall give it."

children.text: dhenur uvāca
children.translated_text: The cow said:

children.text: sṛṣṭā ca brahmaṇāhaṃ tam ayācaṃ sthānakāṅkṣiṇī ||
children.translated_text: I was created by <s>Brahmā</s>, and, desiring a place, I asked him.

children.text: sa ca tvāṃ darśayāmāsa tad ahaṃ tvām upasthitā
children.translated_text: He directed me to you; therefore I have approached you.

children.text: sthānaṃ kutrāpi deveśa darśayān uttamaṃ mama ||
children.translated_text: Show me, O lord of gods, some excellent place for me.

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: asyopari mama kṣetraṃ gokarṇaṃ surapūjitam
children.translated_text: Above this is my sacred field, <s>Gokarṇa</s>, worshiped by the gods.

children.text: vartate tatra bhadre tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vastum arhasi ||
children.translated_text: There, auspicious one, you may dwell as you wish.

children.text: sā tatheti praṇamyeśaṃ gokarṇaṃ samupāgatā
children.translated_text: Saying, "So be it," she bowed to the Lord and came to <s>Gokarṇa</s>,

children.text: saṅgame tāmragaṅgāyāḥ samudrasya ca sattama ||
children.translated_text: to the confluence of <s>Tāmragaṅgā</s> and the ocean, O best one.

children.text: pāpasthālyāṃ mahābhāgā sthitvā samacarat tapaḥ
children.translated_text: Staying at <s>Pāpasthālī</s>, the greatly fortunate one practiced austerity.

children.text: deveṣu tat sthitaṃ liṅgam amṛtotthaṃ purātanam ||
children.translated_text: Taking that ancient <s>liṅga</s>, arisen from nectar and kept among the gods,

children.text: samādāya pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayantī samāsthitā
children.translated_text: she installed it and remained there worshiping it.

children.text: tataḥ prasannau viṣṇvīśau tasyāḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gatau ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Īśa</s>, pleased, became manifest before her.

children.text: tau dṛṣṭvātha jagannāthau vavande surabhir nṛpa
children.translated_text: Seeing those two lords of the world, <s>Surabhi</s> bowed down, O king.

children.text: tau ca tām ūcatur bhadre vṛṇīṣva varam īpsitam ||
children.translated_text: And the two said to her, "Blessed lady, choose the boon you desire."

children.text: dhenur uvāca
children.translated_text: The cow said:

children.text: svadehotthasya payaso devarṣipitṛyogyatām ||
children.translated_text: "May the milk arising from my own body be fit for gods, seers, and ancestors;

children.text: etalliṅgārcakānāṃ tu mahatīṃ śriyam eva ca
children.translated_text: and may great prosperity also belong to the worshipers of this <s>liṅga</s>;

children.text: yuvayor atra sānnidhyaṃ yāce 'haṃ jagadīśvarau ||
children.translated_text: I ask for your presence here, O two lords of the world."

children.text: hariharāv ūcatuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Hari</s> and <s>Hara</s> said:

children.text: tathāstu bhadre te abhīṣṭaṃ nau prasādād varānane
children.translated_text: "So be it, blessed one; your wish is granted by our favor, fair-faced lady.

children.text: sthānaṃ caitan mahāliṅgaṃ trailokyatilakaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: This place, this great <s>liṅga</s>, shall become the ornament of the three worlds.

children.text: pitṛsthālīti nāmnaitat sthānaṃ bhavatu viśrutam
children.translated_text: Let this place be renowned by the name <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>.

children.text: atra dattaṃ hutaṃ vāpi japtaṃ taptaṃ ca nandini ||
children.translated_text: Whatever is given here, or offered in fire, recited, or practiced as austerity, O <s>Nandinī</s>,

children.text: akṣayyaṃ tad bhaved bhadre nau prasādād asaṃśayam
children.translated_text: that shall become imperishable, blessed one, by our favor, without doubt."

children.text: tām ity uktvātmanas tatra sānnidhyaṃ cakratuś ca tau ||
children.translated_text: Having spoken to her in this way, the two established their own presence there.

children.text: surabhis tu tataḥ siddhakāmovāsa yathāsukham
children.translated_text: Then <s>Surabhi</s>, her desire fulfilled, dwelt there as she pleased.

children.text: gobilaṃ nāma tatrāste samudre varuṇālaye ||
children.translated_text: There in the ocean, the abode of <s>Varuṇa</s>, there is a cavern called <s>Gobila</s>.

children.text: bilāt tasmād viniṣkramya sā gacchati divāniśam
children.translated_text: Emerging from that cavern, she goes by day and by night.

children.text: divā madhyandine rātrau madhyarātre samaiti sā ||
children.translated_text: By day at midday and by night at midnight she comes there.

children.text: tasyās tv ahorātram etan nṛṇāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa
children.translated_text: This day and night of hers is a year for human beings, O king.

children.text: madhyaṃdinaṃ ca viṣuvattulā caivārdharātrakam ||
children.translated_text: Midday, the equinoctial time, <s>Tulā</s>, and midnight are the times.

children.text: tasmin kāle nṛpaśreṣṭha pitṛsthālyāṃ samāhitaḥ
children.translated_text: At that time, O best of kings, one should be composed at <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>;

children.text: devān pitṝn samuddiśya brāhmaṇebhyo dhanādikam ||
children.translated_text: with gods and ancestors in view, wealth and other gifts

children.text: dātavyam atra vidhivat kāmakrodhādikaṃ tyajet
children.translated_text: should be given here to Brahmins according to rule; one should abandon desire, anger, and the rest.

children.text: sā dhenuḥ kāmadhugbhūtvā dātāram upatiṣṭhate ||
children.translated_text: That cow, having become <s>Kāmadhuk</s>, attends upon the giver.

children.text: dhenoḥ śvāsānilasparśāt pāpāny apahatāni vai
children.translated_text: From contact with the wind of the cow's breath, sins are indeed struck away;

children.text: dūraṃ gacchanti rājendra pravātāc chuṣkaparṇavat ||
children.translated_text: they go far off, O king of kings, like dry leaves before a strong wind.

children.text: vidhūtapāpāḥ pāpiṣṭhās tatragāsyuḥ punaḥ punaḥ
children.translated_text: Even the most sinful, their sins shaken off, would go there again and again.

children.text: ato vidhūtapāpā sā sthālī tu nṛpasattama ||
children.translated_text: Therefore that basin is called "the one whose sins are shaken off," O best of kings;

children.text: vidhūtapāpasthālīti tasmāt tat sthānam īryate
children.translated_text: therefore that place is called <s>Vidhūtapāpasthālī</s>.

children.text: pitṛsthālīti yat tasyāparaṃ nāma suviśrutam ||
children.translated_text: As for its other well-known name, <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>,

children.text: tatkāraṇaṃ śṛṇuṣvātha rājan puṇyavivardhanam
children.translated_text: now hear the reason for that, O king, which increases merit.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: brahmā jagatpatiḥ pūrvaṃ sandhyārūpī babhūva ha ||
children.translated_text: Long ago <s>Brahmā</s>, lord of the world, took the form of <s>Sandhyā</s>.

children.text: tena rūpeṇa sa pitṝn sṛṣṭavān abjasaṃbhavaḥ
children.translated_text: In that form the lotus-born one created the ancestors.

children.text: sā sandhyā saha putrais tu tapas taptum upākramat ||
children.translated_text: That <s>Sandhyā</s>, together with her sons, began to practice austerity

children.text: vidhūtapāpasthālyāṃ sā liṅgaṃ tad amṛtodbhavam
children.translated_text: in <s>Vidhūtapāpasthālī</s>, worshiping that <s>liṅga</s> born of nectar,

children.text: arcayantī svatanujair aryamādibhir anvitā ||
children.translated_text: accompanied by her own sons, <s>Aryaman</s> and the others.

children.text: tasyās tapaḥprabhāveṇa tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ
children.translated_text: By the power of her austerity, the supreme lord was pleased.

children.text: siddhir bhavatu te bhadre saputrāyās tvad īpsitā ||
children.translated_text: "Blessed one, may the success desired by you and your sons be yours.

children.text: sthānam etan mahābhāge sarvapāpaharaṃ bhavet
children.translated_text: Greatly fortunate lady, this place shall remove all sins.

children.text: pitṛsthālīti vikhyātam adyaprabhṛti śobhane ||
children.translated_text: From today onward, fair one, it will be celebrated as <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>.

children.text: pitṝṇāṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ matprasādād bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: By my favor it will become the supreme sacred field of the ancestors.

children.text: atra dattaṃ hutaṃ cāpi pitṝn uddiśya bhaktitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever is given here, and whatever is offered in fire with devotion for the ancestors,

children.text: akṣayyaṃ tad bhaved bhadre matprasādād asaṃśayam
children.translated_text: that shall become imperishable, blessed one, by my favor, without doubt.

children.text: māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyām amāyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Especially on the fourteenth day of the dark half of <s>Māgha</s>, or on the new-moon day,

children.text: piṇḍaṃ tilodakaṃ cātra śraddhayā yaḥ prayacchati
children.translated_text: whoever offers a <s>piṇḍa</s> and sesame-water here with faith,

children.text: tasya vai pitaraḥ sarve pūtā nirvāṇam āpnuyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: all his ancestors will indeed be purified and attain <s>nirvāṇa</s>.

children.text: ye piśācatvam āyānti loke svakṛtakarmaṇā
children.translated_text: Those who become <s>piśācas</s> in the world through their own actions,

children.text: teṣām api vidhānena śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: if a son performs <s>śrāddha</s> for them according to rule,

children.text: tena puṇyena khalu tatpitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ
children.translated_text: by that merit, indeed, those ancestors of his, together with their forefathers,

children.text: piśācatvavinirmuktā gatiṃ gacchanti śāśvatīm ||
children.translated_text: freed from the state of <s>piśācas</s>, go to the eternal goal."

children.text: iti datvā varaṃ śambhus tasmiṃlliṅge tirodadhe
children.translated_text: Having granted this boon, <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared into that <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: pitaraḥ pitṛlokasthā vadanty āśāparāyaṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The ancestors dwelling in <s>Pitṛloka</s> speak, intent upon hope:

children.text: asmākam anvaye kaścit kadā khalu gamiṣyati
children.translated_text: "When indeed will someone in our lineage go,

children.text: pitṛsthālīṃ gayāṃ vāpi gatvā puṇyarucir naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: a merit-loving man, having gone to <s>Pitṛsthālī</s> or to <s>Gayā</s>,

children.text: piṇḍaṃ tilodakaṃ tatra yaś cāsmākaṃ prayacchati
children.translated_text: and there offer a <s>piṇḍa</s> and sesame-water for us?

children.text: yenaivaṃ tarpitāḥ sarve muktiṃ vindema śāśvatīm ||
children.translated_text: By that, all of us, being thus satisfied, might obtain eternal liberation."

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: evaṃ pitṝṇāṃ rājendra yas tv āśāṃ pūrayiṣyati
children.translated_text: Thus, O king of kings, whoever fulfills the hope of the ancestors

children.text: so 'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam ||
children.translated_text: also goes to the supreme place, free from return.

children.text: evaṃ pitṝṇāṃ rājendra yas tv āśāṃ pūrayed iha
children.translated_text: Thus, O king of kings, whoever here fulfills the hope of the ancestors,

children.text: sa kulīnaḥ sa codāraḥ sa vaṃśoddhārakaḥ pumān ||
children.translated_text: he is well-born, he is generous, he is the man who rescues his lineage.

children.text: yady ekavatsaraṃ daivāt sandhyā luptā bhavet tadā
children.translated_text: If, by chance, the twilight rite has lapsed for one year,

children.text: pitṛsthālyāṃ sakṛtkṛtvā tat sandhyā phalam aśnute ||
children.translated_text: by performing it once at <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>, he obtains the fruit of that twilight rite.

children.text: ekaṃ vā bhojayed vipraṃ tatrastho yaḥ samantrakam
children.translated_text: Whoever, staying there, feeds even one Brahmin with the proper mantras,

children.text: tena tatpitaraḥ sarve tṛptim eṣyanti śāśvatīm ||
children.translated_text: by that all his ancestors will obtain eternal satisfaction.

children.text: tatrastho rudragāyatrīṃ yo japed vidhipūrvakam
children.translated_text: Whoever, staying there, recites the <s>Rudragāyatrī</s> according to rule,

children.text: caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ tūṣṇīṃ dīkṣāsamanvitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: twenty-four thousand times, silently and endowed with initiation,

children.text: ājanma sambhṛtaṃ pāpaṃ jānatā 'jānatāpi vā
children.translated_text: the sin accumulated from birth, whether knowingly or unknowingly,

children.text: tan naśyati na sandehaḥ prāpnuyāc ca paraṃ padam ||
children.translated_text: is destroyed; there is no doubt, and he attains the supreme state.

children.text: yaḥ sakṛtsaṅgato veśyāṃ kāmato 'kāmato 'pi vā
children.translated_text: Whoever has had intercourse even once with a prostitute, whether from desire or without desire,

children.text: sa tatra rudragāyatrīṃ japan māsena śuddhyati ||
children.translated_text: by reciting the <s>Rudragāyatrī</s> there becomes purified in a month.

children.text: brahmahā gurutalpī vā surāpī paradāragaḥ
children.translated_text: A killer of a Brahmin, a violator of the guru's bed, a drinker of liquor, or one who goes to another's wife,

children.text: tatraiva rudragāyatrīṃ japtvābdena viśuddhyati ||
children.translated_text: having recited the <s>Rudragāyatrī</s> right there, becomes purified in a year.

children.text: yāvantaś ca tilā martyair gṛhītāḥ pitṛkarmaṇi
children.translated_text: As many sesame seeds as are taken by mortals in the ancestral rite,

children.text: tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi pitaraḥ svargavāsinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for that many thousands of years the ancestors dwell in heaven.

children.text: sadā devāś ca pitaraḥ pitṛsthālyāṃ vasanti hi
children.translated_text: Gods and ancestors always dwell at <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>.

children.text: nātas tatrāsti yat teṣām āvāhanavisarjanam ||
children.translated_text: For that reason, there is no summoning or dismissal of them there.

children.text: pitṛsthālīṃ samāsādya yaḥ pitṝn uddhariṣyati
children.translated_text: Whoever reaches <s>Pitṛsthālī</s> and raises up his ancestors,

children.text: sa kulīnaḥ sa codāraḥ sa budhaḥ sa ca buddhimān ||
children.translated_text: he is noble-born, he is generous, he is wise, and he is intelligent.

children.text: atrārthe kathayiṣye 'ham itihāsaṃ purātanam
children.translated_text: On this matter I shall tell an ancient tale.

children.text: candrikānagare pūrvam āste vaiśyaḥ sabāndhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Formerly, in the city of <s>Candrikā</s>, there lived a Vaiśya with his relatives.

children.text: dharmagupta iti khyāto dhanāḍhyaḥ kṛpaṇaś ca saḥ
children.translated_text: Known as <s>Dharmagupta</s>, he was wealthy and miserly.

children.text: putradārasamāyukto na dharmaṃ kṛtavān asau ||
children.translated_text: Though joined with sons and wife, he performed no <s>dharma</s> (religious duty).

children.text: pitror mṛtadine cāpi vai dhṛtyādidineṣu vā
children.translated_text: On the death-days of his parents, and on days such as <s>Dhṛti</s>,

children.text: ardhodayādiyogeṣu manvādiṣu yugādiṣu ||
children.translated_text: at <s>Ardhodaya</s> and other conjunctions, and on days beginning with <s>Manvādi</s> and <s>Yugādi</s>,

children.text: na dattaṃ kāñcanaṃ kiṃcid vastradhānyādikaṃ tu vā
children.translated_text: he gave nothing at all, neither gold nor cloth, grain, and the like.

children.text: dravyalobhena mahatā na vyayaṃ kṛtavān asau ||
children.translated_text: Out of great greed for wealth, he made no expenditure.

children.text: āgatyātithayaḥ kāle nirāśā bhojanecchayā
children.translated_text: Guests who arrived at the proper time, disappointed in their desire for food,

children.text: śapanti taṃ divārātraṃ piśāco 'yaṃ bhavatv iti ||
children.translated_text: cursed him day and night, saying, "May this man become a <s>piśāca</s> (ghoul)."

children.text: evaṃ bahutithe kāle gṛhaṃ dagdhaṃ hutāśanāt
children.translated_text: When much time had passed in this way, his house was burned by fire.

children.text: vyādhitaḥ putradārādyāḥ sarve pañcatvam āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: His sons, wife, and the rest became diseased, and all died.

children.text: kuṣṭhavyādhiyutaḥ so 'pi coraiḥ sarvam apāhṛtam
children.translated_text: He too was afflicted with leprosy, and everything he had was stolen by thieves.

children.text: tato 'tiduḥkhād babhrāma kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ paripīḍitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, in extreme misery, he wandered about, tormented by hunger and thirst.

children.text: kadācid vipine ghore vṛkṣamūlam upāśritaḥ
children.translated_text: Once, in a dreadful forest, he took shelter at the foot of a tree.

children.text: rātrau tatra mahāvyāghro bhakṣayāmāsa taṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: There at night a great tiger devoured him, O king.

children.text: tena doṣeṇa mahatā piśācatvam avāpya saḥ
children.translated_text: Through that great fault, he became a <s>piśāca</s> (ghoul),

children.text: sa hy āraṇye mahāghore vijane hy avasan nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: and he lived in a very terrible, deserted forest, O king.

children.text: tatra sthitān bhūtasaṅghān bhakṣayāmāsa nityaśaḥ
children.translated_text: There he constantly devoured the hosts of spirits that stayed there.

children.text: kadācit paryaṭan tīrthān kutsas tatrāgato hy abhūt ||
children.translated_text: Once, while roaming among <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred places), <s>Kutsa</s> came there.

children.text: dharmaguptas tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā jighāṃsur bhakṣaṇecchayā
children.translated_text: Seeing him, <s>Dharmagupta</s> wished to kill him out of desire to eat him.

children.text: jagṛhe balavaddorbhyāṃ kutsam abhyarṇam āgatam ||
children.translated_text: With powerful arms he seized <s>Kutsa</s>, who had come near.

children.text: atha kutsasparśamātrān naṣṭapāpo 'bhavad vaṇik
children.translated_text: Then, by the mere touch of <s>Kutsa</s>, the merchant became free of sin.

children.text: prāptapūrvasmṛtiś cāpi tyaktvā taṃ viprapuṃgavam ||
children.translated_text: Regaining memory of his former life, he released that foremost Brahmin.

children.text: nanāma daṇḍavad bhūmau trāhi trāhīti ca bruvan
children.translated_text: He bowed on the ground like a staff, saying, "Protect me, protect me!"

children.text: kṛpaṇaṃ pāpinaṃ krūraṃ paiśācaṃ yonim āgatam ||
children.translated_text: "I am a wretched, sinful, cruel one who has entered a <s>piśāca</s> (ghoul) womb."

children.text: ity āścaryakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kutsaḥ prāha piśācinam
children.translated_text: Seeing this astonishing thing, <s>Kutsa</s> said to the <s>piśāca</s> (ghoul):

children.text: brūhi kas tvaṃ ghorarūpī kim arthaṃ ceha tiṣṭhasi ||
children.translated_text: "Tell me, who are you, terrible in form, and why are you staying here?"

children.text: kiṃ kṛtaṃ tādṛśaṃ pāpaṃ yenaivaṃ durgatiṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: "What such sin did you commit, by which you have come to this bad condition?"

children.text: dharmagupta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Dharmagupta</s> said:

children.text: ahaṃ vaiśyo dharmaguptaḥ pāpāl lobhasya mūlataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "I am the Vaiśya <s>Dharmagupta</s>; because of sin rooted in greed,

children.text: paiśācīṃ yonim āpannas taduddhara kṛpānidhe
children.translated_text: I have fallen into a <s>piśāca</s> (ghoul) birth. Therefore lift me up, treasure of compassion.

children.text: bhavataḥ sparśamātrān me jātā janmāntarasmṛtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: By your mere touch, memory of another birth has arisen in me.

children.text: ato māṃ dayayā brahman trāhi te śaraṇāgatam
children.translated_text: Therefore, out of compassion, O Brahmin, save me, who have come to you for refuge."

children.text: kutsa uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Kutsa</s> said:

children.text: mā bhaiṣīr dharmagupta tvām uddhariṣyāmy ahaṃ dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: "Do not fear, <s>Dharmagupta</s>; I shall certainly deliver you.

children.text: ehi sārdhaṃ mayā vaiśya gokarṇaṃ kṣetrasattamam
children.translated_text: Come with me, Vaiśya, to <s>Gokarṇa</s>, the best of sacred fields.

children.text: tatra śrāddhaṃ pitṛsthālyāṃ vidhivat tvatkṛte tv aham ||
children.translated_text: There at <s>Pitṛsthālī</s> I shall duly perform <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rite) for your sake,

children.text: kṛtvāśu prāpayiṣye 'dya gatiṃ vaiśya tavottamām
children.translated_text: and today, O Vaiśya, I shall quickly bring you to your highest destiny."

children.text: ity uktvā tena sahitaḥ kutso gokarṇam āyayau ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, <s>Kutsa</s> came to <s>Gokarṇa</s> together with him.

children.text: snānaṃ kṛtvā pitṛsthālyāṃ vaiśyena sahito dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: The Brahmin, together with the Vaiśya, bathed at <s>Pitṛsthālī</s>.

children.text: vaiśyanāmnā kuśagranthiṃ kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Tying a knot of kuśa grass in the Vaiśya's name, he performed the <s>śrāddha</s> according to rule.

children.text: uddhārayāmāsa ca taṃ piśācatvād dvijottamaḥ
children.translated_text: And that best of Brahmins rescued him from <s>piśāca</s>-hood.

children.text: yathākāmaṃ gataḥ kutso vaiśyo'pi svargam āptavān ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kutsa</s> went wherever he wished, and the Vaiśya too reached heaven.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: pitṛsthālī mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpaharā śubhā
children.translated_text: <s>Pitṛsthālī</s> is very holy, auspicious, and remover of all sins.

children.text: kathā caiṣā puṇyatamā paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: And this story is most meritorious for those who read and hear it, O king.

children.text: iti śrīskānde śrīgokarṇamāhātmye pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus, in the venerable <s>Skanda</s>, in the venerable <s>Gokarṇa Māhātmya</s>, the fifth chapter.

children.text: Chapter 6
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpanno mṛkaṇḍur nāma vai muniḥ
children.translated_text: A sage named <s>Mṛkaṇḍu</s> was born from <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Khyāti</s>.

children.text: sumitrā nāma tasyāsīd bhāryā paramaśobhanā ||
children.translated_text: His wife was named <s>Sumitrā</s>, exceedingly beautiful.

children.text: tayor jajñe suto dhīmān mārkaṇḍeya iti śrutaḥ
children.translated_text: To them was born a wise son, known as <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>.

children.text: tadā santoṣavelāyāṃ vāg uvācāśarīriṇī ||
children.translated_text: Then, at the moment of joy, a bodiless voice spoke:

children.text: mṛkaṇḍo tava putro 'yaṃ ṣoḍaśābde mariṣyati
children.translated_text: "<s>Mṛkaṇḍu</s>, this son of yours will die in his sixteenth year."

children.text: iti śrutvātha tadvākyaṃ dampatī duḥkhitau bhṛśam ||
children.translated_text: After hearing that utterance, the couple became deeply distressed.

children.text: cakratus tasya putrasya jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ
children.translated_text: They performed for that son the <s>jātakarman</s> (birth-rite) and the other rites.

children.text: kāle gurukulaṃ nītaḥ pitrā tena mahātmanā ||
children.translated_text: At the proper time he was taken to the guru's household by that noble father.

children.text: guroḥ prasādād vedānāṃ pāragaḥ sa babhūva ha
children.translated_text: Through the guru's grace, he became one who had mastered the Vedas.

children.text: svagṛhaṃ punar āyāto vavande pitarau svakau ||
children.translated_text: Returning again to his own house, he bowed to his own parents.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā nanandatuḥ putraṃ duḥkhitau ca babhūvatuḥ
children.translated_text: Seeing their son, they rejoiced, but they also became distressed.

children.text: duḥkhitau pitarau dṛṣṭvā papraccha sa kutūhalāt ||
children.translated_text: Seeing his parents distressed, he asked out of curiosity:

children.text: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> said:

children.text: harṣakāle kim arthaṃ vāṃ duḥkham atyadbhutaṃ pitaḥ
children.translated_text: "At a time for joy, why do you two have this very strange sorrow, father?"

children.text: mṛkaṇḍur uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Mṛkaṇḍu</s> said:

children.text: tvayi jāte tadā vatsa vāg uvācāśarīriṇī ||
children.translated_text: "When you were born, my child, a bodiless voice said,

children.text: mṛkaṇḍo tava putro 'yaṃ ṣoḍaśe 'bde mariṣyati
children.translated_text: '<s>Mṛkaṇḍu</s>, this son of yours will die in his sixteenth year.'

children.text: tac chrutvāvāṃ hṛdi hatau vajreṇeva suduḥkhitau ||
children.translated_text: Hearing that, we two were struck in the heart as if by a thunderbolt and were deeply distressed.

children.text: idānīṃ dvādaśo varṣo vartate tava vai suta
children.translated_text: Now your twelfth year is underway, my son.

children.text: āvāṃ tad anusaṃsmṛtya duḥkhitau svaḥ sutādhunā ||
children.translated_text: Remembering that, we two are distressed now because of you, son."

children.text: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> said:

children.text: duḥkhaṃ te vyapaneṣyāmi tathā mātur na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: "I shall remove your sorrow, and likewise mother's; there is no doubt.

children.text: ity uktvā tau samāśvāsya nirgataḥ svagṛhāt tataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having said this and comforted them both, he then went out from his own house.

children.text: bhṛgor āśramam āsādya sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat
children.translated_text: Reaching the hermitage of <s>Bhṛgu</s>, he told him everything.

children.text: tenoktena vidhānena tapas tepe suduścaram ||
children.translated_text: By the procedure taught by him, he practiced austerity that was very hard to perform.

children.text: caturthe vatsare kāśīṃ gatvā gaṅgātaṭe śubhe
children.translated_text: In the fourth year, going to <s>Kāśī</s>, to the auspicious bank of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: śivam eva paraṃ dhyāyann āste vītabhayo muniḥ ||
children.translated_text: the sage remained there, free from fear, meditating on <s>Śiva</s> alone as supreme.

children.text: śaucopaviṣṭam aśucim ekadā taṃ mṛkaṇḍujam
children.translated_text: Once, while that son of <s>Mṛkaṇḍu</s> was seated for purification and was ritually impure,

children.text: abhyadravad ghorarūpas tv antaraṃ prepsur antakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: terrifying in form, <s>Antaka</s> rushed at him, seeking an opportunity.

children.text: mārkaṇḍeyas tadodvigno ghaṭaṃ gaṅgāmbupūritaṃ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>, alarmed, took a pot filled with <s>Gaṅgā</s> water

children.text: svakarasthaṃ śivadhiyā tam eva pariṣasvaje ||
children.translated_text: which was in his own hand, and embraced that very pot with his mind fixed on <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: gatāyuṣaṃ api hy enaṃ kālo hantuṃ na cāśakat
children.translated_text: Although his span of life had passed, <s>Kāla</s> could not kill him,

children.text: tatas tasmād ghaṭāt sadyaḥ śivaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: and then, from that pot, <s>Śiva</s> at once became manifest.

children.text: āvirbhūtaṃ munir dṛṣṭvā 'bhayaṃ tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Śaṅkara</s> appear, the sage, freed from fear, praised him:

children.text: āyur me nāsti bhagavan nāyur me samprakalpaya ||
children.translated_text: "I have no life-span, Blessed One; appoint a life-span for me."

children.text: tato 'bravīn mahādevo mṛkaṇḍutanayaṃ munim
children.translated_text: Then <s>Mahādeva</s> spoke to the sage, the son of <s>Mṛkaṇḍu</s>:

children.text: madbhaktir dhriyatāṃ vipra cara tvaṃ tapa āyuṣe ||
children.translated_text: "Let devotion to me be maintained, O Brahmin; perform tapas for the sake of life.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya paritoṣaya keśavam
children.translated_text: Reach the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> and satisfy <s>Keśava</s>;

children.text: sa te dadāti bhagavān āyur vai manasepsitam ||
children.translated_text: the Blessed Lord will give you the life-span desired by your mind.

children.text: tadāhaṃ tatra yāsyāmi brahmaṇā saha putraka
children.translated_text: Then I shall go there with <s>Brahmā</s>, my son."

children.text: ity uktvāntardadhe śambhur mārkaṇḍeyas tataḥ svayam ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared; then <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> himself

children.text: jagāma siddhamārgeṇa gokarṇaṃ kṣetram uttamam
children.translated_text: went by the path of the siddhas to the excellent sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā dharmāśramasamīpataḥ ||
children.translated_text: There he made a hermitage near the hermitage of <s>Dharma</s>.

children.text: liṅgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya tapas tepe suduścaram
children.translated_text: Having established a <s>liṅga</s> there, he performed very difficult tapas.

children.text: prasannas tapasā tasya pratyakṣo 'bhūddhariḥ svayam ||
children.translated_text: Pleased by his tapas, <s>Hari</s> himself became visible before him.

children.text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo 'bravīd vacaḥ
children.translated_text: Seeing that lord of the gods of gods, <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> spoke these words:

children.text: nārāyaṇa namas te 'stu namas te bhaktavatsala ||
children.translated_text: "O <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, homage to you; homage to you, lover of devotees.

children.text: namas te lokakartre ca bhartre hartre namo namaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to you as maker, sustainer, and destroyer of the worlds; homage again and again."

children.text: atha prīto hariḥ prāha varaṃ vṛṇu dvijepsitam ||
children.translated_text: Then, pleased, <s>Hari</s> said, "Choose the boon desired by a twice-born man."

children.text: athāyayau śivas tatra brahmā cāyāc chivecchayā ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śiva</s> came there, and <s>Brahmā</s> too came by <s>Śiva</s>'s wish.

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: mahāviṣṇo munir ayaṃ gatāyur api bhaktitaḥ
children.translated_text: "O <s>Mahāviṣṇu</s>, this sage, though his life-span had passed, through devotion

children.text: rudrasyālokanād eva jīvayukto babhūva ha ||
children.translated_text: became endowed with life merely by seeing <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: janmāyutaṃ devadeva tvām ārādhitavān purā
children.translated_text: For ten thousand births, O god of gods, he formerly worshiped you.

children.text: rudreṇāyur dattam eva tvam apy asmai prasādaya ||
children.translated_text: Life has indeed been given by <s>Rudra</s>; you too should show favor to him."

children.text: viṣṇur uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> said:

children.text: ajarāmaratā vipra matprasādād bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: "O Brahmin, by my grace you will become free from old age and death.

children.text: dattaṃ mayā pūrvam eva śivabhaktyā na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It was already granted by me because of devotion to <s>Śiva</s>; there is no doubt.

children.text: āśramas te dvijaśreṣṭha loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati
children.translated_text: Your hermitage, O best of twice-born men, will become famous in the world.

children.text: mārkaṇḍeyahrade puṇye snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi ||
children.translated_text: After bathing according to rule in the holy <s>Mārkaṇḍeyahrada</s>,

children.text: tasya trijanmācaritaṃ svalpaṃ vā ?di vā bahu
children.translated_text: whatever sin from his conduct through three births, whether small, [uncertain reading], or great,

children.text: pāpaṃ praśamam āyāti viṣṇuyāgaphalaṃ labhet ||
children.translated_text: comes to cessation, and he obtains the fruit of a sacrifice to <s>Viṣṇu</s>."

children.text: iti tasmai varaṃ datvā tatraivāntardadhuḥ surāḥ
children.translated_text: Having given him this boon, the gods disappeared right there.

children.text: mārkaṇḍeyo 'pi bhagavān yathākāmaṃ jagāma ha ||
children.translated_text: And blessed <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> too went wherever he wished.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: prajāḥ sisṛkṣan brahmā tu sṛṣṭavān dharmam uttamam
children.translated_text: Desiring to create creatures, <s>Brahmā</s> created excellent <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: catuṣpādayutaṃ dāntaṃ lokarakṣaṇahetave ||
children.translated_text: endowed with four feet and self-restrained, for the protection of the world.

children.text: sa cāha dharmaṃ rakṣa tvaṃ sarvā vai māmakāḥ prajāḥ
children.translated_text: And he said, "You protect all my creatures."

children.text: tac chrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ tathāstv iti tato 'bravīt ||
children.translated_text: Hearing that word of <s>Brahmā</s>, he then said, "So be it."

children.text: dadhāra dharmo bhagavān prajāḥ sarvās tadā nṛpa
children.translated_text: Then blessed <s>Dharma</s> supported all creatures, O king,

children.text: dharmo 'pi bhagavān devaḥ svāṃ yoniṃ samacintayat ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Dharma</s> too, the blessed god, reflected on his own source of birth.

children.text: jñātvā sūryaṃ viśeṣāc ca vāyubhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
children.translated_text: Having especially understood <s>Sūrya</s> as that source, the eternal one had become wind-like;

children.text: tasmin kāle sa bhagavān vivasvān lokapāvanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at that time that blessed <s>Vivasvān</s>, purifier of the world,

children.text: tapas tepe sa gokarṇe liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāmbhavam
children.translated_text: performed tapas at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, having established a <s>Śāmbhava</s> <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: tataḥ śivaḥ prasannātmā sūryaṃ prāha kṛpānidhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śiva</s>, pleased in heart, the treasury of compassion, spoke to <s>Sūrya</s>:

children.text: siddhir bhavatu te sūrya matprasādād asaṃśayam
children.translated_text: "Let accomplishment be yours, O <s>Sūrya</s>, by my grace, without doubt.

children.text: liṅgam etat pūjakānāṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: May this <s>liṅga</s> become the giver of every siddhi for those who worship it."

children.text: iti tasmai varaṃ datvā talliṅge 'ntaradhāt prabhuḥ
children.translated_text: Having given him this boon, the Lord disappeared into that <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: antarhite bhagavati sūryaḥ svastriyam āptavān ||
children.translated_text: When the Blessed Lord had disappeared, <s>Sūrya</s> approached his own wife.

children.text: saṃjñayā saha saṃgamya tasyāṃ dharmam ajījanat
children.translated_text: Uniting with <s>Saṃjñā</s>, he begot <s>Dharma</s> in her.

children.text: utpādya dharmaṃ sūryaś ca yathāsthānam agāt prabhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: After producing <s>Dharma</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, the lord, went to his proper place.

children.text: dharmo 'pi tatra bhagavān sūryāśramasamīpataḥ
children.translated_text: Blessed <s>Dharma</s> too, there near the hermitage of <s>Sūrya</s>,

children.text: kṛtvāśramapadaṃ rājaṃstapas tepe suduścaram ||
children.translated_text: made a hermitage, O king, and performed very difficult tapas.

children.text: tasya tuṣṭās tadā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
children.translated_text: Then the gods <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Maheśvara</s> were pleased with him.

children.text: devā ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The gods said:

children.text: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yate manasi vartate ||
children.translated_text: "Choose a boon; welfare to you, ascetic, whatever is in your mind."

children.text: ity uktaḥ prāha dharmo 'pi brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān
children.translated_text: Thus addressed, <s>Dharma</s> too spoke to <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Maheśvara</s>.

children.text: dharma uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> said:

children.text: yadi prasannā yūyaṃ me lokapālāś ca sādaram ||
children.translated_text: "If you, and the guardians of the worlds, are gracious to me with respect,

children.text: tīrtham etat suraśreṣṭhā hy āśramo liṅgam eva ca
children.translated_text: O best of gods, may this tīrtha, this hermitage, and this <s>liṅga</s>

children.text: loke śreṣṭhatamaṃ bhūyāt sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
children.translated_text: become the very best in the world, destroying all sins."

children.text: tathety uktvā tato devās tatraivāntardadhuḥ surāḥ
children.translated_text: Saying "So be it," the gods then disappeared right there.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: śivād anujñāṃ samprāpya ṣaṇmukho bharatarṣabha ||
children.translated_text: Having obtained permission from <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Ṣaṇmukha</s>, O bull of the <s>Bharatas</s>,

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya kumāreśvaram abhyagāt
children.translated_text: reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> and came to <s>Kumāreśvara</s>.

children.text: trayodaśakumārā vai tasmin siddhim upāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thirteen <s>Kumāras</s> indeed attained siddhi at that place.

children.text: tīrthe guhodake snātvā ṣaṇmukho liṅgam arcayan
children.translated_text: Bathing in the tīrtha of <s>Guhodaka</s>, <s>Ṣaṇmukha</s>, worshiping the <s>liṅga</s>,

children.text: tapas tepe nirāhāraḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: performed tapas without food, wholly devoted to meditation on <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: kārtike kṛttikāyuktapaurṇamāsyāṃ nṛpottama
children.translated_text: In the month of <s>Kārtika</s>, on the full-moon day joined with <s>Kṛttikā</s>, O best of kings,

children.text: tasmil liṅge hy āvirabhūt pārvatyā sahitaḥ śivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> appeared in that <s>liṅga</s> together with <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: brahmaviṣṇvādibhiḥ sārdham idam ūce nṛpottama
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and the others, he said this, O best of kings.

children.text: śaṃkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: varaṃ varaya putra tvaṃ yat te 'bhilaṣitaṃ hṛdi ||
children.translated_text: "Choose a boon, my son, whatever is desired in your heart."

children.text: ṣaṇmukha uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Ṣaṇmukha</s> said:

children.text: siddhim icchāmi bhagavan tīrthaṃ liṅgaṃ mayā śritam
children.translated_text: "I desire siddhi, Blessed One; may the tīrtha and <s>liṅga</s> that I have resorted to

children.text: bahupuṇyapradaṃ cāstu tvatprasādān maheśvara ||
children.translated_text: also bestow abundant merit by your grace, O <s>Maheśvara</s>."

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: siddho 'si pūrvam eva tvaṃ devasenāpatir bhava
children.translated_text: "You are already perfected; become the commander of the army of the gods."

children.text: tārakāsuranāśāya senānī tvadṛte na hi ||
children.translated_text: For the destruction of <s>Tārakāsura</s>, there is indeed no commander except you.

children.text: śaktiṃ cāpi dadau tasmai sarvaśatruniṣūdinīm
children.translated_text: And he gave him a spear that would slay all enemies.

children.text: iti tasmai varaṃ datvā tatraivāntardadhe śivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having granted him this boon, <s>Śiva</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: tīrthe guhodake snātvā kumāreśvaram arcayet
children.translated_text: Having bathed at the <s>Guhodaka</s> <s>tīrtha</s>, one should worship <s>Kumāreśvara</s>.

children.text: triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
children.translated_text: Together with twenty-one generations of his family, he is honored in <s>Śivaloka</s>.

children.text: purā hi dāruṇo nāma pārthivo vaṅgadeśajaḥ
children.translated_text: Formerly, O king, there was an earthly ruler named <s>Dāruṇa</s>, born in the land of <s>Vaṅga</s>.

children.text: prajāḥ pālayatas tasya babhūvuḥ śatravo nṛpa
children.translated_text: While he was protecting his subjects, enemies arose against him, O king.

children.text: ruddhvā purīṃ tena guptāṃ saptāṅgaṃ jahrur ojasā
children.translated_text: They besieged his well-guarded city and forcefully seized his sevenfold kingdom.

children.text: tatas tu dāruṇo nāma ekākī vanam āśritaḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Dāruṇa</s>, now alone, took refuge in the forest.

children.text: bahudhā kṣuttṛṣāviṣṭo nyagrodhatalam āśritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Afflicted in many ways by hunger and thirst, he took shelter beneath a banyan tree.

children.text: upaspṛśya jalaṃ tatra bhāryayā samupāviśat
children.translated_text: After sipping water there, he sat down with his wife.

children.text: saṃcintayan sa bahudhā tasmin kāle samāhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At that time, composed in mind, he reflected in many ways.

children.text: sanako nāma yogīndras trailokyāṭanatatparaḥ
children.translated_text: A foremost yogin named <s>Sanaka</s>, intent on wandering through the three worlds,

children.text: tam āgatam abhiprekṣya tatpadau praṇipatya ca ||
children.translated_text: came there; seeing him arrive, the king bowed down at his feet.

children.text: uvāca sāñjalir bhūtvā sanakaṃ yoginaṃ tadā
children.translated_text: Then, standing with folded hands, he spoke to the yogin <s>Sanaka</s>:

children.text: yogin praśāsataḥ pṛthvīṃ dharmeṇa sakalāḥ prajāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "O yogin, while I was ruling the earth and all my subjects according to <s>dharma</s> (righteous order),

children.text: śatravaś ca balāt kṛtya saptāṅgaṃ jahrur ojasā
children.translated_text: enemies acted by force and seized my sevenfold kingdom with power.

children.text: mama rājyaṃ yathā prāpsye tathā kuru mahāmate ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, great-minded one, do what will let me regain my kingdom."

children.text: sanaka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sanaka</s> said:

children.text: sarvasiddhipradaṃ kṣetraṃ gaccha gokarṇam uttamam
children.translated_text: "Go to excellent <s>Gokarṇa</s>, the sacred field that grants every accomplishment.

children.text: kumāreśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu liṅgaṃ tatrāsti siddhidam
children.translated_text: There is there a <s>liṅga</s> called <s>Kumāreśvara</s>, which grants accomplishment.

children.text: tvaṃ tatra gatvā rājendra snātvā tīrthe guhodake
children.translated_text: Go there, O king of kings, bathe in the <s>Guhodaka</s> <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: kumāreśaṃ samabhyarcya tapas tīvraṃ samācara ||
children.translated_text: worship <s>Kumāreśa</s>, and perform severe austerity.

children.text: tataḥ prasanno bhavati pārvatyā sahitaḥ śivaḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śiva</s>, together with <s>Pārvatī</s>, will become pleased.

children.text: tavābhīṣṭaṃ dadāty eva svaṃ rājyaṃ prāpsyase punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He will certainly give you what you desire, and you will regain your own kingdom."

children.text: iti tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā praṇipatya mahāmunim
children.translated_text: Hearing these words of his, he bowed down to the great sage.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya kumāreśvaram abhyagāt ||
children.translated_text: Reaching the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, he went to <s>Kumāreśvara</s>.

children.text: snātvā guhodake tīrthe kumāreśam apūjayat
children.translated_text: He bathed at the <s>Guhodaka</s> <s>tīrtha</s> and worshipped <s>Kumāreśa</s>.

children.text: āvirbabhūva puratas tasmāl liṅgād umāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: From that <s>liṅga</s>, <s>Umāpati</s> appeared before him.

children.text: rājānaṃ prāha rājendra vākyam etan maheśvaraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Maheśvara</s> addressed the king with these words, O king of kings.

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: tavābhīṣṭaṃ pradāsyāmi rājan brūhi manogatam ||
children.translated_text: "I shall grant you what you desire, O king; speak what is in your mind."

children.text: dāruṇa uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Dāruṇa</s> said:

children.text: śatrubhir hṛtarājyaḥ ahaṃ prāpsye rājyaṃ svakaṃ yathā
children.translated_text: "My kingdom has been taken by enemies. Make it so that I regain my own kingdom,

children.text: tathā kuru mahādeva tvayi bhaktir bhaven mama ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Mahādeva</s>, and so that I may have devotion to you."

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: tathā astu nṛpaśārdūla svaṃ rājyaṃ prāpsyase acirāt
children.translated_text: "So be it, tiger among kings. You will regain your own kingdom before long.

children.text: idaṃ śaktyā yudhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śatravas tava bhūpate ||
children.translated_text: When your enemies see this battle with the spear, O lord of the earth,

children.text: palāyante daśadiśaḥ ity uktvāntardadhe haraḥ
children.translated_text: they will flee to the ten directions." Having said this, <s>Hara</s> disappeared.

children.text: rājā tu dāruṇo nāma bhāryayā saha pārthiva ||
children.translated_text: Then King <s>Dāruṇa</s>, O earthly ruler, together with his wife,

children.text: varaṃ labdhvā maheśāt tu śatrūn jitvā svakāṃ purīm
children.translated_text: having obtained a boon from <s>Maheśa</s>, conquered his enemies and his own city.

children.text: samprāpya sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ pālayāmāsa pūrvavat ||
children.translated_text: Regaining the whole earth, he ruled it as before.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: brahmā jagatpatiḥ pūrvaṃ sraṣṭukāmaḥ prajā nṛpa
children.translated_text: In former times, O king, <s>Brahmā</s>, lord of the world, desired to create beings.

children.text: dhyāyatas tasya devasya jihvāgrād agalad rasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As that god meditated, fluid dripped from the tip of his tongue.

children.text: gṛhītvā tadrasaṃ brahmā pātukāmo dadhāra ca
children.translated_text: Taking that fluid, <s>Brahmā</s>, wishing to drink it, held it in his mouth.

children.text: na śaśāka dṛḍhīkartuṃ vaktrākāśaṃ vyadārayat ||
children.translated_text: He was not able to keep it firm; it split open the space of his mouth.

children.text: tasmān mukhād babhūvāśu śuddhavarṇā sarasvatī
children.translated_text: From that mouth there quickly arose <s>Sarasvatī</s>, pure in color.

children.text: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame devaḥ provācedaṃ caturmukhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing her, the god desired her, and the four-faced one spoke these words:

children.text: sarasād rasanād evaṃ jātāsi mama mānade
children.translated_text: "Since you have thus been born from the fluid of my tongue, O honorable one,

children.text: sarasvatīti te nāma loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: your name <s>Sarasvatī</s> will become renowned in the world.

children.text: dvidhā tvaṃ bhava kalyāṇi hy ekāṃśena nadī bhava
children.translated_text: Divide yourself in two, auspicious one; with one portion become a river.

children.text: divyastrīrūpiṇī bhūtvā bhaja māmeva bhāmini ||
children.translated_text: With a divine female form, beautiful lady, worship me alone.

children.text: vyaktāvyaktasvarūpeṇa bhūteṣu vasa sarvadā
children.translated_text: In a manifest and unmanifest form, dwell always among living beings."

children.text: ity uktā sā tathety uktvā tyaktā dehaṃ varānanā ||
children.translated_text: Thus addressed, she said, "So be it," and the fair-faced one abandoned her body.

children.text: dakṣasya duhitā bhūtvā gokarṇe vyacarat tapaḥ
children.translated_text: Having become the daughter of <s>Dakṣa</s>, she practiced austerity in <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tīrthaṃ sunirmalaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāmbhavam ||
children.translated_text: She made a very pure <s>tīrtha</s> and established a <s>Śāmbhava</s> <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: tasyās tapaḥprabhāveṇa brahmā pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: By the power of her austerity, <s>Brahmā</s> became visible before her.

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: dātāsmi te varaṃ bhadre kim icchasi śubhe vada ||
children.translated_text: "I am ready to give you a boon, blessed one. Tell me, auspicious one, what you wish."

children.text: siddhāhaṃ sarvabhūteṣu cariṣye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
children.translated_text: "May I be accomplished among all beings and move for eternal years.

children.text: tīrthe snātvā madīye tu malliṅgaṃ pūjayec ca yaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And whoever, after bathing in my <s>tīrtha</s>, worships my <s>liṅga</s>,

children.text: vākpaṭutvaṃ sa labhatu tvatprasādāt sureśvara
children.translated_text: may he obtain eloquence through your favor, O lord of gods."

children.text: siddhāsi pūrvam eva tvaṃ jihvāyāṃ vasa sarvadā ||
children.translated_text: "You were already accomplished before; dwell always on the tongue.

children.text: sarasvatīkuṇḍam iti loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati
children.translated_text: It will become famous in the world as <s>Sarasvatīkuṇḍa</s>."

children.text: iti datvā varaṃ brahmā tatraivāntardadhe nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Having granted this boon, <s>Brahmā</s> disappeared right there, O king.

children.text: sarasvatī ca brahmāṇam upatasthe samāhitā ||
children.translated_text: And <s>Sarasvatī</s>, with concentrated mind, attended upon <s>Brahmā</s>.

children.text: iti śrīskānde śrīgokarṇamāhātmye ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the sixth chapter in the glorious <s>Gokarṇamāhātmya</s> of the glorious <s>Skanda</s>.

children.text: Chapter 7
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ dhātṛvaktrebhyo jajñire bhārate tadā
children.translated_text: Then, in <s>Bhārata</s>, for the sake of creation, from the mouths of the Creator

children.text: vedāś caturbhyaś catvāraḥ sarahasyāḥ saśākhakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: were born the four <s>Veda</s>s from his four mouths, with their secret teachings and branches.

children.text: ekībhūtāḥ punas tān vai lolayāmāsa padmabhūḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Padmabhū</s> then gathered them together again and stirred them.

children.text: vedarāśau mathyamāne gāyatrī samajāyata ||
children.translated_text: As the mass of the <s>Veda</s>s was being churned, <s>Gāyatrī</s> came into being.

children.text: vedeṣu sārabhūtatvāt sāvitrīty api kathyate
children.translated_text: Because she is the essence of the <s>Veda</s>s, she is also called <s>Sāvitrī</s>.

children.text: gāyantaṃ trāyate yasmād gāyatrī ceti tāṃ viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: Because she protects one who sings, they know her as <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: uvāca padmabhūr devīṃ gokarṇe tapa ācara
children.translated_text: <s>Padmabhū</s> said to the goddess, "Practice austerity at <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: manniyogakarī paścān madvaśe tiṣṭha bhāmini ||
children.translated_text: Afterward, doing my command, remain under my control, beautiful lady."

children.text: evaṃ kariṣye deveśety uktvā sāntaradhīyata
children.translated_text: Saying, "I shall do so, lord of gods," she disappeared.

children.text: tenaiva hetunā brahmā sāvitrīm aśapad ruṣā ||
children.translated_text: For that very reason, <s>Brahmā</s>, in anger, cursed <s>Sāvitrī</s>:

children.text: śarīraṃ nāśam āyātu tava śīghraṃ varānane
