children.translated_text: "May your body quickly come to destruction, fair-faced one."

children.text: tyaktvā śarīraṃ sā devī vāyubhūtā cacāra ha ||
children.translated_text: Abandoning her body, that goddess moved about, having become wind.

children.text: tato gokarṇam āsādya cacāra tapa uttamam
children.translated_text: Then, having reached <s>Gokarṇa</s>, she practiced supreme austerity.

children.text: tīrthaṃ kṛtvā suvimalaṃ brahmā pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: After she had made a very pure <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred bathing place), <s>Brahmā</s> appeared in visible form.

children.text: gāyatrīṃ cāpi sāvitrīṃ varaṃ brūhīty uvāca ha
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said to <s>Gāyatrī</s> and also to <s>Sāvitrī</s>, "Speak your boon."

children.text: gāyatry uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Gāyatrī</s> said:

children.text: siddhim icchāmi bhagavan tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: I desire accomplishment, O blessed lord; may this <s>tīrtha</s> be the very best.

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: siddhir bhavatu te bhadre tīrthe ye snānti bhāmini
children.translated_text: May accomplishment be yours, gracious lady; O lovely one, those who bathe at this <s>tīrtha</s>

children.text: teṣāṃ trijanmacaritaṃ pāpaṃ naśyaty asaṃśayam ||
children.translated_text: have the sin committed over three births destroyed, without doubt.

children.text: sāvitry uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sāvitrī</s> said:

children.text: śarīraṃ prārthaye deva tvatprasādāj jagadguro
children.translated_text: I ask for a body, O god, through your favor, O teacher of the world.

children.text: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā datvā śubhaṃ vapuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having heard her words, <s>Brahmā</s> gave her an auspicious body;

children.text: gāyatryā caiva sāvitryā sahitaḥ svapadaṃ yayau
children.translated_text: and, together with <s>Gāyatrī</s> and <s>Sāvitrī</s>, he went to his own station.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: mātrā śaptāḥ purā nāgā uccaiḥ śravasakāraṇāt ||
children.translated_text: Long ago the <s>Nāgas</s> had been cursed by their mother because of <s>Uccaiḥśravas</s>.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya tapaś cakruḥ samāhitāḥ
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, they performed austerity with composed minds.

children.text: tīrthaṃ sunirmalaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāmbhavam ||
children.translated_text: Having made a very pure <s>tīrtha</s> and installed a <s>Śāmbhava liṅga</s> (emblem of Śiva),

children.text: evaṃ tapasyatāṃ teṣāṃ brahmā pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: while they were practicing austerity in this way, <s>Brahmā</s> appeared before them.

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: nāgā vṛṇīdhvaṃ dāsyāmi yuṣmākaṃ yad abhīpsitam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāgas</s>, choose; I shall give whatever is desired by you.

children.text: nāgā ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Nāgas</s> said:

children.text: mātrā śaptā vayaṃ brahmaṃs tanmokṣaṃ naḥ prasādaya
children.translated_text: We have been cursed by our mother, O <s>Brahmā</s>; graciously grant us release from that.

children.text: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā nāgān uvāca ha ||
children.translated_text: Having heard their words, <s>Brahmā</s> spoke to the <s>Nāgas</s>:

children.text: mātṛśāpo na bhavitā matprasādān na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: By my favor the mother's curse will not come to pass; there is no doubt.

children.text: tīrtham etan mahābhāgā liṅgaṃ yuṣmābhir arcitam ||
children.translated_text: O greatly fortunate ones, may this <s>tīrtha</s> and the <s>liṅga</s> worshiped by you

children.text: sarvasiddhikaraṃ cāstu pitṛśāpavimokṣadam
children.translated_text: grant every accomplishment and give release from an ancestral curse.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: iti teṣāṃ varaṃ datvā brahmā cāntaradhīyata ||
children.translated_text: Having given them this boon, <s>Brahmā</s> disappeared.

children.text: śrāvaṇe māsi śukle tu pañcamyāṃ nāgatīrthake
children.translated_text: In the bright fortnight of the month of <s>Śrāvaṇa</s>, on the fifth lunar day, at <s>Nāgatīrtha</s>,

children.text: snātvā tu vidhinā devaṃ sarpasūktena cārcayet ||
children.translated_text: one should bathe according to rule and worship the deity with the <s>Sarpasūkta</s> (snake hymn).

children.text: mātṛśāpo na bhavitā sarpaśāpo vinaśyati
children.translated_text: The mother's curse will not come to pass, and a snake's curse is destroyed.

children.text: ubhayoḥ pakṣayoś caiva pañcamyāṃ nāgatīrthake ||
children.translated_text: On the fifth lunar day in both fortnights, at <s>Nāgatīrtha</s>,

children.text: snānaṃ vidhāya tal liṅgaṃ nāgasūktena cārcayet
children.translated_text: one should perform the bath and worship that <s>liṅga</s> with the <s>Nāgasūkta</s> (serpent hymn).

children.text: purā tu bhārgavo rāmo hatvā kṣatriyasantatim ||
children.translated_text: Long ago <s>Bhārgava Rāma</s>, after killing the succession of <s>Kṣatriyas</s>,

children.text: kaśyapaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ yajñārthaṃ ca samāhvayat
children.translated_text: summoned <s>Kaśyapa</s>, tiger among sages, for the sake of a sacrifice.

children.text: yajñaṃ kṛtvā tadā rāmas tasmai prādād vasundharāṃ ||
children.translated_text: Having performed the sacrifice, <s>Rāma</s> then gave him the earth.

children.text: tāṃ bhūmiṃ kaśyapo rājan brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradattavān
children.translated_text: That land, O king, <s>Kaśyapa</s> gave to the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>.

children.text: arājakā tadā cāsīt sarvā bhūmir mahīpate ||
children.translated_text: Then the whole earth, O lord of the earth, was without a king.

children.text: babhūvātitarāṃ loke hy adharmo lokanāśakaḥ
children.translated_text: Exceedingly great <s>adharma</s> (unrighteous disorder), destructive of the world, arose among people.

children.text: tato bhūmir adharmaṃ taṃ soḍhuṃ na kṣamate 'nagha ||
children.translated_text: Then the Earth could not bear that <s>adharma</s>, O sinless one.

children.text: tato gokarṇam āsādya śataśṛṅgasya mūrdhani
children.translated_text: Then, having reached <s>Gokarṇa</s>, on the summit of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>,

children.text: adhobhāgaṃ praviśyāśu tapas tīvram atapyata ||
children.translated_text: she quickly entered the lower region and practiced fierce austerity.

children.text: bhūmiś ca kāśyapī cakre divyavarṣasahasrakam
children.translated_text: The Earth, called <s>Kāśyapī</s>, did this for a thousand divine years.

children.text: tatas tuṣṭo mahādevo varaṃ brūhīty abhāṣata ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Mahādeva</s>, pleased, said, "Speak your boon."

children.text: bhūmir uvāca
children.translated_text: The Earth said:

children.text: arājakam idaṃ viśvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kuru prabho ||
children.translated_text: Make this kingless world as it was before, O lord.

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: rājanvatī bhava śubhe kāśyapīti prathā bhavet
children.translated_text: Become possessed of kings, auspicious one; you shall be renowned as <s>Kāśyapī</s>.

children.text: idaṃ tava tapasthānaṃ gogarbham iti viśrutam ||
children.translated_text: This place of your austerity shall be renowned as <s>Gogarbha</s>.

children.text: atra praviśatāṃ nṝṇāṃ na bhaved garbhasaṃsthitiḥ
children.translated_text: For people who enter here, there will be no abiding in a womb.

children.text: iti datvā varaṃ bhūmyai śaṅkaro 'ntaradhīyata ||
children.translated_text: Having given this boon to the Earth, <s>Śaṅkara</s> disappeared.

children.text: bhūmitvaṃ prāpya sā devī yathāpūrvam atiṣṭhata
children.translated_text: Having regained her state as Earth, that goddess stood as before.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro vasiṣṭho munipuṅgavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, the mind-born son of <s>Brahmā</s> and best of sages,

children.text: himavatparvate ramye tapaḥ kurvann uvāsa ha
children.translated_text: dwelt on the lovely <s>Himavat</s> mountain, practicing austerity.

children.text: ikṣvākur nāma nṛpatir varayāmāsa taṃ guruṃ ||
children.translated_text: A king named <s>Ikṣvāku</s> chose him as guru

children.text: śuśrūṣayā svavaṃśasya tathāstv ity avadan muniḥ
children.translated_text: for his own lineage by service; the sage said, "So be it."

children.text: tadanvaye hy abhūd bhūpo nimiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In that lineage there was a king, <s>Nimi</s>, supremely righteous.

children.text: kadācin mṛgayāṃ kṛtvā gṛhe supto mahīpatiḥ
children.translated_text: Once, after going hunting, the lord of the earth slept at home.

children.text: tadā vasiṣṭho hy agamat tadgṛhadvāradeśataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> came to the area of the doorway of his house.

children.text: suptaṃ dvāḥsthamukhāc chrutvā dadau śāpaṃ nṛpāya saḥ
children.translated_text: Hearing from the doorkeeper's mouth that he was asleep, he pronounced a curse on the king:

children.text: śarīraṃ te vinaśyeta rājan madavamānataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Your body shall perish, O king, because of disrespect toward me."

children.text: iti śaptvā yayau so 'pi svāśramaṃ prati bhūpate
children.translated_text: Having cursed him thus, he too went back to his own hermitage, O lord of the earth.

children.text: tataḥ prabuddho rājāpi śrutvā śāpaṃ guros tadā ||
children.translated_text: Then the king also awoke and, hearing his guru's curse,

children.text: svaguruṃ śaptavān so 'pi rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
children.translated_text: that supremely righteous king cursed his own guru in turn:

children.text: anāgasaṃ māṃ viprendra yasmāt tvaṃ śaptavān asi ||
children.translated_text: "Since, O best of brahmins, you have cursed me though I am without fault,

children.text: tasmāt tavāpi dehas tu naśyaty eva na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: therefore your body too will surely perish; there is no doubt."

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: brahmalokaṃ gatau rājann ubhau tau vāyurūpiṇau ||
children.translated_text: O king, those two both went to <s>Brahmaloka</s> in wind-like forms.

children.text: cintayāmāsa tau dṛṣṭvā brahmā munim uvāca ha
children.translated_text: Seeing them, <s>Brahmā</s> reflected and spoke to the sage:

children.text: mune tvaṃ gaccha gokarṇe tapovanam anuttamam ||
children.translated_text: "Sage, go to the excellent ascetic grove at <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: mitrāvaruṇanāmānau munī tatra tapasyataḥ
children.translated_text: There two sages named <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are practicing austerity.

children.text: tatra gatvā tu ruvaṇāc charīraṃ punar āpnuhi ||
children.translated_text: After going there, regain a body from that outflow."

children.text: tato nimim uvācedaṃ kim icchasi nṛpādhunā
children.translated_text: Then he said this to <s>Nimi</s>: "What do you desire now, O king?"

children.text: nimir uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Nimi</s> said:

children.text: śarīraṃ nāśasahitaṃ necchāmi surasattama ||
children.translated_text: I do not desire a body accompanied by destruction, O best of gods.

children.text: cakṣuṣoḥ sarvamartyānāṃ vasāmi tatprasādataḥ
children.translated_text: By your favor, may I dwell in the eyes of all mortals.

children.text: tatheti brahmaṇā proktaḥ so 'vasac cakṣuṣor nṛṇāṃ ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Brahmā</s> said, "So be it," he dwelt in the eyes of men.

children.text: tad ārabhya narāḥ sarve sanimeṣā nṛpābhavan
children.translated_text: From that time onward, O king, all men became possessed of blinking.

children.text: tato vasiṣṭhaḥ samprāpya śarīraṃ varuṇān nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, having received a body from <s>Varuṇa</s>, O king,

children.text: tapaś cakāra suciraṃ gokarṇe tu tapovane
children.translated_text: performed austerity for a very long time in the ascetic grove at <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: liṅgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya tīrthaṃ kṛtvā sunirmalam ||
children.translated_text: Installing a <s>liṅga</s> there and making a very pure <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: tato maheśvarāt prāpya yogasiddhiṃ tadā muniḥ
children.translated_text: then the sage received yogic accomplishment from <s>Maheśvara</s>.

children.text: icchāvāsaṃ bhūtale ca yathākāmaṃ jagāma ha ||
children.translated_text: He lived wherever he wished on earth and went about as he desired.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putraḥ kuśiko nāma pārthivaḥ
children.translated_text: There was a mind-born son of <s>Brahmā</s>, a king named <s>Kuśika</s>,

children.text: kuśanābhis tasya suto gādhis tasya hy abhūt sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kuśanābha</s> was his son, and <s>Gādhi</s> indeed was his son.

children.text: so 'pi durvāsastuṣṭāt kanyāratnaṃ ca labdhavān
children.translated_text: He too, when <s>Durvāsas</s> was pleased, obtained an excellent daughter.

children.text: bhṛguputra ṛcīkas tu hy upayeme ca kanyakām ||
children.translated_text: And <s>Ṛcīka</s>, son of <s>Bhṛgu</s>, married the maiden.

children.text: tato bhṛgus tan niśamya yayau putraniketanam
children.translated_text: Then <s>Bhṛgu</s>, hearing of this, went to his son's dwelling.

children.text: sapatnīkaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā uvāca svasnuṣāṃ muniḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing his son together with his wife, the sage said to his daughter-in-law:

children.text: putras te bhavitā bhadre mātus te 'pi na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: "A son will be born to you, good lady, and also to your mother, without doubt.

children.text: āliṅgetaṃ pṛthag vṛkṣaṃ sāśvatthaṃ tvam udumbaram ||
children.translated_text: Let the two of you embrace separate trees: she an aśvattha, and you an udumbara."

children.text: ity uktvā sa yathākāmaṃ jagāma svāśramaṃ prati
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he went as he wished back to his own hermitage.

children.text: athaitad anyathā te tu cakrāte varayoṣitau ||
children.translated_text: But then those two excellent women did this otherwise.

children.text: tato garbhaḥ samabhavat tayor api nṛpottama
children.translated_text: Thereupon both of them conceived, O best of kings.

children.text: tato bhṛgur agād bhūyaḥ snuṣām evam uvāca ca ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Bhṛgu</s> came again and spoke thus to his daughter-in-law:

children.text: āliṅgane 'nyathā bhadre yuvābhyāṃ hi kṛtaṃ hy abhūt
children.translated_text: "In the embracing, good lady, the two of you did it otherwise.

children.text: tasmāt tava suto bhadre kṣatrācāro bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: Therefore your son, good lady, will have the conduct of a kṣatriya.

children.text: kṣatriyo 'pi tava bhrātā tapasā brāhmaṇo bhavet
children.translated_text: And though a kṣatriya, your brother will become a brāhmaṇa through austerity."

children.text: satyavaty uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Satyavatī</s> said:

children.text: putro me muniśārdūla brāhmaṇācāravān bhavet ||
children.translated_text: "Tiger among sages, may my son possess the conduct of a brāhmaṇa."

children.text: bhṛgur uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Bhṛgu</s> said:

children.text: tathāstu bhadre pautras te kṣatrācāro bhavet dhruvam
children.translated_text: "So be it, good lady. Your grandson will certainly have kṣatriya conduct."

children.text: ity uktvā prayayau so 'pi yathākāmaṃ svam āśramam ||
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he too went as he wished to his own hermitage.

children.text: tato gādheḥ suto jāto viśvāmitraḥ pratāpavān
children.translated_text: Then <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, the powerful son of <s>Gādhi</s>, was born.

children.text: dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa medinīṃ sa nṛpottamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He protected the earth according to dharma, O best of kings.

children.text: kadācin mṛgayāsakto himavatkānanaṃ yayau
children.translated_text: Once, intent on hunting, he went to a forest of <s>Himavat</s>.

children.text: nānāvidhān mṛgān hatvā vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ yayau ||
children.translated_text: After killing many kinds of deer, he went to <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>'s hermitage.

children.text: suśrāntaṃ nṛpatiṃ jñātvā vasiṣṭho vākyam abravīt
children.translated_text: Knowing that the king was very weary, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> spoke these words:

children.text: sthīyatām atra nṛpate bhojayiṣyāmy ahaṃ kṣaṇāt ||
children.translated_text: "Remain here, O king. I shall feed you at once."

children.text: ity uktvāhūya surabhiṃ nandinīm idam abravīt
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he summoned <s>Surabhi</s>, <s>Nandinī</s>, and said this:

children.text: sabalasya nṛpasyāsya dehi bhojanam uttamam ||
children.translated_text: "Give excellent food for this king together with his army."

children.text: tathety uktvā ca sā devī vicitrāṇi gṛhāṇi ca
children.translated_text: Saying "So be it," that goddess brought forth wondrous houses,

children.text: hastiśālādīni tathā cānnaṃ bahuvidhaṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: elephant-stables and the like, and many kinds of food, O king,

children.text: pānāni vastrābharaṇaṃ dudoha surabhiḥ kṣaṇāt
children.translated_text: drinks, garments, and ornaments; <s>Surabhi</s> milked them forth in an instant.

children.text: tatas tu sabalo rājā snātvā pītvā mumoda ha ||
children.translated_text: Then the king with his army bathed, drank, and rejoiced.

children.text: bhuktvovāsa sukhaṃ rājā svarge sukṛtino yathā
children.translated_text: After eating, the king stayed happily, like a meritorious man in heaven.

children.text: vyapanīya niśāṃ tāṃ tu vasiṣṭhaṃ vākyam abravīt ||
children.translated_text: When he had passed that night, he spoke these words to <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>:

children.text: kāmadhenur iyaṃ rājño mama yogyā munīśvara
children.translated_text: "This <s>Kāmadhenū</s> is suited to a king, suited to me, lord of sages.

children.text: ayutena gavāṃ tasmād imāṃ me dātum arhasi ||
children.translated_text: Therefore you ought to give her to me for ten thousand cows."

children.text: vasiṣṭha uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> said:

children.text: na deyā gaur nṛpaśreṣṭha homadhenur iyaṃ mama
children.translated_text: "The cow is not to be given, best of kings; she is my homadhenu, my cow for oblations."

children.text: ity uktas tena rājā sa kopād āha munīśvaram ||
children.translated_text: When the king had been told this by him, he said in anger to the lordly sage:

children.text: neṣyāmi gāṃ balād vipra ratnārhaḥ kṣatriyo 'smy aham
children.translated_text: "I shall take the cow by force, Brahmin; I am a kṣatriya entitled to precious things."

children.text: ity uktvā kauśikaḥ krauryād gṛhītvā tāṃ payasvinīm ||
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, <s>Kauśika</s>, in cruelty, seized that milk-giving cow

children.text: yayau svanagarīṃ gantuṃ dhenur āha muniṃ tadā
children.translated_text: and set out to go to his own city. Then the cow said to the sage:

children.text: upekṣase kim arthaṃ māṃ duṣṭair ebhiḥ prakarṣitām ||
children.translated_text: "Why do you ignore me as I am being dragged away by these wicked men?"

children.text: vasiṣṭha uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> said:

children.text: kṣamādhanā vayaṃ krūrair balāt tvaṃ nīyase śubhe
children.translated_text: "Patience is our wealth; you are being carried off by force by cruel men, auspicious one."

children.text: ity uktā sā tu muninā kopād ākāśagābhavat ||
children.translated_text: So addressed by the sage, she, in anger, became sky-going.

children.text: yodhān sasarja vividhān nānā praharaṇodyatān
children.translated_text: She created various warriors, raised up with many kinds of weapons.

children.text: kṣaṇāt te nāśayāmāsur viśvāmitrasya vāhinīm ||
children.translated_text: In an instant they destroyed <s>Viśvāmitra</s>'s army.

children.text: nirjitaḥ kauśikas tv īrṣyād rudram ārādhya yatnataḥ
children.translated_text: Defeated, <s>Kauśika</s>, out of envy, carefully propitiated <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: labdhvā tasmād rudradaṇḍaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ punar abhyagāt ||
children.translated_text: Having obtained from him the <s>Rudradaṇḍa</s>, he approached <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> again.

children.text: jagrāsa rudradaṇḍaṃ taṃ vasiṣṭho munipuṅgavaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, bull among sages, swallowed that <s>Rudradaṇḍa</s>.

children.text: nirbhidya munidehaṃ sa rudradaṇḍas tv agāc chivam ||
children.translated_text: Piercing the sage's body, that <s>Rudradaṇḍa</s> went to <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: rarakṣa taṃ muniṃ brahmā viśvāmitro'pi pārthiva
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> protected that sage; and <s>Viśvāmitra</s> too, O earthly ruler,

children.text: brāhmaṃ balaṃ balaṃ matvā dhikkṛtvā kṣatriyaṃ balam ||
children.translated_text: regarding brāhmaṇical power as true power, despised kṣatriya power.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya śataśṛṅgasya mūrdhani
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, on the summit of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>,

children.text: liṅgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya tīrthaṃ kṛtvā hy adhas tataḥ ||
children.translated_text: he established a liṅga there and made a tīrtha below it.

children.text: tapaś cakāra suciraṃ varṣāṇām ayutaṃ prabhuḥ
children.translated_text: The lord performed austerity for a very long time, for ten thousand years.

children.text: āvirbabhūva talliṅgād brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||
children.translated_text: From that liṅga appeared <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Maheśvara</s>.

children.text: viśvāmitraṃ tadā vākyam abruvaṃs te narottama
children.translated_text: Then they spoke these words to <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, O best of men:

children.text: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te prasannāḥ smo vayaṃ mune ||
children.translated_text: "Choose a boon; welfare to you. We are pleased, O sage."

children.text: viśvāmitra uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvāmitra</s> said:

children.text: yadi prasannā yūyaṃ me brāhmaṇyaṃ prārthayāmy aham
children.translated_text: "If you are pleased with me, I ask for brāhmaṇya, brāhmaṇa status.

children.text: tīrthaṃ liṅgaṃ suraśreṣṭhās trailokye cottamaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: Best of gods, may this tīrtha and liṅga be supreme in the three worlds."

children.text: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
children.translated_text: Having heard his words, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Maheśvara</s>

children.text: brāhmaṇyaṃ ca dadus tasmai brahmadaṇḍaṃ ca pūjyatām ||
children.translated_text: gave him brāhmaṇya, the brahmadaṇḍa, and venerability,

children.text: tasya liṅgasyāśramasya śreṣṭhatvam cāpi pārthiva
children.translated_text: and also the preeminence of that liṅga and hermitage, O earthly ruler.

children.text: iti datvā varaṃ tasmai tatraivāntardadhuḥ surāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having thus granted him the boon, the gods disappeared right there.

children.text: viśvāmitro 'pi brāhmaṇyaṃ gokarṇe prāpya pārthiva
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvāmitra</s> too, having attained brāhmaṇya at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, O earthly ruler,

children.text: loke śreṣṭhatamo bhūtvā cacāra sa mahāmuniḥ ||
children.translated_text: became the very best in the world and roamed as a great sage.

children.text: tasya tīrthe naraḥ snātvā talliṅgaṃ paripūjya ca
children.translated_text: A man who bathes in that tīrtha and fully worships that liṅga,

children.text: japed yo brāhmaṇo loke gāyatrīṃ lakṣasaṅkhyayā ||
children.translated_text: and who, as a brāhmaṇa in the world, recites the <s>Gāyatrī</s> one hundred thousand times,

children.text: saptajanma bhaved vipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
children.translated_text: becomes a brāhmaṇa for seven births, versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: sumitro nāma viprendraḥ paulastyakulasaṃbhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There was a foremost Brahmin named <s>Sumitra</s>, born in the family of <s>Pulastya</s>.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāmbhavam
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> and established a <s>Śāmbhava</s> liṅga,

children.text: tapasā mahatā tatra toṣayāmāsa śaṅkaram ||
children.translated_text: through great austerity there he satisfied <s>Śaṅkara</s>.

children.text: śivaḥ sānnidhyam akarot tasmin liṅge śivānvitaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s>, accompanied by <s>Śivā</s>, made his presence in that liṅga.

children.text: tajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve hy ānetuṃ jāhnavīṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, all the sages, O king, in order to bring the <s>Jāhnavī</s>...

children.text: parasparaṃ samālocya koṭitīrthāgnidiktaṭe
children.translated_text: After consulting with one another, on the southeastern bank of <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>,

children.text: vighneśvaraṃ pūjayitvā sumitraṃ munim āgaman ||
children.translated_text: they worshiped <s>Vighneśvara</s> and approached the sage <s>Sumitra</s>.

children.text: munaya ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The sages said:

children.text: siddhaḥ asi tapasā brahmañchavasānnidhyakāraṇāt
children.translated_text: O brahman, you are accomplished through austerity and because of the nearness of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: asmanmanoratham imaṃ kartum arhasi suvrata ||
children.translated_text: O you of good vows, you are able to fulfill this desire of ours.

children.text: gaṅgāṃ tripathagāṃ vipra pātālatalavāsinīṃ
children.translated_text: O brahmin, for the welfare of all worlds, by your austerity you should raise up <s>Gaṅgā</s>, the three-pathed river,

children.text: sarvalokahitārthāya tapasoddhartum arhasi ||
children.translated_text: who dwells in the depths of the underworld.

children.text: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā muniḥ sampūjya śāmbhavam
children.translated_text: Having heard their words, the sage worshiped the <s>Śāmbhava</s> one;

children.text: pratyakṣīkṛtya sa śivam idam ūce maheśvaram ||
children.translated_text: making <s>Śiva</s> visible before him, he said this to <s>Maheśvara</s>:

children.text: dehi gaṅgāṃ mahādevīṃ hitārthaṃ jagato 'sya vai
children.translated_text: Grant the great goddess <s>Gaṅgā</s> for the welfare of this world.

children.text: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgāṃ sasmāra śaṅkaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hearing his words, <s>Śaṅkara</s> called <s>Gaṅgā</s> to mind.

children.text: tat tasya cintitaṃ jñātvā gaṅgā yātā nṛpottama
children.translated_text: Knowing what he had thought, <s>Gaṅgā</s> came, O best of kings,

children.text: śataśṛṅgagirer mūrdhni hrādinī paryavartata ||
children.translated_text: and the resounding goddess moved upon the summit of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s> mountain.

children.text: gaṅgādhāreti tām āhur munayas tattvadarśinaḥ
children.translated_text: The sages who see reality call her <s>Gaṅgādhārā</s>.

children.text: dṛśyādṛśyeva sā devī plāvayāmāsa gośrutim ||
children.translated_text: That goddess, both visible and invisible, flooded <s>Gośruti</s>.

children.text: saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatra snānād vinaśyati ||
children.translated_text: Sin committed over seven births is destroyed by bathing there.

children.text: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe gokarṇakhaṇḍe gokarṇamāhātmye sāroddhāre saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus, in the glorious <s>Skanda Mahāpurāṇa</s>, in the <s>Gokarṇakhaṇḍa</s>, in the <s>Gokarṇamāhātmya</s>, in the extracted essence, ends the seventh chapter.

children.text: Chapter 8
purā kharāsuro gatvā śataśṛṅgaṃ mahāgirim
children.translated_text: In ancient times the demon <s>Khara</s> went to the great mountain <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>,

children.text: krīḍāvanagatāṃ tatra pārvatīṃ sa dadarśa ha ||
children.translated_text: and there he saw <s>Pārvatī</s>, who had gone into a pleasure grove.

children.text: prāptukāmas tu tāṃ pāpas tapo ghoram atapyata
children.translated_text: The sinful one, desiring to obtain her, practiced terrible austerity.

children.text: tatas tuṣṭaṃ maheśānam uvācāsurapuṅgavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, when <s>Maheśāna</s> was pleased, that foremost asura spoke:

children.text: khara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Khara</s> said:

children.text: yasya mūrdhni kṣipe hastaṃ bhasmasāt sa bhaved vibho
children.translated_text: O lord, may anyone on whose head I place my hand become ash.

children.text: tathāstv iti śivenokto hastaṃ tasyaiva mūrdhani ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Śiva</s> said, "So be it," he raised his hand toward that very one's head;

children.text: nikṣeptum udyato duṣṭaḥ śivas tasmād adhāvata
children.translated_text: as the wicked one was about to set it down, <s>Śiva</s> ran away from him.

children.text: viṣṇum etyāha tad vṛttaṃ viṣṇur māyāṃ prasṛṣṭavān ||
children.translated_text: Going to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, he told what had happened, and <s>Viṣṇu</s> sent forth a magic illusion.

children.text: ekāṃśenānugaḥ śambhor aindrīṃ diśam adhāvata
children.translated_text: With one portion he followed <s>Śambhu</s> and ran toward the eastern quarter;

children.text: pareṇāṃśena dhṛtavān strīrūpāṃ mohinīṃ tanum ||
children.translated_text: with another portion he assumed a female body in the form of <s>Mohinī</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cakame daityas tadā vismṛtya pārvatīm
children.translated_text: Seeing her, the daitya desired her then and forgot <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: uvāca subhage kāsi kasyāsi varavarṇini ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Lovely one, who are you, and to whom do you belong, beautiful woman?

children.text: hiraṇyakaśiporvaṃśe jāto 'haṃ lokaviśrutaḥ
children.translated_text: I was born in the lineage of <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>, famous in the world.

children.text: tapasā śivam ārādhya varaṃ labdhvānyadurlabham ||
children.translated_text: By austerity I propitiated <s>Śiva</s> and obtained a boon hard for others to obtain:

children.text: yanmūrdhni nikṣipe hastaṃ sa bhaved bhasmasāt dhruvam
children.translated_text: whoever's head I place my hand upon will certainly become ash.

children.text: śivaṃ hatvā tu tāṃ gaurīṃ rameyam iti me matiḥ ||
children.translated_text: My thought is that, after killing <s>Śiva</s>, I will sport with that <s>Gaurī</s>.

children.text: paraṃ madanurūpā tvaṃ tava cāham anindite
children.translated_text: But you are especially suited to me, and I am suited to you, O blameless one.

children.text: ehi sārdhaṃ mayā subhrūḥ suciraṃ ramayasva māṃ ||
children.translated_text: Come, beautiful-browed one; enjoy yourself with me for a long time."

children.text: mohiny uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Mohinī</s> said:

children.text: vivāho vā vivādo vā praśastas tulyayoḥ kila
children.translated_text: Marriage or dispute is said to be proper between equals.

children.text: balī labdhavaraś ca tvam eṣā labdhavarābalā ||
children.translated_text: You are strong and have received a boon; I am a weak woman who has also received a boon.

children.text: ato me tadvaraṃ datvā labhasva upayamaṃ sukham
children.translated_text: Therefore give that boon to me, and obtain the pleasure of marriage.

children.text: tathety uktvā kharas tasyai īśāl labdhavaraṃ dadau ||
children.translated_text: Saying "So be it," <s>Khara</s> gave her the boon he had received from the Lord.

children.text: kāmāndhas tāṃ copasṛtya parirambhodyato 'bhavat
children.translated_text: Blinded by desire, he approached her and was about to embrace her.

children.text: tāvat sā vāmahastena tasya kaṇṭhe nipīḍya ca ||
children.translated_text: Just then she pressed his neck with her left hand,

children.text: mūrdhni dakṣakaraṃ nyasyāśapad bhasmī bhaveti tam
children.translated_text: and, placing her right hand on his head, cursed him, saying, "Become ash."

children.text: kharāsuraḥ sadya eva bhasmaśeṣo babhūva ha ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kharāsura</s> immediately became nothing but ash.

children.text: tato devāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vavṛṣus tatra pārthiva
children.translated_text: Then the gods rained down a shower of flowers there, O earthly ruler.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: upasaṃhṛtya bhagavān strīrūpaṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One, whose banner bears <s>Garuḍa</s>, withdrew the female form.

children.text: uvāca śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇus tava śatrur hato mayā
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> said to <s>Śaṅkara</s>, "Your enemy has been killed by me."

children.text: ity ukto viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ vaitaraṇyāḥ samutthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus addressed, he rose up from the <s>Vaitaraṇī</s> together with <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: yasmād deśād upākrāmat tad unmajjanam ucyate
children.translated_text: The place from which he stepped out is called <s>Unmajjana</s>.

children.text: tīrthānām uttamaṃ tīrthaṃ nadī vaitaraṇīti sā ||
children.translated_text: That river, the <s>Vaitaraṇī</s>, is the highest <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford) among <s>tīrtha</s>s.

children.text: unmajjanapurobhāge sarvatīrthasamanvitā
children.translated_text: In the area before <s>Unmajjana</s>, endowed with all <s>tīrtha</s>s,

children.text: dṛśyādṛśyā nadī bhūtvā koṭitīrthaṃ samāviśat ||
children.translated_text: the river, becoming visible and invisible, entered <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>.

children.text: sambhūya tāmragauryā sā samudraṃ praviveśa ha
children.translated_text: Joining with <s>Tāmragaurī</s>, she entered the ocean.

children.text: vaitaraṇyāṃ naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
children.translated_text: A man who bathes in the <s>Vaitaraṇī</s> is released from all sins.

children.text: unmajjane naraḥ snāto rājate khe yathoḍurāṭ
children.translated_text: A man who has bathed at <s>Unmajjana</s> shines like the moon in the sky.

children.text: tasmin siddhaḥ purā nāga elāpatro mahābalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There, in former times, the mighty serpent <s>Elāpatra</s> attained accomplishment.

children.text: elāvanam iti khyātam abhitonmajjanān nṛpa
children.translated_text: O king, the region around <s>Unmajjana</s> is known as <s>Elāvana</s>.

children.text: tato hariharau yātau nārāyaṇapuraṃ śubham ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Hari</s> and <s>Hara</s> went to the auspicious <s>Nārāyaṇapura</s>.

children.text: uvāca śaṅkaraḥ śauriṃ strīrūpaṃ tat pradarśaya
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said to <s>Śauri</s>, "Show me that female form."

children.text: darśayitvā tu tad rūpaṃ śaṅkarāya tadā hariḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Hari</s> showed that form to <s>Śaṅkara</s>,

children.text: ācaṣṭa sarvavṛttāntaṃ kharāsuravadhe kṛtam
children.translated_text: and related the whole affair done in the slaying of <s>Kharāsura</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭvātisundaraṃ rūpaṃ śaṅkaro vismito 'bhavat ||
children.translated_text: Seeing the exceedingly beautiful form, <s>Śaṅkara</s> was amazed.

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: rūpeṇānena tiṣṭhātra mayā saha janārdana
children.translated_text: With this form, stay here together with me, O <s>Janārdana</s>.

children.text: ity uktvāliṅgya tāṃ devo naranārīśvaro 'bhavat ||
children.translated_text: Having said this and embraced her, the god became <s>Naranārīśvara</s>.

children.text: tasminn eva pure devāv ekamūrtidharau smṛtau
children.translated_text: In that very town the two gods are remembered as bearing a single form.

children.text: puraṃ hariharaṃ nāma gokarṇe surapūjitam ||
children.translated_text: The town in <s>Gokarṇa</s>, worshiped by the gods, is named <s>Harihara</s>.

children.text: tasmin dānāni dattāni devabhogyāni sattama
children.translated_text: O best one, gifts given there become fit for divine enjoyment.

children.text: triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ dātā svargam avāpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: The giver obtains heaven together with those born in twenty-one generations of his family.

children.text: pure harihare cāsti maṇḍapatritayaṃ nṛpa
children.translated_text: And in the town of <s>Harihara</s> there are three <s>maṇḍapa</s>s (pavilions), O king:

children.text: vairāgyadaṃ jñānadaṃ ca muktidaṃ ca nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: one grants dispassion, one grants knowledge, and one grants liberation, O best of kings.

children.text: uttarasyāṃ sthitaṃ yat tu vairāgyaṃ maṇḍapaṃ smṛtam
children.translated_text: The one situated to the north is remembered as the <s>Vairāgya</s> <s>maṇḍapa</s>.

children.text: tatra māsam uṣitvā tu gāyatrījapam ācaret ||
children.translated_text: After dwelling there for a month, one should perform recitation of the <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: devayoḥ purato yat tu maṇḍapaṃ jñānadaṃ viduḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>maṇḍapa</s> that stands before the two gods is known as the knowledge-granting one.

children.text: aṣṭākṣaraṃ japen mantraṃ tatra māsaṃ nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: There one should recite the eight-syllabled <s>mantra</s> for a month, O best of kings.

children.text: sa jñānaṃ sulabhaṃ labdhvā viṣṇusāyujyam āpnuyāt
children.translated_text: Having easily obtained knowledge, he attains <s>Viṣṇu-sāyujya</s> (union with <s>Viṣṇu</s>).

children.text: tatra nairṛtyadigbhāge sthitaṃ vai muktimaṇḍapam ||
children.translated_text: There, in the southwestern quarter, stands indeed the <s>muktimaṇḍapa</s> (liberation pavilion).

children.text: tasmin mṛtāś ca ye kecit pāpātmāno 'pi mānavāḥ
children.translated_text: Those human beings who die there, even if they are sinful-minded,

children.text: sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim ||
children.translated_text: are freed from all sins and attain the supreme state.

children.text: prayāṇasamaye yas tu tatra śete hariṃ smaran
children.translated_text: But whoever, at the time of departure, lies there remembering <s>Hari</s>,

children.text: nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kurvant samīpaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and performs the chanting of the Name, to him <s>Puruṣottama</s>,

children.text: āgatya dayayā tasya svakaraṃ mūrdhni nikṣipan
children.translated_text: coming near out of compassion and placing his own hand on his head,

children.text: brahmopadeśaṃ kurute sa brahmā jāyate dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: gives instruction in <s>brahman</s>; he surely becomes <s>Brahman</s>.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: dharmarājasya duhitā nadī vaitaraṇī nṛpa
children.translated_text: O king, the river <s>Vaitaraṇī</s> was the daughter of <s>Dharmarāja</s>.

children.text: svabhartur varuṇasyaiṣā saṃketaṃ na yayau yataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Since this wife of <s>Varuṇa</s> did not go to the rendezvous with her own husband,

children.text: tataḥ śaśāpa tāṃ bhartā śoṇitodā nadī bhava
children.translated_text: thereupon her husband cursed her: "Become a river whose water is blood."

children.text: tataḥ prasādayāmāsa bhartāraṃ sā śucismitā ||
children.translated_text: Then she, with a pure smile, propitiated her husband.

children.text: tataḥ prasannas tām āha bhartā hariharau śubhe
children.translated_text: Then, pleased, her husband said to her, "O auspicious one, when <s>Hari</s> and <s>Hara</s>

children.text: yadā pātālalokasthau tadā yāhi rasātalam ||
children.translated_text: are abiding in the underworld, then go down to <s>Rasātala</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā hariharau tatra tapaś cara suduścaram
children.translated_text: Having seen <s>Hari</s> and <s>Hara</s> there, perform a very difficult austerity;

children.text: tatas tayoḥ prasādena śāpamokṣo bhavet dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: then by their favor release from the curse will surely come about."

children.text: ity uktā patinā sā tu rudhirodā nadī hy abhūt
children.translated_text: Thus addressed by her husband, she indeed became a river of blood.

children.text: tataḥ pātālam āgatya dṛṣṭvā hariharau nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Then, having come to <s>Pātāla</s> and seen <s>Hari</s> and <s>Hara</s>, O king,

children.text: tapasā toṣya tau devau śāpān muktā babhūva sā
children.translated_text: she pleased the two gods with austerity and became freed from the curse.

children.text: vaitaraṇyā samaṃ devau pātālād ūrdhvam āgatau ||
children.translated_text: The two gods came up from <s>Pātāla</s> together with <s>Vaitaraṇī</s>.

children.text: bhartṛśāpād vimuktā sā patyā ca saha saṃsthitā
children.translated_text: Freed from her husband's curse, she remained together with her husband.

children.text: tasyāṃ snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A person who bathes in her is as one who has bathed in all <s>tīrtha</s>s (sacred fords).

children.text: tasmād unmajjanītīrthād āgneyyāṃ diśi pārthiva
children.translated_text: From that <s>Unmajjanī-tīrtha</s>, in the southeastern direction, O earthly ruler,

children.text: durgādevī yaśodāyāṃ prādurbhūtāntarikṣagā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Durgādevī</s>, born to <s>Yaśodā</s>, appeared as one moving through the sky.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya vaitaraṇyāḥ samīpataḥ
children.translated_text: Having reached the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, near the <s>Vaitaraṇī</s>,

children.text: tīrthaṃ sunirmalaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ kṛtvā suniścalā ||
children.translated_text: having made a very pure <s>tīrtha</s> and practiced austerity, steadfast,

children.text: viṣṇuvākyāt tato devī vindhyācalam agān nṛpa
children.translated_text: then, by the word of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the goddess went to <s>Vindhyācala</s>, O king.

children.text: ekāṃśenāvasat tatra śataśṛṅgataṭe śubhe ||
children.translated_text: With one portion she dwelt there on the auspicious slope of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā pāṇḍusuto rājā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
children.translated_text: Long ago King <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>, son of <s>Pāṇḍu</s> and son of <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: bhuvaṃ pradakṣiṇīkurvan gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āgamat ||
children.translated_text: while circumambulating the earth, came to the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: ādau snātvā koṭitīrthe pūjayitvā mahābalam
children.translated_text: First, after bathing at <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> and worshiping <s>Mahābala</s>,

children.text: śataśṛṅgataṭe ramye tīrthaṃ kṛtvā sunirmalam ||
children.translated_text: on the lovely slope of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s> he made a very pure <s>tīrtha</s>.

children.text: vārṣikāṃś caturo māsān uṣitvā tatra pāṇḍavaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Pāṇḍava</s>, having dwelt there for the four months of the rainy season,

children.text: tato dvaitavanaṃ prāyād bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pārthiva ||
children.translated_text: then went to <s>Dvaitavana</s> with his brothers, O earthly ruler.

children.text: tad etat pāṇḍavaṃ tīrthaṃ yatrovāsa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
children.translated_text: This is that <s>Pāṇḍava-tīrtha</s>, where <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> stayed.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: rāvaṇādīn raṇe hatvā rāmo rākṣasapuṅgavān ||
children.translated_text: Having slain <s>Rāvaṇa</s> and the other foremost <s>Rākṣasa</s>s in battle,

children.text: kṛtābhiṣeko rājendra ayodhyām adhyatiṣṭhata
children.translated_text: and having been consecrated, O king of kings, <s>Rāma</s> ruled <s>Ayodhyā</s>.

children.text: tato 'gastyamukhācchrutvā rāvaṇaṃ brahmavaṃśajam ||
children.translated_text: Then, after hearing from the mouth of <s>Agastya</s> that <s>Rāvaṇa</s> was born in <s>Brahmā</s>'s lineage,

children.text: brahmahatyābhayād bhīto vasiṣṭhoktyā tato 'gamat
children.translated_text: fearing the sin of <s>brahmahatyā</s>, he then went at <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>'s instruction,

children.text: sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyuktas tathā vāyusutena ca ||
children.translated_text: accompanied by <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, and also by the son of <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya tapaḥ kṛtvā suniścalam
children.translated_text: Having reached the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, he performed firm austerity;

children.text: pratyakṣīkṛtya giriśaṃ hatyāpāpād vimuktavān ||
children.translated_text: having made <s>Giriśa</s> visible before him, he was freed from the sin of killing.

children.text: kṣetrayātrāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayitvā mahābalam
children.translated_text: Then, having made a pilgrimage around the field and worshiped <s>Mahābala</s>,

children.text: ayodhyāṃ svāṃ purīṃ gatvā yathāpūrvam atiṣṭhata ||
children.translated_text: he went to his own city, <s>Ayodhyā</s>, and remained as before.

children.text: rāmatīrthe snānamātrād brahmahatyā vinaśyati
children.translated_text: Merely by bathing in <s>Rāmatīrtha</s>, <s>brahmahatyā</s> (the sin of killing a Brahmin) is destroyed.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā kṛtiyuge tāta vaidarbhaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Long ago in the <s>Kṛtayuga</s>, dear one, the king of the <s>Vidarbha</s>s,

children.text: bhīmo nāma svatanaye rājyaṃ nyasya vanaṃ yayau
children.translated_text: named <s>Bhīma</s>, entrusted the kingdom to his son and went to the forest.

children.text: patnyā saha viraktaḥ san śataśṛṅgaṃ mahāgirim ||
children.translated_text: Together with his wife, being detached, he went to the great mountain <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>,

children.text: tapas tepe nirāhāro ghoram uddiśya śaṅkaram
children.translated_text: and practiced terrible austerity, without food, directed toward <s>Śaṅkara</s>.

children.text: pratyakṣīkṛtya giriśaṃ śāśvataṃ svargam āptavān ||
children.translated_text: Having made <s>Giriśa</s> visible before him, he obtained eternal heaven.

children.text: tīrthaṃ tad etan nṛpate sarvapāpaharaṃ param
children.translated_text: This <s>tīrtha</s>, O king, is supreme, removing all sins;

children.text: bhīmakuṇḍam iti khyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam ||
children.translated_text: it is known as <s>Bhīmakuṇḍa</s>, famed in all worlds.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: bhṛguvaṃśodbhavaḥ pūrvam aurvo nāma mahāmuniḥ
children.translated_text: Formerly, a great sage named <s>Aurva</s>, born from the lineage of <s>Bhṛgu</s>,

children.text: krodhāviṣṭas tapas tepe dagdhukāmaś carācaram ||
children.translated_text: possessed by anger, practiced austerity, wishing to burn the moving and unmoving world.

children.text: gokarṇe śataśṛṅge tu rudram ārādhayan ciram
children.translated_text: At <s>Gokarṇa</s>, on <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>, worshiping <s>Rudra</s> for a long time,

children.text: pratyakṣīkṛtya sa śivaṃ trilokīdāhano hy abhūt ||
children.translated_text: he made <s>Śiva</s> visible before him and became the burner of the three worlds.

children.text: jvālāmālī vivṛddhaś ca dṛṣṭvā brahmā vibhāvasum
children.translated_text: Seeing that fire, wreathed in flames and grown great, <s>Brahmā</s>

children.text: devaiḥ samaṃ prārthayitvā viṣṇur gokarṇaṃ āgamat ||
children.translated_text: prayed together with the gods, and <s>Viṣṇu</s> came to <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: cakreṇa veṣṭayāmāsa taṃ vahniṃ madhusūdanaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Madhusūdana</s> encircled that fire with his discus,

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ tu candraṃ saṃsthāpya aurvam āha janārdanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and, setting the moon above, <s>Janārdana</s> said to <s>Aurva</s>:

children.text: kopaḥ saṃhriyatāṃ vipra saṃhāro nocito 'dhunā
children.translated_text: "Withdraw your anger, O Brahmin; destruction is not proper now.

children.text: ante saṃhārakas tvaṃ vai bhava vipra madājñayā ||
children.translated_text: At the end, by my command, you shall indeed be the destroyer, O Brahmin.

children.text: tīrtham aurvākhyam iti tat khyātaṃ bhavatu sarvataḥ
children.translated_text: Let that <s>tīrtha</s> be famous everywhere by the name <s>Aurva</s>."

children.text: ity uktvā bhagavān viṣṇur devaiḥ sārdhaṃ tirodadhe ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, blessed <s>Viṣṇu</s> disappeared together with the gods.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: mātṛdāsyavimokṣārthaṃ garuḍaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ
children.translated_text: For the sake of freeing his mother from servitude, <s>Garuḍa</s>, best of birds,

children.text: jitvā devāsurān yuddhe sudhām āhṛtavān purā ||
children.translated_text: after conquering the gods and asuras in battle, formerly brought the nectar.

children.text: garuḍena nṛpaśreṣṭha nikṣiptaṃ yatra cāmṛtam
children.translated_text: Where the nectar was set down by <s>Garuḍa</s>, O best of kings,

children.text: tatrābhavac cāndratīrthaṃ sarvarogavināśakaṃ ||
children.translated_text: there arose <s>Cāndratīrtha</s>, destroying all diseases.

children.text: tatra cauṣadhajātāni jajñire trīṇi pārthiva
children.translated_text: There, O earthly ruler, three kinds of medicinal plants were born:

children.text: somamālī sumālī ca samālī ceti ca trayam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Somamālī</s>, <s>Sumālī</s>, and <s>Samālī</s>, these three.

children.text: mahatā tapasā labhyāny alabhyāni ca pāpinām
children.translated_text: They are obtainable through great austerity and unobtainable for sinners.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: candrāya pradadau dakṣaḥ saptaviṃśati kanyakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dakṣa</s> gave twenty-seven daughters to <s>Candra</s>.

children.text: tāsāṃ madhye surūpaikā caturthī rohiṇī śubhā
children.translated_text: Among them there was one beautiful one, the auspicious fourth, <s>Rohiṇī</s>.

children.text: sarvāḥ striyaḥ parityajya tām eva ramayaty ayam ||
children.translated_text: Abandoning all the women, he delights only in her.

children.text: tato dakṣaḥ prakupitaś cāśapac candram añjasā
children.translated_text: Then <s>Dakṣa</s>, angered, at once cursed <s>Candra</s>,

children.text: kṣayarogī bhava tvaṃ hi strīṇāṃ bhedakaro yataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Become afflicted with wasting disease, for you are one who creates division among women."

children.text: tataḥ kṣayābhibhūtas tu candramāḥ pitṛvākyataḥ
children.translated_text: Then the moon, overcome by wasting disease because of his father-in-law's words,

children.text: nirvṛtiṃ tapasānvicchan gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āgamat ||
children.translated_text: came to the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, seeking relief through austerity.

children.text: somatīrthaṃ samāsādya toṣayāmāsa śaṅkaram
children.translated_text: Having reached <s>Somatīrtha</s>, he pleased <s>Śaṅkara</s>,

children.text: tadā śāpād vimukto 'bhūt siddhiṃ prāpya maheśvarāt ||
children.translated_text: and then, freed from the curse, he obtained success from <s>Maheśvara</s>.

children.text: mūrdhni sthānam avāpāgryaṃ śivasya dvijarāṭ tadā
children.translated_text: At that time the moon, king of the twice-born, obtained the foremost place on <s>Śiva</s>'s head.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: tvaṣṭuḥ prajāpateḥ kanyā bhāryā sūryasya cābhavat ||
children.translated_text: The daughter of Prajāpati <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> became the wife of <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: sā 'sahantī bhartṛtejaḥ pitṛveśma jagāma ha
children.translated_text: Unable to bear her husband's heat, she went to her father's house.

children.text: taj jñātvā savitā cāpi tvaṣṭur geham upāgamat ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, <s>Savitṛ</s> also came to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>'s house.

children.text: tatas tvaṣṭā sahāmantrya tridaśaiḥ saha pārthiva
children.translated_text: Then <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, after consulting together with the gods, O king,

children.text: tejo viśātayāmāsa yantram āropya taṃ śanaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: set him on a device and gradually reduced his brilliance.

children.text: yat tadaṃśo 'patad rājan śataśṛṅgataṭe śubhe
children.translated_text: The portion of that splendor which fell, O king, on the auspicious bank of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>,

children.text: tat saṃgṛhya śivaś cakre raudraṃ cakraṃ sudarśanam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> gathered and made into the fierce discus <s>Sudarśana</s>.

children.text: tat sūryatīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ yatra kīrṇaṃ maho raveḥ
children.translated_text: That is famed as <s>Sūryatīrtha</s>, where the great splendor of <s>Ravi</s> was scattered.

children.text: tatra snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A man who bathes there has bathed in every <s>tīrtha</s>.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: nāgarājaḥ api siddhyarthaṃ tapas tepe atidāruṇam
children.translated_text: The serpent king too, for the sake of accomplishment, performed exceedingly severe austerity.

children.text: tasya tattapasā rājan śivaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ||
children.translated_text: By that austerity of his, O king, <s>Śiva</s> became visible.

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nāgarāja dadāmi te
children.translated_text: "Choose a boon; may there be welfare for you, O serpent king. I grant it to you."

children.text: ananta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Ananta</s> said:

children.text: bale dhairye tathā dhurye na matto hy adhiko bhavet ||
children.translated_text: "In strength, in firmness, and likewise in bearing burdens, may there be no one greater than me."

children.text: jñānaṃ dehi mahādeva tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhaved idam
children.translated_text: "Give me knowledge, O <s>Mahādeva</s>, and may this <s>tīrtha</s> be the best."

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: tathāstv iti śivo 'py uktvā tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
children.translated_text: Having said, "So be it," <s>Śiva</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: tato 'nantaḥ praviśyābdhiṃ jalamārgeṇa pārthiva
children.translated_text: Then <s>Ananta</s>, entering the ocean by a water-path, O lord of earth,

children.text: svasthānam agamat so 'pi nāgendraiḥ saṃstutaḥ svayam ||
children.translated_text: went to his own place, himself praised by the chiefs of serpents.

children.text: tato 'nantadṛṣad rājan pāṣāṇo lokaviśrutaḥ
children.translated_text: Then, O king, the stone of <s>Ananta</s> is a rock famed in the world.

children.text: śilāyāṃ dṛśyate mārgaḥ samudre ca narādhipa ||
children.translated_text: A path is visible in the rock and in the sea, O lord of men.

children.text: śilāyāṃ vartate tīrthaṃ nāgarājasya pārthiva
children.translated_text: In that rock, O king, is the <s>tīrtha</s> of the serpent king.

children.text: tasmint snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A man who bathes in it has bathed in every <s>tīrtha</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā tac ca śilāmārgaṃ sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet
children.translated_text: And by seeing that rocky path, all sin is destroyed.

children.text: sarvadevamayaḥ sākṣāc chiṃśumāraḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiśumāra</s> Prajāpati, visibly composed of all the gods,

children.text: tapas tepe nirāhāraḥ siddhim icchan purā nṛpa
children.translated_text: in ancient times, O king, desiring accomplishment, performed austerity while taking no food.

children.text: ghoreṇa tapasā tasya tutoṣa bhagavān haraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Through his dreadful austerity, the blessed <s>Hara</s> was pleased with him.

children.text: pratyakṣam agamat tasya varaṃ brūhīti cābravīt
children.translated_text: He came before him and said, "Ask for a boon."

children.text: śiśumāra uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiśumāra</s> said:

children.text: siddhim icchāmi bhagavan parāṃ siddhiṃ pradehi me ||
children.translated_text: "I desire accomplishment, Blessed One; grant me supreme accomplishment."

children.text: tīrthaṃ mannāmakaṃ bhūyāt snātāḥ siddhā bhavantu vai
children.translated_text: "May a <s>tīrtha</s> bearing my name come into being, and may those who bathe there become accomplished."

children.text: īśvara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Īśvara</s> said:

children.text: siddhir bhavatu te cātra snātāḥ siddhā bhavantu vai ||
children.translated_text: "May accomplishment be yours here, and may those who bathe here indeed become accomplished."

children.text: tīrtham etac chiṃśumāra tvannāmnā khyātim eṣyati
children.translated_text: "This <s>tīrtha</s>, O <s>Śiśumāra</s>, will become famous by your name."

children.text: ity uktvā bhagavāñśambhus tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, the blessed <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: tattīrthasnānamātreṇa sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
children.translated_text: By merely bathing in that <s>tīrtha</s>, one obtains all desires.

children.text: prāṇināṃ kṣetrabhūtaṃ tad gokarṇaṃ kṣetram uttamam ||
children.translated_text: That <s>Gokarṇa</s>, the supreme sacred field, has become a holy field for living beings.

children.text: iti śrīskānde gokarṇakhaṇḍe śrīgokarṇamāhātmye aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the eighth chapter in the glorious <s>Gokarṇamāhātmya</s> of the <s>Gokarṇakhaṇḍa</s> of the glorious <s>Skanda</s>.

children.text: Chapter 9
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: sanatkumāro bhagavān gokarṇāt krośamātrataḥ
children.translated_text: The blessed <s>Sanatkumāra</s>, at a distance of one <s>krośa</s> from <s>Gokarṇa</s>,

children.text: kṛtvāśramapadaṃ tatra tapas tepe suduścaraṃ ||
children.translated_text: made an āśrama site there and performed very difficult austerity.

children.text: tatas tasyāpi bhagavān āvirāsīt sadāśivaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the blessed <s>Sadāśiva</s> appeared even to him,

children.text: sanatkumāraṃ bhagavāṃs tuṣṭo 'smīty āha taṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: and the Lord said to <s>Sanatkumāra</s>, "I am pleased," O king.

children.text: sanatkumāra uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:

children.text: liṅgam etan narāḥ spṛṣṭvā svargaṃ gacchanty avāritāḥ
children.translated_text: "May men who touch this <s>liṅga</s> go to heaven unhindered."

children.text: yogeśvarābhidhānena trailokye viśrutaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: "May it become renowned in the three worlds by the name <s>Yogeśvara</s>."

children.text: tathāstv iti hareṇoktvā liṅge tasmin vyalīyata
children.translated_text: After <s>Hara</s> said, "So be it," he dissolved into that <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: sanatkumāro nṛpate yathākāmaṃ jagāma ha ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sanatkumāra</s>, O king, went away as he wished.

children.text: tat spṛṣṭvā sarvabhūtāni svargaṃ gacchanty aharniśam
children.translated_text: Having touched it, all beings go to heaven day and night,

children.text: mahāpātakayuktāś ca hy upapātakinas tathā ||
children.translated_text: even those burdened with great sins and also those guilty of lesser sins.

children.text: tiryagyonigatāś cāpi sarve 'pi nṛpasattama
children.translated_text: Even those gone into animal wombs, all of them, O best of kings,

children.text: pūrṇa āsīn nākaloko nāvakāśo hy abhūn nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: filled heaven; there was no room, O king.

children.text: tato brahmā samāgamya devaiś ca ṛṣibhiḥ saha
children.translated_text: Then <s>Brahmā</s>, coming together with the gods and sages,

children.text: pratyakṣīkṛtya lakṣmīśam idaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
children.translated_text: approached <s>Lakṣmīśa</s> in person and spoke these words:

children.text: sanatkumāreṇa vibho gokarṇe sthāpitaṃ śubham
children.translated_text: "O Lord, the auspicious <s>liṅga</s> established in <s>Gokarṇa</s> by <s>Sanatkumāra</s>,

children.text: yogeśvarābhidhaṃ liṅgaṃ tat spṛṣṭvā prāṇino dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: called <s>Yogeśvara</s>: by touching it, living beings certainly

children.text: saśarīrā divaṃ prāptās tair vayaṃ bādhitā bhṛśam
children.translated_text: have reached heaven in their bodies, and by them we are greatly harassed."

children.text: tac chrutvā bhagavān viṣṇuś cakraṃ saṃgṛhya pāṇinā ||
children.translated_text: Hearing that, the blessed <s>Viṣṇu</s> took the discus in his hand,

children.text: devair brahmādibhiḥ sākam etya tal liṅgam ācchinat
children.translated_text: and, together with the gods headed by <s>Brahmā</s>, came and cut that <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: adhobhāgaḥ sthito bhūmau cakropari tathā paraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Its lower part remained on earth, and the other, upper part, on top of the discus.

children.text: magnam āsīt tadā cakraṃ bhāreṇa mahatā nṛpa
children.translated_text: Then the discus sank under its great weight, O king.

children.text: tatas tu viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ devā gokarṇasaṃsthitam ||
children.translated_text: Then the gods, together with <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: rudram ārādhayāmāsuḥ cakrārthaṃ te divaukasaḥ
children.translated_text: worshiped <s>Rudra</s>, who dwelt at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, for the sake of the discus.

children.text: śivo 'vatārayāmāsa pātāle tacchiro mahat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> caused that great top to descend into <s>Pātāla</s>.

children.text: tatas tasmāt punaś cakram uttatāra dvijottama
children.translated_text: Then, from that, the discus rose up again, O best of twice-born.

children.text: tac cakratīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
children.translated_text: That became famed as <s>Cakratīrtha</s>, the destroyer of all sin.

children.text: cakreṇa khaṇḍitatvāc ca cakrakhaṇḍeśvaro hy abhūt
children.translated_text: And because it had been split by the discus, he became <s>Cakrakhaṇḍeśvara</s>.

children.text: pūjayitvā tu tal liṅgaṃ dehānte svargam āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: Having worshiped that <s>liṅga</s>, at the end of life one reaches heaven.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā kṛtayuge rājan grahaṇe bhāskarasya ca
children.translated_text: Long ago in the <s>Kṛtayuga</s>, O king, at an eclipse of the sun,

children.text: puṣyamāse tadā lokāḥ sarve gokarṇam āyayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: in the month of <s>Puṣya</s>, all people came to <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā samitiṃ gaurī khe sthitā śaṅkaraṃ jagau
children.translated_text: Seeing that assembly, <s>Gaurī</s>, standing in the sky, addressed <s>Śaṅkara</s>:

children.text: kimarthaṃ tu mahādeva atrāgacchanti vai prajāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "For what reason, <s>Mahādeva</s>, are these people coming here?"

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: adyāparāhṇe grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati varānane
children.translated_text: "This afternoon, fair-faced one, an eclipse will occur.

children.text: tadā saṃpūjya māṃ bhaktyā sarve yānti triviṣṭapam ||
children.translated_text: Then, having worshiped me with devotion, they all go to heaven."

children.text: devy uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Devī</s> said:

children.text: sarve yadi divaṃ yānti nāvakāśo bhaved divi
children.translated_text: "If everyone goes to heaven, there would be no space in heaven."

children.text: tataḥ prahasya bhagavān śaṅkaras tām uvāca ha ||
children.translated_text: Then the blessed <s>Śaṅkara</s> laughed and said to her:

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: eṣāṃ madhye gamiṣyanti trayo nirvāṇam eva hi
children.translated_text: "Among these, only three will go to nirvāṇa.

children.text: kriyate yādṛśaṃ karma phalaṃ bhavati tādṛśam ||
children.translated_text: As the deed is performed, so is the fruit that comes.

children.text: darśayiṣye tava śive kiṃcid atra nidarśanam
children.translated_text: I shall show you here, O <s>Śivā</s>, a certain illustration."

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: tataḥ śivo bhavānī ca dhṛtvā gorūpam añjasā ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Bhavānī</s> at once assumed the form of a pair of cows

children.text: yātrikāṇāṃ dṛṣṭipathe paṅkamagnau sthitau nṛpa
children.translated_text: and stood, O king, sunk in mud within the sight of the pilgrims.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā gatāḥ sarve purukutso dvijottamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: All of them, after seeing them again and again, went on; but <s>Purukutsa</s>, the excellent Brahmin,

children.text: tad goyugmaṃ samuddhartuṃ prayatnaṃ kṛtavān bahu
children.translated_text: made great effort to lift up that pair of cows.

children.text: ātreyo nāma vipro 'pi tatsahāya upāgamat ||
children.translated_text: And a Brahmin named <s>Ātreya</s> came to assist him.

children.text: ubhāv api na śaktau tau suhotras tatra cāgamat
children.translated_text: Even the two of them were not able; and <s>Suhotra</s> came there.

children.text: te ca gomithunaṃ yatnād uddhṛtyātha siṣevire ||
children.translated_text: Then they lifted up the cow-pair with effort and served them

children.text: jalair bālatṛṇair aṅgamardanair vividhair nṛpa
children.translated_text: with water, tender grass, massages of the body, and various other services, O king.

children.text: tatas tadbhaktisaṃtuṣṭaḥ pratyakṣībhūya śaṅkaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śaṅkara</s>, pleased by that devotion, made himself manifest

children.text: uddadhāra bhavāmbhodhipaṅkamagnān dvijottamān
children.translated_text: and lifted those excellent Brahmins who were sunk in the mud of the ocean of becoming.

children.text: aho yal labhyate bhaktyā na tat karmaśatair api ||
children.translated_text: Ah, what is obtained by devotion is not obtained even by hundreds of ritual acts.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: yatra gomithunaṃ magnaṃ tīrthaṃ tat kapilaṃ viduḥ
children.translated_text: Where the cow-pair was sunk, that tīrtha is known as <s>Kapila</s>.

children.text: māsi bhādrapade kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhī bhaumārkasaṃyutā ||
children.translated_text: In the month of <s>Bhādrapada</s>, if the sixth day of the dark fortnight is joined with <s>Bhauma</s> and <s>Arka</s>,

children.text: rohiṇīpātayuktā cet sā ṣaṣṭhī kapilā smṛtā
children.translated_text: and if it is accompanied by the descent of <s>Rohiṇī</s>, that sixth day is remembered as <s>Kapilā</s>.

children.text: tadā tatra tu ye snānti bhavābdhiṃ te taranti vai ||
children.translated_text: Those who bathe there then cross the ocean of becoming.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: araṇyo nāma rājā tu rājyaṃ tyaktvā viraktimān
children.translated_text: A king named <s>Araṇya</s>, having renounced his kingdom and become detached,

children.text: putre rājyadhuraṃ nyasya gokarṇakṣetram āgamat ||
children.translated_text: placed the burden of rule upon his son and came to the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tīrthaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena tapas tepe nirāmayam
children.translated_text: Having performed the tīrtha according to rule, he practiced austerity free from affliction.

children.text: prasannīkṛtya deveśaṃ siddhiṃ prāpya maheśvarāt ||
children.translated_text: Having propitiated the lord of gods and obtained perfection from <s>Maheśvara</s>,

children.text: tatrovāsa yathākāmaṃ gokarṇe kṣetrasattame
children.translated_text: he lived there as he wished in <s>Gokarṇa</s>, the best of sacred fields.

children.text: tattīrthasnānamātreṇa rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||
children.translated_text: By merely bathing in that tīrtha one obtains the fruit of a <s>Rājasūya</s> sacrifice.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: sunādo nāma viprendraḥ pātālatalam āgamat
children.translated_text: A foremost Brahmin named <s>Sunāda</s> went to the nether region.

children.text: maṇināgān nāgarājād gṛhītvā liṅgam uttamam ||
children.translated_text: Taking an excellent liṅga from <s>Maṇināga</s>, the king of nāgas,

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādyāsthāpya liṅgaṃ manoramam
children.translated_text: he reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> and installed the lovely liṅga.

children.text: tadarcanaprabhāveṇa sāyujyam agamad ṛṣiḥ ||
children.translated_text: By the power of worshiping it, the sage attained sāyujya, union with the deity.

children.text: nādeśvaram iti khyātaṃ talliṅgaṃ bharatarṣabha
children.translated_text: That liṅga is famed as <s>Nādeśvara</s>, O bull of the <s>Bharatas</s>.

children.text: adhastād avane rājann idānīṃ tatra vartate ||
children.translated_text: Now, O king, it exists there below the earth.

children.text: tāḍyamāne padā tatra nādayaty avanītalam
children.translated_text: When it is struck by the foot there, it makes the ground resound.

children.text: tīrthaṃ tatra tu tasyaiva nādatīrtham iti śrutam ||
children.translated_text: The tīrtha there, belonging to that very one, is known as <s>Nādatīrtha</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭamātre tu talliṅge svargaṃ gacchanti dehinaḥ
children.translated_text: At the mere sight of that liṅga, embodied beings go to heaven.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: aśoko nāma rājāsīt plakṣadvīpādhipaḥ purā ||
children.translated_text: There was once a king named <s>Aśoka</s>, lord of <s>Plakṣadvīpa</s>.

children.text: tasya cāsīt putraśataṃ tathā pautrādisantatiḥ
children.translated_text: He had a hundred sons and likewise descendants, grandsons and the like.

children.text: kanyāśataṃ ca tasyāsīt svaṃ rājyaṃ paryapālayat ||
children.translated_text: He also had a hundred daughters, and he ruled his own kingdom.

children.text: tataḥ śatrur abhūt tasya sumatir nāma pārthivaḥ
children.translated_text: Then a king named <s>Sumati</s> became his enemy.

children.text: aśokasya purīṃ ruddhvā yuddhaṃ kṛtvā sudāruṇam ||
children.translated_text: Having besieged <s>Aśoka</s>'s city and fought a very terrible battle,

children.text: aśokaṃ nṛpatiṃ jitvā putrādīn avadhīt tataḥ
children.translated_text: he defeated King <s>Aśoka</s> and then killed his sons and the others.

children.text: tataḥ sa rājā saptāṅgaṃ hitvā vahneḥ prasādataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then that king, leaving behind the seven-limbed kingdom, by the favor of <s>Vahni</s>

children.text: labdhaṃ turagam āruhya jambudvīpaṃ yayau kṣaṇāt
children.translated_text: mounted a horse he had obtained and went in a moment to <s>Jambudvīpa</s>.

children.text: gokarṇe śataśṛṅgādrau dṛṣṭvā svasya pitāmahān ||
children.translated_text: At <s>Gokarṇa</s>, on Mount <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>, he saw his grandfathers:

children.text: agnidyutiṃ cāgnibāhuṃ medhāśvaṃ purum eva ca
children.translated_text: <s>Agnidyuti</s>, <s>Agnibāhu</s>, <s>Medhāśva</s>, and <s>Puru</s>.

children.text: teṣāṃ caivopadeśena taiḥ sākaṃ tapa ācarat ||
children.translated_text: Following their instruction, he practiced austerity together with them.

children.text: āvirbabhūva puratas tuṣṭo 'smīty āha tān śivaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s>, pleased, appeared before them and said, "I am satisfied."

children.text: aśoka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Aśoka</s> said:

children.text: śatruṇāpahṛtaṃ rājyaṃ putrapautrādi yad dhanam ||
children.translated_text: "The kingdom taken by my enemy, and the wealth consisting of sons, grandsons, and the rest,

children.text: tatsarvaṃ tvatprasādena labheya karuṇānidhe
children.translated_text: may I obtain all that by your favor, ocean of compassion."

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: na śokas te bhaved bhūyaḥ sarvaṃ prāpsyasi cintitam ||
children.translated_text: "You shall have no sorrow again; you will obtain everything you have thought of."

children.text: iti datvā varaṃ śambhus tatraivāntaradhīyata
children.translated_text: Having given this boon, <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: aśokaḥ svāṃ purīṃ prāpya yathāpūrvam atiṣṭhata ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aśoka</s>, having reached his own city, remained as before.

children.text: aśokapañcakam iti tīrthānāṃ pañcakaṃ viduḥ
children.translated_text: A group of five tīrthas is known as <s>Aśokapañcaka</s>.

children.text: snātvā vaiśākhapūrṇāyāṃ duṣṭasaṅgād vimucyate ||
children.translated_text: By bathing on the full moon of <s>Vaiśākha</s>, one is freed from evil company.

children.text: kāmāghanāśinī nadyāś cotpattiṃ kathayāmi te
children.translated_text: I shall tell you the origin of the river <s>Kāmāghanāśinī</s>.

children.text: harabhālāgninā dagdhaḥ pūrvaṃ kāmaḥ śucānvitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In former times <s>Kāma</s>, burned by the fire on <s>Hara</s>'s forehead and filled with grief,

children.text: śive kṛtasvāghaśāntyai triḥ parītya dharām imām
children.translated_text: circumambulated this earth three times to pacify his own offense committed against <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: anarho 'pi praveṣṭuṃ sa gokarṇaṃ kṣetram uttamam ||
children.translated_text: He was not fit to enter the excellent sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tasmāt kṣetrād bahiḥ sthitvā tapas tīvram atapyata
children.translated_text: Therefore he stood outside that sacred field and performed severe austerity.

children.text: divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāṅkaram ||
children.translated_text: For a thousand divine years he installed a liṅga of <s>Śaṅkara</s>.

children.text: tatas tuṣṭo mahādevo varayety āha taṃ nṛpa
children.translated_text: Then <s>Mahādeva</s>, pleased, said to him, "Choose a boon," O king.

children.text: stutvā taṃ manmatho vavre varān abhimatāṃs tadā ||
children.translated_text: Having praised him, <s>Manmatha</s> then chose the boons he desired.

children.text: manmatha uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Manmatha</s> said:

children.text: devānāṃ vacanāt pūrvaṃ tvayi droham akāriṣam
children.translated_text: "Earlier, at the word of the gods, I committed hostility against you.

children.text: taddoṣaśāntir me bhūyāc charīraṃ ca vṛṇe prabho ||
children.translated_text: May that fault be pacified for me, and I choose a body, lord.

children.text: kṣetrasyāntaḥ praveśaś ca tvayi bhaktiṃ ca śāśvatīm
children.translated_text: I also choose entry into the sacred field and eternal devotion to you."

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: vasudevagṛhe sākṣād bhagavān kamalāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: "When the blessed lord <s>Kamalāpati</s> himself, in the house of <s>Vasudeva</s>,

children.text: yadāvataraṇaṃ kuryāt tasya putratvam āpnuhi
children.translated_text: makes his descent, then obtain the state of being his son.

children.text: gokarṇe tvatpraveśārthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ karomy aham ||
children.translated_text: For the sake of your entry into <s>Gokarṇa</s>, I myself shall perform a prāyaścitta, an atonement."

children.text: ity uktvā bhagavān śambhus triśūlena tadā nṛpa
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the blessed lord <s>Śambhu</s> then, O king, with his trident

children.text: cakhāna bhūtalaṃ gaṅgā pātālād ūrdhvam āgatā ||
children.translated_text: pierced the surface of the earth, and <s>Gaṅgā</s> rose upward from the netherworld.

children.text: anujñātas tv īśvareṇa snānaṃ tatra yathāvidhi
children.translated_text: With <s>Īśvara</s>'s permission, after bathing there according to rule,

children.text: kṛtvā kāmo viśuddhātmā varaṃ vavre kṛpānidhim ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kāma</s>, purified in soul, chose a boon from the treasury of compassion.

children.text: kāma uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Kāma</s> said:

children.text: liṅgam etat pūjakānāṃ kāmadaṃ syāt sadāśiva
children.translated_text: O <s>Sadāśiva</s>, may this liṅga always grant desires to those who worship it,

children.text: aghanāśananāmnīyaṃ nadīnāṃ pravarā bhavet ||
children.translated_text: and may this river, named <s>Aghanāśanā</s>, become the foremost of rivers.

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: yad uktaṃ tu tvayā kāma tat sarvaṃ bhavati dhruvam
children.translated_text: What you have said, O <s>Kāma</s>, all of that shall certainly come to pass.

children.text: brahmahā gurutalpī vā svarṇasteyī ca mānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whether a man is a slayer of a Brahmin, a violator of his teacher's bed, or a thief of gold,

children.text: surāpānarato vāpi saṃyukto hy upapātakaiḥ
children.translated_text: or even one devoted to drinking liquor and joined with lesser sins,

children.text: snātvā sampūjya kāmeśaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
children.translated_text: having bathed and worshipped <s>Kāmeśa</s>, he is released from all sins.

children.text: ity uktvā bhagavāñchambhus tatraivāntaradhīyata
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the blessed <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: kāmo gokarṇam āsādya koṭitīrthasya pūrvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kāma</s>, having reached <s>Gokarṇa</s> to the east of <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>,

children.text: liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinā pūjayitvā ca bhaktitaḥ
children.translated_text: established a liṅga according to rule and worshipped it with devotion;

children.text: kṛtakṛtyatvam āpanno yathākāmam uvāsa ha ||
children.translated_text: having attained fulfillment, he lived there as he desired.

children.text: śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam
children.translated_text: Listen, O king: I shall tell an ancient account.

children.text: purā kaliṅgadeśīyo brāhmaṇaḥ śambhunāmakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Long ago there was a Brahmin from the land of <s>Kaliṅga</s>, named <s>Śambhu</s>.

children.text: sadā durjanasaṃyuktaḥ kāmacārī dvijādhamaḥ
children.translated_text: Always joined with wicked people, acting according to desire, he was the basest of twice-born men,

children.text: vimārganirato nityaṃ dyūtacauryaviśāradaḥ ||
children.translated_text: constantly intent on the wrong path and skilled in gambling and theft.

children.text: svakarmaṇaḥ parityāgī śūdravṛttirataḥ sadā
children.translated_text: He abandoned his own proper rites and was always devoted to the occupation of a Śūdra.

children.text: kadācid ardharātrau tu mātṛsaṅgam athākarot ||
children.translated_text: Then one midnight he had intercourse with his mother.

children.text: tena pāpena mahatā lokadūṣyo 'bhavan nṛpa
children.translated_text: Because of that great sin he became an object of public reproach, O king.

children.text: paścāt tāpābhibhūtaḥ san babhrāma jagatītale ||
children.translated_text: Afterwards, overcome by remorse, he wandered over the face of the earth,

children.text: tiraskṛtaḥ sa sarvaiś ca munibhir bhāvitātmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: rejected by all the sages whose selves were purified.

children.text: tato durvāsasaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya prāñjalir nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Then, seeing <s>Durvāsas</s>, he bowed down with joined palms, O king.

children.text: prasādyovāca vipraḥ saḥ durvāsās tu taponidhiḥ
children.translated_text: That Brahmin appeased him and spoke; but <s>Durvāsas</s>, a treasure of austerity,

children.text: prāha tvatkṛtapāpasya niṣkṛtir nāsti kutracit ||
children.translated_text: said, "There is no expiation anywhere for the sin you have committed.

children.text: tathāpi vakṣye pāpasya niṣkṛtiṃ śṛṇu bho dvija
children.translated_text: Nevertheless I shall tell you an expiation for the sin; listen, O Brahmin.

children.text: gokarṇākhyaṃ mahākṣetram asti pāpavināśanam ||
children.translated_text: There is a great sacred field called <s>Gokarṇa</s>, a destroyer of sin.

children.text: tatrāsti sarvapāpaghnī nadī kāmāghanāśinī
children.translated_text: There is the river <s>Kāmāghanāśinī</s>, destroyer of all sins,

children.text: śivatriśūlajanitā manmathasyāghaśāntaye ||
children.translated_text: born from <s>Śiva</s>'s trident for the pacification of <s>Manmatha</s>'s sin.

children.text: mātrā sahaiva tvaṃ gaccha tatra sthitvā vidhānataḥ
children.translated_text: Go there together with your mother, and remain there according to rule.

children.text: snātvā kāmāghanāśinyāṃ japan pañcākṣarīṃ manum ||
children.translated_text: Having bathed in <s>Kāmāghanāśinī</s>, reciting the five-syllabled mantra,

children.text: tatra kāmeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayasva vidhānataḥ
children.translated_text: worship there the <s>Kāmeśvara</s> liṅga according to rule."
