children.text: iti durvāsaso vākyaṃ śrutvā taṃ praṇipatya ca ||
children.translated_text: Having heard the speech of <s>Durvāsas</s> and bowed down to him,

children.text: kāmāghanāśinīṃ prāpya tatrovāsa ciraṃ dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: the Brahmin reached <s>Kāmāghanāśinī</s> and lived there for a long time.

children.text: snātvā kāmāghanāśinyāṃ kāmeśaṃ paripūjayan ||
children.translated_text: He bathed in <s>Kāmāghanāśinī</s> and fully worshipped <s>Kāmeśa</s>.

children.text: japan pañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ dvādaśābdam uvāsa ha
children.translated_text: Reciting the five-syllabled sacred formula, he stayed for twelve years.

children.text: tato gokarṇam āsādya koṭitīrthādiṣu kramāt ||
children.translated_text: Then, having reached <s>Gokarṇa</s>, at <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> and the other tīrthas in order,

children.text: snātvā sarveṣu tīrtheṣu talliṅgaṃ paripūjya ca
children.translated_text: he bathed in all the tīrthas and fully worshipped that liṅga.

children.text: kṛtakṛtyas tato bhūtvā yayau svabhavanaṃ dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, having become fulfilled, the Brahmin went to his own home.

children.text: svācāranirataḥ śānto babhūva dvijasattamaḥ
children.translated_text: Devoted to his proper conduct and peaceful, he became an excellent Brahmin.

children.text: mahāpātakayukto vā saṃyukto hy upapātakaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whether one is burdened with a great sin or joined with lesser sins,

children.text: snātvā kāmāghanāśinyāṃ naro mucyeta pātakaiḥ
children.translated_text: a man, after bathing in <s>Kāmāghanāśinī</s>, is released from his sins.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: paulastyaputrā rājendra bahavaḥ siddhim āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Many descendants of <s>Pulastya</s>, O lord of kings, attained siddhi,

children.text: gokarṇe rāvaṇaś caiva kumbhakarṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: and at <s>Gokarṇa</s> <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, <s>Kumbhakarṇa</s>, and <s>Vibhīṣaṇa</s>

children.text: tapas tepur nirāhārā brahmadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: performed austerities without food, devoted to meditation on <s>Brahmā</s>.

children.text: śirāṃsi svāni saṃchidya juhāva daśakandharaḥ
children.translated_text: Cutting off his own heads, <s>Daśakandhara</s> offered them in sacrifice.

children.text: dadau teṣāṃ varaṃ brahmā yathābhilaṣitaṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> gave them boons as each desired, O king.

children.text: aṇimādimahāsiddhim āyuryogaṃ ca rāvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Rāvaṇa</s> received great siddhis such as minuteness and long life,

children.text: avadhyatvaṃ sarvabhūtaiḥ ṛte mānuṣamātrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: and invulnerability from all beings, except from human beings alone.

children.text: kumbhakarṇo mahānidrāṃ kanīyāṃs tu vibhīṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Kumbhakarṇa</s> received great sleep, while the younger <s>Vibhīṣaṇa</s>

children.text: dharme ratiṃ viṣṇubhaktim amaratvaṃ ca labdhavān ||
children.translated_text: obtained delight in <s>dharma</s> (righteous order), devotion to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and immortality.

children.text: rāvaṇenārcitaṃ liṅgaṃ kumbhakarṇena pūjitam
children.translated_text: The liṅga honored by <s>Rāvaṇa</s> and worshipped by <s>Kumbhakarṇa</s>,

children.text: vibhīṣaṇeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayanti narā bhuvi ||
children.translated_text: and the <s>Vibhīṣaṇeśvara</s> liṅga, people worship on earth.

children.text: dīrghāyuṣo bhavanty addhā gokarṇe tadvane nṛpa
children.translated_text: They surely become long-lived at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, O king, in that grove

children.text: śleṣmātakam iti śreṣṭhaṃ sarvasiddhaniṣevitam ||
children.translated_text: called <s>Śleṣmātaka</s>, excellent and frequented by all siddhas.

children.text: hetir nāma prahetiś ca viśvacittir vidūrathaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Heti</s>, <s>Praheti</s>, <s>Viśvacitti</s>, and <s>Vidūratha</s>

children.text: ete cānye ca bahavas tatra siddhim upāgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and these and many others attained siddhi there.

children.text: rāvaṇādyā varaṃ labdhvā aiśvaryabaladarpitāḥ
children.translated_text: Having obtained boons, <s>Rāvaṇa</s> and the others became proud of sovereignty and strength.

children.text: mātṛvākyāt tadā yuddhe jitvā vaiśravaṇaṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Then, at their mother's command, they defeated <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s> in battle, O king.

children.text: apahṛtya purīṃ laṅkāṃ vimānam api puṣpakam
children.translated_text: After seizing the city of <s>Laṅkā</s> and also the <s>Puṣpaka</s> aerial car,

children.text: cakre laṅkāṃ rājadhānīṃ rākṣasaiḥ saha rāvaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Rāvaṇa</s> made <s>Laṅkā</s> his capital city together with the rākṣasas.

children.text: kuberas tu pitur vākyāt tapas taptuṃ suduścaram
children.translated_text: <s>Kubera</s>, however, at his father's command, set out to perform very difficult austerity.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya śleṣmātakavane śubhe ||
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, in the auspicious <s>Śleṣmātaka</s> forest,

children.text: liṅgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya tīrthaṃ kṛtvā tu bhaktitaḥ
children.translated_text: he installed a liṅga there and, with devotion, made a tīrtha.

children.text: tapas taptvā vidhānena pratyakṣīkṛtya śaṅkaram ||
children.translated_text: Performing austerity according to rule, he directly beheld <s>Śaṅkara</s>.

children.text: alakākhyāṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ nidhīn aṣṭau śriyaṃ tathā
children.translated_text: He obtained the lovely city called <s>Alakā</s>, the eight treasures, and prosperity,

children.text: udagdigādhipatyaṃ ca haramaitrīṃ tathā nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: as well as lordship over the northern quarter and friendship with <s>Hara</s>, O king.

children.text: labdhvā vaiśravaṇaḥ paścād adhyuvāsālakāṃ purīṃ
children.translated_text: Afterwards <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>, having obtained these, lived in the city of <s>Alakā</s>.

children.text: snātvā vaiśravaṇe tīrthe kubereśvaram arcayet ||
children.translated_text: One should bathe in <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s> tīrtha and worship <s>Kubereśvara</s>;

children.text: kārtike tu trayodaśyāṃ tasya lakṣmīḥ sthirā bhavet ||
children.translated_text: on the thirteenth lunar day in <s>Kārtika</s>, that person's <s>Lakṣmī</s> will become stable.

children.text: iti śrīskānde gokarṇakhaṇḍe śrīgokarṇamāhātmye navamo 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the ninth chapter in the <s>Śrī-Skanda</s>, in the <s>Gokarṇa-khaṇḍa</s>, in the <s>Śrī-Gokarṇa-māhātmya</s>.

children.text: Chapter 10
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā vivādo hy abhavad brahmaviṣṇvor nṛpottama
children.translated_text: Long ago there was indeed a dispute between <s>Brahmā</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, O best of kings:

children.text: ahaṃ śreṣṭhaś cāham iti tayor yuddham abhūt tadā ||
children.translated_text: each said, "I am the best; I am," and then a battle arose between them.

children.text: tatra hy āvirabhūl liṅgam īśvaraś cāyayau nṛpa
children.translated_text: There indeed a <s>liṅga</s> manifested, and <s>Īśvara</s> came, O king.

children.text: śivo 'py uvāca tau devau mābhūd vāṃ kalaho mithaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> also said to those two gods, "Let there be no quarrel between you two."

children.text: asya liṅgasya mūrdhānaṃ mūlaṃ vā yo 'bhipaśyati
children.translated_text: "Whoever beholds the top or the base of this <s>liṅga</s>,

children.text: sa śreṣṭha iti manye 'haṃ gacchataṃ śīghram eva hi ||
children.translated_text: I consider him the superior one; go quickly indeed."

children.text: ity ukte haṃsarūpeṇa brahmā draṣṭuṃ śiro yayau
children.translated_text: When this had been said, <s>Brahmā</s>, in the form of a swan, went to see the top.

children.text: viṣṇur varāharūpo 'dhaḥ mūlaṃ draṣṭum agān nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, in the form of a boar, went downward to see the base, O king.

children.text: dhāvann ūrdhvamukho brahmā madhye dṛṣṭvā tu ketakīṃ
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, racing with his face upward, saw a <s>Ketakī</s> flower in the middle,

children.text: liṅgāt tuṅgād vigalitāṃ tāṃ kṛtvā sākṣiṇīṃ vidhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: fallen from the lofty <s>liṅga</s>; <s>Vidhi</s> made her his witness.

children.text: śivasya sannidhiṃ prāpa viṣṇuḥ kūrmāvadhiṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: He reached <s>Śiva</s>'s presence; <s>Viṣṇu</s> had gone down as far as the tortoise,

children.text: liṅgamūlam adṛṣṭvaiva harasyāntikam āyayau ||
children.translated_text: and, without seeing the base of the <s>liṅga</s>, came into <s>Hara</s>'s presence.

children.text: tataḥ śivena pṛṣṭas tu brahmā provāca śaṅkaram
children.translated_text: Then, when questioned by <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Brahmā</s> spoke to <s>Śaṅkara</s>:

children.text: dṛṣṭaṃ mayā śira iti sākṣiṇī ketakī yataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "I have seen the top; for <s>Ketakī</s> is my witness."

children.text: ketaky api tathety āha viṣṇuṃ papraccha śaṅkaraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Ketakī</s> also said, "So it is." <s>Śaṅkara</s> asked <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: tato harir haraṃ prāha mayā mūlaṃ na lokitam ||
children.translated_text: and then <s>Hari</s> said to <s>Hara</s>, "The base was not seen by me."

children.text: kruddhaś cāsatyavacanāt ketakīm aśapat tadā
children.translated_text: Angered by the false statement, he then cursed <s>Ketakī</s>:

children.text: kūṭasākṣyāparādhena ayogyā bhava me 'rcane ||
children.translated_text: "Because of the offense of false witness, become unfit for my worship."

children.text: brahmāṇaṃ cāśapad rudro hy apūjyo bhava viṣṭape
children.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> also cursed <s>Brahmā</s>: "Become unworshiped in the world."

children.text: tena prīto hariṃ prāha bhava tvaṃ lokapūjitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Pleased by that, he said to <s>Hari</s>, "You shall be worshiped by the world."

children.text: tata utpādayāmāsa kopād utkaṭabhairavam
children.translated_text: Then, out of anger, he produced fierce <s>Bhairava</s>.

children.text: uvāca bhairavaṃ śambhuḥ sraṣṭur ūrdhvaṃ śiro hara ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śambhu</s> said to <s>Bhairava</s>, "Take off the upper head of the creator."

children.text: tac chrutvā bhairavaḥ śīghraṃ sraṣṭur ūrdhvaṃ śiro 'hanat
children.translated_text: Hearing this, <s>Bhairava</s> quickly struck off the creator's upper head.

children.text: sa brahmahatyāgrastaḥ san babhrāma jagatītalam ||
children.translated_text: Seized by <s>brahmahatyā</s> (the sin of killing a Brahmin), he wandered over the surface of the earth.

children.text: tato brahmā cintayitvā gokarṇaṃ prāpya tatra hi
children.translated_text: Then <s>Brahmā</s>, after reflecting, reached <s>Gokarṇa</s> there,

children.text: śataśṛṅgagirau liṅgaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā girer adhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and on Mount <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>, below the mountain, he made a <s>liṅga</s> and a <s>tīrtha</s>.

children.text: tapaḥ kṛtvā ca suciraṃ pratyakṣīkṛtya śaṅkaram
children.translated_text: Having practiced austerity for a very long time and made <s>Śaṅkara</s> manifest before him,

children.text: yajñe pūjām avāpya svāṃ mūrtiṃ saṃsthāpya tatra tu ||
children.translated_text: having obtained his own worship in sacrifice and established his image there,

children.text: satyalokaṃ yayau brahmā yathākāmaṃ kurūdvaha
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> went to <s>Satyaloka</s> as he wished, O descendant of <s>Kuru</s>.

children.text: brahmakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā brahmeśaṃ paripūjya ca ||
children.translated_text: A man, after bathing in <s>Brahmakuṇḍa</s> and fully worshiping <s>Brahmeśa</s>,

children.text: tanmūrtiṃ pūjayed rājan dīrghāyuṣmān bhavet dhruvam
children.translated_text: and worshiping his image, O king, will certainly become long-lived.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: ketaky apy āśramaṃ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ kṛtvā tu nirmalam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ketakī</s> too, having made a hermitage and made a pure <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: haraṃ saṃtoṣya tapasā bhaktyā cānanyapūrvayā
children.translated_text: satisfied <s>Hara</s> by austerity and by devotion that had no rival.

children.text: śivarātrau puṇyadine pūjāyogyā babhūva sā ||
children.translated_text: On the meritorious day of <s>Śivarātri</s>, she became fit for worship.

children.text: taddine tāṃ samādāya bhaktyā yaś cārcayec chivam
children.translated_text: Whoever takes her on that day and worships <s>Śiva</s> with devotion,

children.text: sarvakratuphalaṃ tasya bhavaty eva na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the fruit of all sacrifices indeed becomes his; there is no doubt.

children.text: kūṭasākṣyabhavaṃ pāpaṃ tatra snānād vinaśyati
children.translated_text: The sin born from false witness is destroyed by bathing there.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: bhairavo 'pi tataḥ prāpya gokarṇaṃ kṣatram uttamam ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Bhairava</s> also reached the excellent sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā cacāra sumahat tapaḥ
children.translated_text: Having made a hermitage there, he practiced very great austerity,

children.text: ghaṇṭākarṇena sahito divyavarṣasahasrakam ||
children.translated_text: together with <s>Ghaṇṭākarṇa</s>, for a thousand divine years.

children.text: tatas tattapasā śambhus tuṣṭa āgatya cābravīt
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śambhu</s>, pleased by that austerity, came and said:

children.text: kālabhairava tuṣṭo 'smi varaṃ varaya kāṅkṣitam ||
children.translated_text: "O <s>Kālabhairava</s>, I am pleased; choose the desired boon."

children.text: bhairava uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Bhairava</s> said:

children.text: brahmahatyā tv iyaṃ deva bādhate māṃ divāniśam ||
children.translated_text: "This <s>brahmahatyā</s>, O god, torments me day and night.

children.text: tanmokṣaṃ me kuru vibho yadi tuṣṭo 'si śaṅkara
children.translated_text: Release me from it, O lord, if you are pleased, O <s>Śaṅkara</s>."

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: matprasādād bhairavādya brahmahatyā vināśitā
children.translated_text: "By my grace, O <s>Bhairava</s>, today <s>brahmahatyā</s> has been destroyed.

children.text: pātā sukṛtināṃ tvaṃ hi śāstā duṣkṛtināṃ bhava ||
children.translated_text: Be the protector of the virtuous and the chastiser of the wicked.

children.text: gaccha śīghraṃ kurukṣetraṃ viṣṇur mokṣyati tatra tu
children.translated_text: Go quickly to <s>Kurukṣetra</s>; <s>Viṣṇu</s> will release you there.

children.text: ghaṇṭākarṇo 'pi samprāpya kṣetrapālatvam añjasā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ghaṇṭākarṇa</s> too will at once obtain the office of guardian of the sacred field."

children.text: tatrovāsa yathākāmaṃ tatraivāntardadhe śivaḥ
children.translated_text: He lived there as he wished, and <s>Śiva</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: tataḥ sa bhairavo brahmakapālena samanvitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then that <s>Bhairava</s>, bearing <s>Brahmā</s>'s skull,

children.text: kurukṣetraṃ samāsādya tatra dṛṣṭvā janārdanam
children.translated_text: reached <s>Kurukṣetra</s> and saw <s>Janārdana</s> there.

children.text: tatra kṣiptvā kapālaṃ tu gokarṇaṃ punar āgamat ||
children.translated_text: After casting away the skull there, he returned again to <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tatraiva vasatiṃ cakre ghaṇṭākarṇena saṃyutaḥ
children.translated_text: He made his dwelling there itself, together with <s>Ghaṇṭākarṇa</s>,

children.text: śikṣakaḥ pāpināṃ nityaṃ rakṣant sukṛtiśālinām ||
children.translated_text: always chastising sinners and protecting those endowed with merit.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: haranetrāgninā dagdhe manmathe munayo nṛpa
children.translated_text: When <s>Manmatha</s> had been burned by the fire from <s>Hara</s>'s eye, O king, the sages

children.text: śivasya nikaṭaṃ gatvā kāmaṃ dehīti cābruvan ||
children.translated_text: went near <s>Śiva</s> and said, "Give us <s>Kāma</s>."

children.text: hara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Hara</s> said:

children.text: itaḥ paraṃ na tasyāṅgaṃ cittajanmā bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: "From now on the mind-born one will have no body.

children.text: vaivasvate 'ntare viprāḥ kṛṣṇe putratvam āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: In the <s>Vaivasvata</s> interval, O Brahmins, he will attain birth as a son of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>."

children.text: ity ukte śambhunā kāmaḥ śivacetasy abhūt tataḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Śambhu</s> had said this, <s>Kāma</s> then arose in <s>Śiva</s>'s mind.

children.text: aikṣiṣṭa pārvatīṃ śambhur lalāṭāt teja āpatat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śambhu</s> looked at <s>Pārvatī</s>; radiance fell from his forehead.

children.text: svasyākṛtiḥ kumāro 'bhūd gauryai taṃ pradadau śivaḥ
children.translated_text: A boy having his own form was born, and <s>Śiva</s> gave him to <s>Gaurī</s>.

children.text: vināyakākhyāṃ gamitaḥ kadācit pārvatī nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: He was given the name <s>Vināyaka</s>; once, O king, <s>Pārvatī</s>

children.text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tanayaṃ devī taṃ bhartāram amanyata
children.translated_text: saw that son, and the goddess thought him to be her husband.

children.text: tato jñātvātmajaṃ krodhād aśapad vikṛto bhava ||
children.translated_text: Then, realizing he was her own son, she angrily cursed him: "Become deformed."

children.text: gajānano daśabhujaḥ kharvapādāmbujadvayaḥ
children.translated_text: Elephant-faced, ten-armed, and with a pair of small lotus-like feet,

children.text: lambodaraḥ śūrpakarṇaḥ so 'bhūn mātuś ca śāpataḥ ||
children.translated_text: pot-bellied and winnow-eared, he became so through his mother's curse.

children.text: śaṅkaraḥ sthātmajaṃ dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭaḥ ka iti pārvatīm
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s>, seeing his own son, asked <s>Pārvatī</s>, "Who is he?"

children.text: vināyakas tava suta iti sarvaṃ jagāda ha ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Vināyaka</s> is your son," she said, and told him everything.

children.text: śivaḥ svaputram ādāya idaṃ vacanam abravīt
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s>, taking his own son, spoke these words:

children.text: mātṛśāpāt tu vairūpyaṃ tava prāptaṃ gajānana ||
children.translated_text: "Because of your mother's curse, deformity has come upon you, O <s>Gajānana</s>.

children.text: idam eva yathā bhūyāt punaḥ saurūpyam ātmanaḥ
children.translated_text: So that your own good form may arise again,

children.text: tathā gokarṇam āsādya tapaḥ kuru vināyaka ||
children.translated_text: go to <s>Gokarṇa</s> and practice austerity, O <s>Vināyaka</s>."

children.text: so 'pi gokarṇam āsādya tīrthaṃ kṛtvā sunirmalam
children.translated_text: He too, reaching <s>Gokarṇa</s> and making a very pure <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: tapaś cacāra suciraṃ prasanno 'bhūn maheśvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: practiced austerity for a very long time, and <s>Maheśvara</s> became pleased.

children.text: devair brahmādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ varaṃ brūhīty abhāṣata
children.translated_text: Together with the gods beginning with <s>Brahmā</s>, he said, "Ask for a boon."

children.text: vināyaka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Vināyaka</s> said:

children.text: mātṛśāpavimokṣaṃ ca dehi me parameśvara ||
children.translated_text: Grant me release from my mother's curse, O supreme lord.

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: vairūpyaṃ tava saurūpyaṃ bhavaty eva gajānana
children.translated_text: Your ugliness shall indeed become beauty, O <s>Gajānana</s>.

children.text: gaṇānām adhipaś caiva vighnānām adhipo bhava ||
children.translated_text: Be the lord of the hosts, and also the lord of obstacles.

children.text: tato devāḥ svāyudhāni dadus tasmai mudānvitāḥ
children.translated_text: Then the gods, filled with joy, gave him their own weapons.

children.text: viṣṇuḥ svatanayāṃ śaktiṃ dadau tasmai narādhipa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, O lord of men, gave him his own <s>śakti</s> (power or weapon).

children.text: iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai rudrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ
children.translated_text: Having thus given him a boon, the hosts of deities beginning with <s>Rudra</s>

children.text: vināyakena sahitās tatraivāntardadhuḥ surāḥ ||
children.translated_text: disappeared right there together with <s>Vināyaka</s>, those gods.

children.text: tīrthe vaināyake snātvā gaṇānāntveti mantrataḥ
children.translated_text: After bathing at the <s>Vaināyaka</s> <s>tīrtha</s>, with the mantra "gaṇānāṃ tvā,"

children.text: pūjayec ca gaṇādhyakṣaṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: one should worship <s>Gaṇādhyakṣa</s>; one obtains all desired things.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahlādākhyo mahāsuraḥ
children.translated_text: The son of <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>, a great asura named <s>Prahlāda</s>,

children.text: pitṛdrohaṃ samādhāya tato nāradavākyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: having set his mind against his father because of <s>Nārada</s>'s words,

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya koṭitīrthasya dakṣiṇe
children.translated_text: reached the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, south of <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>.

children.text: nṛsiṃhamūrtiṃ saṃsthāpya tapas tepe yatātmavān ||
children.translated_text: He installed an image of <s>Nṛsiṃha</s> and performed austerity, self-controlled.

children.text: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān narasiṃhaḥ samāgamat
children.translated_text: Then blessed <s>Narasiṃha</s>, pleased, came there.

children.text: tvaṃ varaṃ varayety āha prahlādo vākyam abravīt ||
children.translated_text: He said, "Choose a boon," and <s>Prahlāda</s> spoke these words:

children.text: mayā kṛtaḥ pitṛdrohas tanmokṣaṃ me prasādaya
children.translated_text: I have committed hostility toward my father; graciously grant me release from that.

children.text: śrībhagavān uvāca
children.translated_text: The blessed Lord said:

children.text: pitṛdrohād vimuktas tvaṃ lokapūjyo bhavādhunā ||
children.translated_text: You are freed from hostility toward your father; from now on, be honored by the world.

children.text: vaiśākhe śuklabhūte tu māṃ pūjayati yo naraḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever worships me in <s>Vaiśākha</s>, on a bright lunar day,

children.text: pitṛdrohādikaṃ pāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tatkṣaṇāt ||
children.translated_text: his sin, such as hostility toward his father, perishes at that very moment.

children.text: ity uktvā nṛharis tatra tasyāṃ mūrtau vyalīyata
children.translated_text: Having said this, <s>Nṛhari</s> dissolved there into that image.

children.text: iti labdhvā varaṃ so 'pi prahlādaḥ svapuraṃ yayau ||
children.translated_text: Having obtained this boon, <s>Prahlāda</s> too went to his own city.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: uṣā bāṇāsurasutā kṛṣṇapautraṃ jahāra ca
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣā</s>, daughter of <s>Bāṇāsura</s>, abducted <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s grandson.

children.text: adṛṣṭvā svasya pautraṃ tu kṛṣṇaś cintāparo 'bhavat ||
children.translated_text: Not seeing his own grandson, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> became filled with anxiety.

children.text: tato nāradavākyena gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āgamat
children.translated_text: Then, on <s>Nārada</s>'s advice, he came to the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: sa snātvā koṭitīrthe tu pūjayitvā mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: He bathed at <s>Koṭitīrtha</s> and worshiped <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: vārṣikāṃś caturo māsāṃś cacāra sumahat tapaḥ
children.translated_text: For four months of the rainy season he practiced very great austerity.

children.text: śivaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ prāpta uvāca madhusūdanam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> became manifest and said to <s>Madhusūdana</s>:

children.text: kṛṣṇaviṣṇo mahābāho māṃ jitvā samare 'dhunā
children.translated_text: O <s>Kṛṣṇa-Viṣṇu</s>, mighty-armed one, after conquering me now in battle,

children.text: bāṇasya darpahananaṃ kṛtvāpnuhi svapautrakam ||
children.translated_text: destroy <s>Bāṇa</s>'s pride and regain your own grandson.

children.text: ity uktvāntardadhe śambhuḥ kṛṣṇo dvāravatīṃ yayau
children.translated_text: Having said this, <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared, and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> went to <s>Dvāravatī</s>.

children.text: bāṇāsuraṃ vijitvā tu svapautraṃ labdhavān nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: After defeating <s>Bāṇāsura</s>, he obtained his own grandson, O king.

children.text: tāṃ kṛṣṇamūrtiṃ saṃpūjya naraḥ kāmān avāpnuyāt
children.translated_text: A person who worships that image of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> obtains his desired things.

children.text: durvāsā vai muniśreṣṭho dattātreyeṇa saṃyutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Durvāsas</s>, the foremost sage, together with <s>Dattātreya</s>,

children.text: tapaḥ kṛtvā tu gokarṇe yogasiddho babhūva ha
children.translated_text: performed austerity at <s>Gokarṇa</s> and became perfected in yoga.

children.text: śaṅkhāsureṇāpahṛtā vedāḥ śāstrāṇi pārthiva ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Veda</s>s and <s>śāstra</s>s had been carried off by <s>Śaṅkhāsura</s>, O earthly ruler.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya liṅgaṃ kṛtvā pṛthak pṛthak
children.translated_text: Having reached the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, they made separate <s>liṅga</s>s,

children.text: tapaś cakruś ca niyatāḥ prasanno viṣṇur abravīt ||
children.translated_text: and, disciplined, performed austerity; <s>Viṣṇu</s>, pleased, said:

children.text: tuṣṭo 'smi nitarāṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi tapasā ca vaḥ
children.translated_text: I am greatly pleased, O <s>Veda</s>s and <s>śāstra</s>s, by your austerity.

children.text: vedaśāstrāṇy ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Veda</s>s and <s>śāstra</s>s said:

children.text: śaṅkhāsureṇāpahṛtā vayaṃ sarve janārdana ||
children.translated_text: We have all been carried off by <s>Śaṅkhāsura</s>, O <s>Janārdana</s>.

children.text: asmān uddhara liṅgāni loke pūjyāni santu vai
children.translated_text: Rescue us; let these <s>liṅga</s>s indeed be worshiped in the world.

children.text: śrībhagavān uvāca
children.translated_text: The blessed Lord said:

children.text: vyāsāvatāraṃ kṛtvā tu tīrthayātrāpadeśataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Taking an incarnation as <s>Vyāsa</s>, under the pretext of pilgrimage,

children.text: atrāgatya tapaḥ kṛtvā hy uddhariṣyāmi vai dhruvam
children.translated_text: I shall come here, perform austerity, and surely rescue you.

children.text: ye pūjayanti liṅgāni vedaśāstrayutā bhuvi ||
children.translated_text: Those on earth who worship the <s>liṅga</s>s together with the <s>Veda</s>s and <s>śāstra</s>s

children.text: saptajanma bhaveyur vai tadante mokṣam āpnuyuḥ
children.translated_text: will indeed be born for seven births, and at their end they will attain liberation.

children.text: iti tebhyo varaṃ datvā tatraivāntardadhe hariḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having granted them this boon, <s>Hari</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: vyāsaḥ parāśarasutas tīrthayātrāṃ kramāc caran
children.translated_text: <s>Vyāsa</s>, son of <s>Parāśara</s>, roaming step by step on pilgrimage,

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya tapas tepe yatātmavān ||
children.translated_text: reached the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> and performed austerity, self-controlled.

children.text: śukam utpādayāmāsa tathāpi tapa ācarat
children.translated_text: He begot <s>Śuka</s>, and nevertheless continued to practice austerity.

children.text: evaṃ tapasyatas tasya prasanno 'bhūn maheśvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: As he was practicing austerity in this way, <s>Maheśvara</s> became pleased.

children.text: uvāca vyāsaṃ nṛpate vyāsa te 'dyāśramaḥ śubhaḥ
children.translated_text: He said to <s>Vyāsa</s>, O king: "<s>Vyāsa</s>, today your hermitage is auspicious.

children.text: tamo 'sureṇa pāpena vedāḥ śāstrāṇi khaṇḍitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Veda</s>s and <s>śāstra</s>s have been broken apart by the sinful asura <s>Tamas</s>.

children.text: vibhājayasva tānt sarvān adhīyīran dvijā bhuvi
children.translated_text: Divide all of them, so that twice-born men on earth may study them."

children.text: ity uktvāntardadhe śambhur vyāsas tu tadanantaram ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared; then <s>Vyāsa</s>, immediately afterward,

children.text: vedāñchāstrāṇi ca tadā vibhāgaṃ kṛtavān nṛpa
children.translated_text: made a division of the <s>Veda</s>s and <s>śāstra</s>s at that time, O king.

children.text: śuko 'pi tapa āsthāya yogasiddhim avāptavān ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śuka</s> too, undertaking austerity, obtained yogic perfection.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: viśvakarmā tapas taptvā gokarṇe liṅgam uttamam
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvakarman</s>, having performed austerity at <s>Gokarṇa</s> and worshiped an excellent <s>liṅga</s>

children.text: pūjayitvā vidhānena brahmāṇaṃ paryatoṣayat ||
children.translated_text: according to rule, fully satisfied <s>Brahmā</s>.

children.text: prasādād brahmaṇo rājan manaḥ śilpaṃ sa labdhavān
children.translated_text: By <s>Brahmā</s>'s grace, O king, he obtained mental craftsmanship.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: gautamena purā śakraḥ śapto 'bhūt kāmalolupaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Formerly <s>Śakra</s>, driven by desire, had been cursed by <s>Gautama</s>.

children.text: liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya gokarṇe tapa ādhāya bhaktitaḥ
children.translated_text: Having established a <s>liṅga</s> at <s>Gokarṇa</s> and undertaken austerity with devotion,

children.text: paritoṣya maheśānaṃ tapasā siddhim āptavān ||
children.translated_text: he satisfied <s>Maheśāna</s> through austerity and obtained success.

children.text: gautamo 'pi muniśreṣṭhas tyaktvāhalyāṃ tato vane
children.translated_text: <s>Gautama</s> too, the foremost sage, then abandoned <s>Ahalyā</s> in the forest.

children.text: bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kurvan gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āgamat ||
children.translated_text: Going around the earth, he came to the field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: liṅgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya tapasā siddhim āptavān
children.translated_text: There he established a <s>liṅga</s> and obtained success through austerity.

children.text: tṛṇāgnir api viprendras tapasā siddhim āptavān ||
children.translated_text: <s>Tṛṇāgni</s> too, best of Brahmins, obtained success through austerity.

children.text: kāśyapo 'pi muniśreṣṭhaḥ kapotākhyo mahāmuniḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s> too, the foremost sage, and the great sage named <s>Kapota</s>,

children.text: surasā nāgamātā ca kesarī hanumatpitā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Surasā</s>, mother of the nāgas, and <s>Kesarī</s>, father of <s>Hanumat</s>,

children.text: viśvedevāś ca vasavo grahendrāś ca bhṛgur muniḥ
children.translated_text: the <s>Viśvedeva</s>s, the <s>Vasu</s>s, the chief planets, and the sage <s>Bhṛgu</s>,

children.text: jamadagniḥ kratuś caiva tathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jamadagni</s> and <s>Kratu</s>, and likewise the host of <s>Apsaras</s>es,

children.text: śataśṛṅge tapaḥ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prāptāḥ purā nṛpa
children.translated_text: long ago obtained success by performing austerity on <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>, O king.

children.text: atrer aṅgirasaś caiva tathā bhaumasya cāśramaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There also are the hermitages of <s>Atri</s>, <s>Aṅgiras</s>, and likewise of <s>Bhauma</s>.

children.text: eteṣām āśramaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva yathākramam
children.translated_text: The holy <s>āśramas</s> and <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred bathing places) of these, each in order,

children.text: darśanād eva pāpāni jñānājñānakṛtāni ca ||
children.translated_text: by the mere sight of them, destroy sins committed knowingly and unknowingly;

children.text: naśyanty eva na saṃdeho nṛṇāṃ bharatasattama
children.translated_text: they certainly perish for men; there is no doubt, O best of the <s>Bharatas</s>.

children.text: viśvāvasos tumburoś ca citrasenasya pārthiva ||
children.translated_text: O king, of <s>Viśvāvasu</s>, <s>Tumburu</s>, and <s>Citrasena</s>,

children.text: gandharvāṇāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ siddhānāṃ marutām api
children.translated_text: and likewise of other <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Siddhas</s>, and <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: kinnarāṇāṃ ca sādhyānāṃ guhyakānāṃ ca rakṣasām ||
children.translated_text: of <s>Kinnaras</s>, <s>Sādhyas</s>, <s>Guhyakas</s>, and <s>Rākṣasas</s>,

children.text: vidyādharāṇāṃ rājan kimpuruṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca
children.translated_text: of <s>Vidyādharas</s>, O king, and likewise of <s>Kimpuruṣas</s>,

children.text: āśramāś ca bahūny atra tīrthāni nṛpasattama ||
children.translated_text: there are many <s>āśramas</s> and <s>tīrthas</s> here, O best of kings.

children.text: vālmīkir api gokarṇe tapaḥ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
children.translated_text: At <s>Gokarṇa</s>, <s>Vālmīki</s> too performed austerity according to rule,

children.text: siddhiṃ prāpya mahādevād yathākāmam atiṣṭhata ||
children.translated_text: and, having obtained <s>siddhi</s> (spiritual accomplishment) from <s>Mahādeva</s>, remained as he wished.

children.text: hanūmāṃs tatra rājendra vāyuputro mahābalaḥ
children.translated_text: There, O king of kings, mighty <s>Hanūmān</s>, son of <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: tapaś cacāra suciraṃ ghoram uddiśya śaṅkaram ||
children.translated_text: performed dreadful austerity for a very long time, directing it to <s>Śaṅkara</s>.

children.text: tapasā tasya vīrasya śivaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: Through the austerity of that hero, <s>Śiva</s> became present before him.

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: tuṣṭo 'smi te harivara tapasā kim abhīpsitam ||
children.translated_text: "I am pleased with you, best of monkeys; what is desired through your austerity?"

children.text: hanūmān uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Hanūmān</s> said:

children.text: yudhyamānasya me deva jayo bhavatu sarvadā
children.translated_text: "O god, may victory always be mine when I am fighting."

children.text: tathāstv iti varaṃ datvā tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having granted the boon, saying "So be it," <s>Hara</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: hanūmeśaṃ pūjayitvā sarvaśatrujayaṃ labhet
children.translated_text: By worshiping <s>Hanūmeśa</s>, one obtains victory over every enemy.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: āryā śṛṅgāt samāgamya durgādevī nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: Coming from <s>Āryaśṛṅga</s>, <s>Durgādevī</s>, O best of kings,

children.text: durgākuṇḍam iti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā sunirmalam
children.translated_text: made a very pure <s>tīrtha</s>, famed as <s>Durgākuṇḍa</s>.

children.text: tapaḥ kṛtvā tu niyatā siddhim āpa sudurlabhām ||
children.translated_text: Disciplined, she performed austerity and obtained a very hard-to-attain <s>siddhi</s>.

children.text: śumbhādirākṣasān hatvā mahākālī nṛpottama
children.translated_text: Having slain the <s>Rākṣasas</s> beginning with <s>Śumbha</s>, <s>Mahākālī</s>, O best of kings,

children.text: svāyudhāni ca saṃkṣālya śataśṛṅgataṭe śubhe ||
children.translated_text: washed her weapons on the auspicious bank of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>.

children.text: tapase kṛtasaṅkalpā āste sā dakṣiṇāmukhā
children.translated_text: Having resolved upon austerity, she remains facing south.

children.text: āyudhāni kṣālitāni yatra tattīrtham uttamam ||
children.translated_text: Where the weapons were washed, that is the excellent <s>tīrtha</s>.

children.text: tatkālīhradam ākhyātaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayen nṛpa
children.translated_text: It is called <s>Kālīhrada</s>; having seen it, one should worship it, O king.

children.text: mahākālīṃ samabhyarcya sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: Having duly worshiped <s>Mahākālī</s>, one obtains all desires.

children.text: gokarṇakṣetrarakṣārthaṃ niyuktā śambhunā hi sā
children.translated_text: For she was appointed by <s>Śambhu</s> to guard the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: atrivaṃśodbhavā viprāś catvāro bindunāmakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Four Brahmins born in the lineage of <s>Atri</s>, named <s>Bindu</s>,

children.text: adṛśyāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ durgādeśaṃ samāśritāḥ
children.translated_text: invisible to all beings, took refuge in the region of <s>Durgā</s>.

children.text: tapas taptvā tu niyataṃ kāṣṭhabhūtā vane 'vasan ||
children.translated_text: Practicing restrained austerity, they lived in the forest as if turned to wood.

children.text: devānāṃ vacanāc chambhus teṣāṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: At the word of the gods, <s>Śambhu</s> appeared before them.

children.text: kāṣṭhabhūtānt samālokya candro 'mṛtam asiñcata ||
children.translated_text: Seeing that they had become like pieces of wood, <s>Candra</s> sprinkled them with <s>amṛta</s> (nectar).

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: yuṣmābhir amṛtaṃ pītaṃ siddhiṃ prāptāḥ sudurlabhām
children.translated_text: "You have drunk <s>amṛta</s>; you have attained a very hard-to-attain <s>siddhi</s>.

children.text: adhigamya paraṃ brahma brahmabhūtāś cariṣyatha ||
children.translated_text: Having reached the supreme <s>brahman</s>, you will move about as beings become <s>brahman</s>."

children.text: tīrthāni vo mahābhāgāḥ sarvapāpaharāṇi vai
children.translated_text: "Your <s>tīrthas</s>, O greatly blessed ones, will indeed remove all sins.

children.text: ā svarlokād dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ pātālāvadhi sattamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: From <s>Svarloka</s> down to <s>Pātāla</s>, O best twice-born, O excellent ones,

children.text: dhārāś cāndryas tu nityā vai santu pāpaharā bhuvi
children.translated_text: may these lunar streams always be on earth, removers of sin."

children.text: iti dattvā varaṃ śambhus tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
children.translated_text: Having given this boon, <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: dharmarājānujo bhīmas tīrthayātrāpadeśataḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Bhīma</s>, the younger brother of <s>Dharmarāja</s>, under pretext of a pilgrimage to <s>tīrthas</s>,

children.text: mātaraṃ svāṃ samādāya gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āgamat ||
children.translated_text: took his mother with him and came to the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tadā tatratya ṛṣibhir bodhito 'gāt tadantikam
children.translated_text: Then, instructed by the sages living there, he went near that place.

children.text: pāṣāṇenāvṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā tīrthaṃ taddeśabindukam ||
children.translated_text: Seeing that <s>tīrtha</s> of the <s>Bindu</s> region covered by a rock,

children.text: gadayā tāḍayāmāsa pāṣāṇaṃ mārgam ātanot
children.translated_text: he struck the rock with his mace and opened a path.

children.text: tadā bhīmagadātīrtham iti khyātam abhūn nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Then it became famed as <s>Bhīmagadātīrtha</s>, O king.

children.text: iti śrīskānde śrīgokarṇamāhātmye daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ | ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the tenth chapter in the glorious <s>Gokarṇamāhātmya</s> of the glorious <s>Skanda</s>.

children.text: Chapter 11
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: rudrapādasya māhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārthiva
children.translated_text: I shall tell the greatness of <s>Rudrapāda</s>; listen, O king.

children.text: mathurāyāṃ dvijaḥ kaścit suhotra iti viśrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In <s>Mathurā</s> there was a certain Brahmin, renowned as <s>Suhotra</s>.

children.text: brahmakṣatraviśaḥ śūdrān yājayan paravañcakaḥ
children.translated_text: Deceiving others, he served as priest for Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras.

children.text: mahādānagrahī parvakāle duṣṭapratigrahī ||
children.translated_text: He accepted great gifts; at festival times he accepted improper gifts.

children.text: candrasūryagrahe caiva śrāddhe dānagrahī sadā
children.translated_text: At lunar and solar eclipses and at <s>śrāddha</s> rites, he was always a receiver of gifts.

children.text: liṅgārcanādi na kṛtaṃ tathā māsavratādikam ||
children.translated_text: He performed no worship of a <s>liṅga</s> and the like, nor any monthly vow.

children.text: na vyayaṃ kṛtavān so 'pi deśād deśaṃ vrajann api
children.translated_text: He made no religious expenditure, even as he wandered from country to country.

children.text: dravyanyāsāya sa yayāv ekadā sahyakānane ||
children.translated_text: Once he went to the <s>Sahya</s> forest to store away his wealth.

children.text: dṛṣṭavān ucchritaṃ tatra niṣpatraṃ śālmalītarum
children.translated_text: There he saw a tall, leafless <s>śālmalī</s> tree,

children.text: tacchākhālambamānāṃś ca ūrdhvapādān atikṛśān ||
children.translated_text: and hanging from its branches, feet upward, extremely emaciated,

children.text: bhayānakān ūrdhvaromṇaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukān
children.translated_text: terrifying, with hair standing up and throats, lips, and palates dried out.

children.text: krandamānān sa dṛṣṭvā tu vegena mahatā yayau ||
children.translated_text: Seeing them crying, he went away with great speed.

children.text: dhāvamānaṃ samālokya jñātvā taṃ ca svavaṃśajam
children.translated_text: Seeing him running and recognizing him as their own descendant,

children.text: āhūya taṃ piśācās te procuḥ prītiyutaṃ vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those <s>piśācas</s> (ghouls) called him and spoke affectionate words.

children.text: piśācā ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>piśācas</s> said:

children.text: suhotrāgaccha bhadraṃ te mā bhaiṣīḥ putra sāmpratam
children.translated_text: "<s>Suhotra</s>, come; blessings on you. Do not be afraid now, son.

children.text: pālayāsmān pitṝṃs te 'dya prāktanena tu karmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: Protect us today, your ancestors, from the effects of former karma.

children.text: tvayā kṛtena pāpena paiśācīṃ yonim āgatān
children.translated_text: Through the sin committed by you, we have entered a <s>piśāca</s> womb;

children.text: patamānāṃs tu narake tvam uddhartum ihārhasi ||
children.translated_text: you ought here to raise us up as we are falling into hell."

children.text: svapitṝṇāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā suhotro 'tīva vihvalaḥ
children.translated_text: Hearing the words of his own ancestors, <s>Suhotra</s> was exceedingly agitated.

children.text: sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatyāha hy ātmānaṃ nindayan bahu ||
children.translated_text: Prostrating with eight limbs, he spoke, greatly blaming himself:

children.text: aparādhaḥ kṛto yo vai sa kṣantavyo hi sāmpratam
children.translated_text: "The offense that I have committed should indeed now be forgiven.

children.text: kena puṇyena bhavatāṃ svargaloko bhavet dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: By what merit may heaven certainly be obtained for you?"

children.text: pitara ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The ancestors said:

children.text: śṛṇu rājan mahatpuṇyaṃ gokarṇaṃ gaccha sāmpratam
children.translated_text: "Listen, O king: go now to greatly holy <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: rudrapādaṃ nāma suta vartate tacchilātale ||
children.translated_text: There, on that slab of rock, O son, is the place named <s>Rudrapāda</s>.

children.text: purā mitrasaho rājā rakṣo 'bhūd guruśāpataḥ
children.translated_text: Long ago King <s>Mitrasaha</s> became a <s>Rākṣasa</s> because of his guru's curse.

children.text: tataḥ sa bhakṣayāmāsa vasiṣṭhasyātmajāñchatān ||
children.translated_text: Then he devoured a hundred sons of <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>.

children.text: durmukhatvaṃ tadā prāptā vasiṣṭhasya sutās tataḥ
children.translated_text: Thereupon the sons of <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> came to a dreadful state;

children.text: vasiṣṭhena samājñaptaḥ śaktiputraḥ parāśaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Parāśara</s>, son of <s>Śakti</s>, was commanded by <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>."

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya gatvā rudrapadaṃ śubham
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> and gone to the auspicious <s>Rudrapāda</s>,

children.text: cakre śrāddhaṃ vidhānena piṇḍaṃ dattvā tilodakam ||
children.translated_text: he performed śrāddha according to rule, offering the piṇḍa and sesame-water.

children.text: tataḥ śaktyādayaḥ sarve brahmalokaṃ yayuḥ suta
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakti</s> and all the others went to <s>Brahmaloka</s>, O son.

children.text: tasmāt putra tvam api vai gatvā rudrapadaṃ śubham ||
children.translated_text: Therefore you too, my son, should go to the auspicious <s>Rudrapāda</s>.

children.text: tatpādaṃ samyag abhyarcya śrāddhaṃ kuru vidhānataḥ
children.translated_text: Worship that foot properly and perform śrāddha according to rule,

children.text: dānaṃ vittānusāreṇa yāvac chambhuḥ prasīdati ||
children.translated_text: and give gifts according to your wealth until <s>Śambhu</s> is pleased.

children.text: iti śrutvā pitṛvaco rudrapādaṃ tato 'gamat
children.translated_text: Having heard his father's words, he then went to <s>Rudrapāda</s>.

children.text: nityaṃ samudre snātvā tu śrāddhaṃ kurvan samāhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bathing every day in the ocean, he performed śrāddha with concentrated mind.

children.text: tapaś cacāra suciraṃ kurvan dānāni pārthiva
children.translated_text: He practiced austerity for a very long time and made gifts, O ruler,

children.text: svayaṃ bhuñjan haviṣyānnaṃ pitṝṇāṃ muktaye nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: while himself eating sacrificial food for the liberation of his ancestors, O king.

children.text: tato bahutithe kāle śivaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: Then, after a long time had passed, <s>Śiva</s> became visible before him.

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: tuṣṭo 'smi nitarāṃ brahman varaṃ varaya kāṅkṣitam ||
children.translated_text: "I am exceedingly pleased, Brahmin. Choose the boon you desire."

children.text: suhotra uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Suhotra</s> said:

children.text: yadi tuṣṭaḥ asi deveśa pitṝṇāṃ muktido bhava
children.translated_text: "If you are pleased, lord of gods, become the giver of liberation to my ancestors."

children.text: śiva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s> said:

children.text: pitṝṇāṃ tava viprendra svargaloko bhavet dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: "For your ancestors, O best of Brahmins, the world of heaven shall certainly be theirs.

children.text: kanyāmāse tu kutupe atrāgatya narottamaḥ
children.translated_text: In the month of <s>Kanyā</s>, at the kutapa time, when a foremost man comes here

children.text: śrāddhaṃ kurvan rudrapāde uddharet svapitṝnt svayam ||
children.translated_text: and performs śrāddha at <s>Rudrapāda</s>, he himself will raise up his own ancestors.

children.text: mama lokaṃ samāsādya amṛtatvaṃ sa gacchati
children.translated_text: Having reached my world, he goes to immortality."

children.text: ity uktvā brāhmaṇaṃ rājaṃs tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having said this to the Brahmin, O king, <s>Hara</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: tatas tatpitaro jagmur brahmalokaṃ mudānvitāḥ
children.translated_text: Then his ancestors went to <s>Brahmaloka</s>, filled with joy.

children.text: suhotro 'pi dvijaśreṣṭho dehānte svargatiṃ yayau ||
children.translated_text: And <s>Suhotra</s>, the best of twice-born men, went to heaven at the end of his life.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: dharmeṇa nirjito 'dharmo dharmaṃ jeṣya iti dhruvaṃ
children.translated_text: Adharma, defeated by Dharma, resolved, "I shall conquer Dharma," as was certain.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya tapas taptvā samāhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, he practiced austerity with concentrated mind.

children.text: prasannīkṛtya deveśaṃ varaṃ labdhvā maheśvarāt
children.translated_text: After pleasing the lord of gods and receiving a boon from <s>Maheśvara</s>,

children.text: kalau yuge hy adharmas tu dharmaṃ jigye nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: in the Kali age Adharma conquered Dharma, O best of kings.

children.text: kārtikyāṃ somavāre tu tīrthe snātvā samāhitaḥ
children.translated_text: On a Monday in <s>Kārttikī</s>, if someone bathes at the tīrtha with concentrated mind,

children.text: adharmaṃ nāpnuyāt ko 'pi agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
children.translated_text: no one incurs adharma; he obtains the fruit of an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> sacrifice.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: asūyā matsarī caṇḍī krodhā dveṣākṣamā tathā
children.translated_text: Envy, jealousy, fierceness, anger, hatred, and impatience,

children.text: īrṣyālakṣmīś ca ghorā ca mohanā ca nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: and envy, misfortune, terror, and delusion, O best of kings,

children.text: nirjitā dharmaputrais tu satyādyair duḥkhitā bhṛśam
children.translated_text: were defeated by the sons of Dharma, beginning with Truth, and became deeply distressed.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya tapas taptvā yathāvidhi ||
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, they practiced austerity according to rule.

children.text: prasannīkṛtya viśveśaṃ samprāpte hy antime yuge
children.translated_text: After pleasing <s>Viśveśa</s>, when the final age had arrived,

children.text: dharmasya tanayān hatvā svayaṃ ca balino 'bhavan ||
children.translated_text: they killed the sons of Dharma and themselves became powerful.

children.text: tīrtheṣu teṣu snātānāṃ tattajjātaṃ bhayaṃ na hi
children.translated_text: For those who bathe in those tīrthas, there is no fear born from each of those evils.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ kīrtir ahiṃsānanda eva ca ||
children.translated_text: Forbearance, truth, self-restraint, fame, non-injury, and joy,

children.text: buddhir mānas tathā rājan lakṣmīr lajjā śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ
children.translated_text: intelligence, mind, and likewise, O king, prosperity, modesty, sacred learning, and tradition,

children.text: tathā medhādharmasutair asūyādyaiḥ parājitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: as well as wisdom, were defeated by the sons of Adharma, beginning with Envy.

children.text: brahmaṇo vacanād rājan gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āgaman
children.translated_text: At the word of <s>Brahmā</s>, O king, they came to the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: śālūkinyās taṭe ramye tapas taptvā ciraṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: On the lovely bank of the <s>Śālūkinī</s> they practiced austerity for a long time, O king.

children.text: prasannīkṛtya deveśaṃ varaṃ labdhvā sudurlabham
children.translated_text: After pleasing the lord of gods and receiving a very hard-to-obtain boon,

children.text: adharmatanayāñjitvā svayaṃ ca balino'bhavan ||
children.translated_text: they defeated the sons of Adharma and themselves became powerful.

children.text: tīrtheṣu teṣu snātānāṃ guṇās teṣāṃ bhavet dhruvam
children.translated_text: For those who bathe in those tīrthas, those virtues will surely be theirs.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: vindhyena nirjito meru putrābhyāṃ saha duḥkhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Meru</s>, defeated by <s>Vindhya</s>, was distressed together with his two sons.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya tapaḥ kṛtvātidāruṇam
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, he performed extremely severe austerity.

children.text: pratyakṣīkṛtya deveśaṃ varaṃ prāpya manogatam ||
children.translated_text: After bringing the lord of gods before his eyes, he obtained the boon he had in mind.

children.text: meruṃ vijitya svastho 'bhūt putrābhyāṃ saha pārthiva
children.translated_text: Having conquered <s>Meru</s>, he became secure together with his two sons, O ruler.

children.text: ramyo ramaṇakaś caivaṃ meruputrau nṛpottama ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ramya</s> and <s>Ramaṇaka</s> were thus the two sons of <s>Meru</s>, O best of kings.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: kṛtatretau dvāparaś ca kaliś ceti caturyugāḥ
children.translated_text: The four yugas are <s>Kṛta</s>, <s>Tretā</s>, <s>Dvāpara</s>, and <s>Kali</s>.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya siddhiṃ prāptā maheśvarāt ||
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>, they attained siddhi from <s>Maheśvara</s>.

children.text: tīrtheṣu teṣu snātānāṃ svargaloko bhaved dhruvam
children.translated_text: For those who bathe in those tīrthas, the world of heaven shall certainly be theirs.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: diśaś cāpi tapas taptvā siddhās tatra kurūdvaha ||
children.translated_text: The directions too practiced austerity there and attained perfection, O descendant of <s>Kuru</s>.

children.text: gālavaś ca kaholaś ca tapas taptvātidāruṇam
children.translated_text: <s>Gālava</s> and <s>Kahola</s> practiced extremely severe austerity.

children.text: bhaktyā śivaṃ samārādhya siddhiṃ prāptau dvijottamau ||
children.translated_text: Devoutly worshiping <s>Śiva</s>, those two excellent Brahmins attained siddhi.

children.text: kanakākhyo rājaputras tatra sampūjya śaṅkaram
children.translated_text: The prince named <s>Kanaka</s>, having worshiped <s>Śaṅkara</s> there,

children.text: pitrā tyaktaṃ svakaṃ rājyaṃ prāptaḥ śambhor anugrahāt ||
children.translated_text: regained his own kingdom, which had been abandoned by his father, through <s>Śambhu</s>'s favor.

children.text: kapaś ca romaśaś caiva parāṃ siddhim upāgatau
children.translated_text: <s>Kapa</s> and <s>Romaśa</s> also attained supreme siddhi.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi śālūkinyāḥ kathāṃ śubhām ||
children.translated_text: Listen, O king; I shall tell the auspicious story of the <s>Śālūkinī</s>.

children.text: purā bhagīratho rājā gaṅgām āhṛtavān divaḥ
children.translated_text: In ancient times King <s>Bhagīratha</s> brought <s>Gaṅgā</s> down from heaven.

children.text: mārge tu jahnunā pītā sevayitvā tu taṃ munim ||
children.translated_text: On the way she was drunk by <s>Jahnu</s>; then, after serving that sage,

children.text: tasmād ānīya gaṅgāṃ tu pātāle bhasmaśeṣitān
children.translated_text: he brought <s>Gaṅgā</s> away from him, and in the netherworld

children.text: uddhārayāmāsa pitṝn samudraṃ praviveśa sā ||
children.translated_text: he raised up his ancestors who remained only as ashes, and she entered the ocean.

children.text: muniḥ satyatapā nāma jahnor āśramam āgamat
children.translated_text: A sage named <s>Satyatapā</s> came to <s>Jahnu</s>'s hermitage.

children.text: pūjayāmāsa taṃ jahnuḥ pṛṣṭaḥ kṣemādikaṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jahnu</s> honored him and asked about his welfare and other matters, O king.

children.text: satyatapā uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Satyatapā</s> said:

children.text: puṣpabhadrānadītīre sthitaḥ ahaṃ jāhnavīṃ gataḥ
children.translated_text: "I was staying on the bank of the river <s>Puṣpabhadrā</s> and went to the <s>Jāhnavī</s>.

children.text: tatra snātvā tv ihāyātaḥ śṛṇuṣvedaṃ vaco mama ||
children.translated_text: Having bathed there, I have come here; now listen to this word of mine.

children.text: tvayā pītā hi gaṅgeti lokavādo 'bhavan mune
children.translated_text: O sage, a public report has arisen: '<s>Gaṅgā</s> was indeed drunk by you.'

children.text: kaśyapādyair munivarair gaditaṃ tatra vai śrutam ||
children.translated_text: It was spoken there by foremost sages such as <s>Kaśyapa</s>; I heard it there.

children.text: tadvādadoṣaśāntyarthaṃ gaccha gokarṇam adya vai
children.translated_text: To pacify the fault of that report, go to <s>Gokarṇa</s> today.

children.text: tatra śālūkinī nāma nadī hy āste malāpahā ||
children.translated_text: There is a river there named <s>Śālūkinī</s>, remover of impurity.

children.text: taṭe tatrāsthāpya gaṅgāmūrtiṃ pūjaya nityaśaḥ
children.translated_text: Having installed an image of <s>Gaṅgā</s> on its bank, worship it every day.

children.text: evaṃ kṛte lokavādo naśyaty eva na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When this is done, the public report will indeed disappear; there is no doubt.

children.text: tatra snātvā purā jahno brāhmaṇau kūṭasākṣiṇau
children.translated_text: There, after bathing in former times, O <s>Jahnu</s>, two Brahmins who were false witnesses...

children.text: romapādapṛthugrīvau muktau svakṛtapātakāt ||
children.translated_text: <s>Romapāda</s> and <s>Pṛthugrīva</s> were released from the sin they themselves had committed.

children.text: jahnur uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Jahnu</s> said:

children.text: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ kūṭasākṣyam ūcatus tau mahāmune
children.translated_text: For what reason did those two utter false testimony, O great sage?

children.text: śālūkinyāṃ kathaṃ snātau vimuktau kutra saṃsthitau ||
children.translated_text: How were they freed after bathing in <s>Śālūkinī</s>, and where did they stay?

children.text: śālūkinyās tathotpattiṃ nāmadheyaṃ ca śaṃsa me
children.translated_text: Tell me also the origin of <s>Śālūkinī</s> and the meaning of her name.

children.text: satyatapā uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Satyatapas</s> said:

children.text: romapādapṛthugrīvau matsamīpe sthitāv ubhau ||
children.translated_text: <s>Romapāda</s> and <s>Pṛthugrīva</s> both stayed near me.

children.text: vedābhyāsāṃ prakurvantau brahmacaryaparāyaṇau
children.translated_text: They were practicing recitation of the <s>Veda</s> and were devoted to <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibate discipline).

children.text: kadācid bhṛguvaṃśyaś ca kaṇḍur nāmāgataś ca mām ||
children.translated_text: At one time a descendant of <s>Bhṛgu</s> named <s>Kaṇḍu</s> came to me.

children.text: vedam abhyastavān so 'pi matsevātatparo hy abhūt
children.translated_text: He too studied the <s>Veda</s>, and he became devoted to serving me.

children.text: ekadā māṃ pṛthugrīvas tūvāca śṛṇu me vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Once <s>Pṛthugrīva</s> said to me, "Listen to my words:

children.text: kaṇḍunā vai surā pītā guro dṛṣṭaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
children.translated_text: "<s>Kaṇḍu</s> has drunk liquor, O guru; this was seen, without doubt.

children.text: romapādena tat sarvam uktaṃ sa tu vicāryatām ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Romapāda</s> has said all this; therefore let it be investigated."

children.text: tac chrutvā romapādākhyam āhūya paripṛṣṭavān
children.translated_text: Hearing that, I summoned the one named <s>Romapāda</s> and questioned him.

children.text: so 'pi tathyam iti prāha tato 'haṃ kupito bhṛśam ||
children.translated_text: He too said, "It is true." Then I became very angry.

children.text: kaṇḍo madbhavanāc chīghraṃ gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇādhama
children.translated_text: "<s>Kaṇḍu</s>, leave my house at once, worst of Brahmins!"

children.text: ity ukte so 'pi sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatyābravīc ca mām ||
children.translated_text: When this was said, he too prostrated with all eight limbs and said to me:

children.text: dūrvārasaṃ nityam eva pibāmi pitṛvākyataḥ
children.translated_text: "I always drink the juice of <s>dūrvā</s> grass, because of my father's command."

children.text: ity ukte 'pi kulāt so 'pi bahiṣkārya itīritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even when this had been said, I declared that he should be expelled from the family.

children.text: etasminn antare kāle vāguvācāśarīriṇī
children.translated_text: At that moment a disembodied voice spoke:

children.text: niṣpāpo 'yaṃ satyatapāḥ śiṣyas te bhṛgunandana ||
children.translated_text: "This pupil of yours is sinless, O <s>Satyatapas</s>, O delight of <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

children.text: pṛthugrīveṇa mātsaryād romapādena vai tathā
children.translated_text: "Out of jealousy, by <s>Pṛthugrīva</s> and also by <s>Romapāda</s>,

children.text: apavādaṃ kūṭasākṣyam uktaṃ ca na vicārataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "slander and false testimony were spoken without proper inquiry.

children.text: tasmāt tvam api viprarṣe kiṃcid duṣkṛtavān abhūḥ
children.translated_text: "Therefore you too, O Brahmin seer, have committed some wrongdoing.

children.text: etatpāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ gaccha gokarṇam adya vai ||
children.translated_text: "For the purification of this sin, go today to <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ kuru vidhānataḥ
children.translated_text: "There, having made a hermitage-site, perform austerity according to rule.

children.text: mahādevaprasādena tava doṣo vinaśyati ||
children.translated_text: "By the favor of <s>Mahādeva</s>, your fault will disappear,

children.text: romapādasya kaṇḍoś ca pṛthugrīvasya vai tathā
children.translated_text: "and likewise that of <s>Romapāda</s>, <s>Kaṇḍu</s>, and <s>Pṛthugrīva</s>."

children.text: ity uktvā māṃ nabhovāṇī virarāma dvijottama ||
children.translated_text: Having said this to me, the heavenly voice fell silent, O best of twice-born men.

children.text: tataḥ śiṣyaiḥ samaṃ gatvā gokarṇamahamādarāt
children.translated_text: Then I went with my pupils to <s>Gokarṇa</s> with great reverence.

children.text: tasya kṣetrasya sīmāyāṃ sthitvāhamacaram tapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Standing at the boundary of that sacred field, I practiced austerity.

children.text: āvirbabhūva purato hy asmākaṃ parameśvaraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Parameśvara</s> appeared before us.

children.text: stuto 'tha bahubhiḥ stotraiḥ svakapardāj jahau tadā ||
children.translated_text: After being praised with many hymns, he then released from his own matted crest

children.text: gaṅgāṃ trailokyajananīṃ nadī bhūtvā tu sāgatā
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgā</s>, mother of the three worlds; becoming a river, she came forth.

children.text: samudraṃ prāviśac chīghram athovāca sadāśivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She quickly entered the ocean; then <s>Sadāśiva</s> said:

children.text: eṣā nadī puṇyatamā śālmalī nāma nāmataḥ
children.translated_text: "This most holy river is named <s>Śālmalī</s> by name.

children.text: mahāpātakino ye ca kūṭasākṣiṣu saṃsthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: "As for those who are great sinners and those involved in false witness,

children.text: teṣāṃ putrā yadi snāyuḥ pitṝn uddiśya bhaktitaḥ
children.translated_text: "if their sons bathe with devotion, intending it for their fathers,

children.text: sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ prāpnuyuḥ paramāṃ gatim ||
children.translated_text: "then, freed from all sins, they will attain the highest state.

children.text: tasmāc chālūkinīty evaṃ vadiṣyanti janā bhuvi
children.translated_text: "Therefore people on earth will call her <s>Śālūkinī</s>."

children.text: ity uktvā bhagavāñchambhus tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, blessed <s>Śambhu</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: tato 'haṃ śiṣyasahitaḥ snātvā nadyāṃ samāhitaḥ
children.translated_text: Then I, together with my pupils, bathed in the river with concentrated mind.

children.text: gokarṇeṣu ca tīrtheṣu snātvā pūjya mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: After bathing in the <s>tīrtha</s>s (sacred bathing places) at <s>Gokarṇa</s> and worshiping <s>Mahābala</s>,

children.text: yathāsthānaṃ gato'haṃ vai tasmāt tvaṃ dvijapuṅgava
children.translated_text: I went to my proper place. Therefore, O foremost of twice-born men,

children.text: snānaṃ kṛtvā tu gaṅgāyāṃ snātvārcaya mahābalam ||
children.translated_text: bathe in the <s>Gaṅgā</s>; after bathing, worship <s>Mahābala</s>.

children.text: evam uktvā satyatapā jahnuṃ svairagatir yayau
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, <s>Satyatapas</s> went away, moving at will, from <s>Jahnu</s>.

children.text: tato jahnus tu gokarṇe śālmalītīram āgamat ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Jahnu</s> came to the bank of the <s>Śālmalī</s> at <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: śālmalyāṃ snānam ādhāya gaṅgāmūrtim apūjayat
children.translated_text: Having undertaken bathing in the <s>Śālmalī</s>, he worshiped the image of <s>Gaṅgā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ pūjayatas tasya gaṅgā pratyakṣatāṃ gatā ||
children.translated_text: As he worshiped in this way, <s>Gaṅgā</s> became visible to him.

children.text: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te tuṣṭāsmīty āha taṃ nṛpa
children.translated_text: "Choose a boon; welfare to you. I am pleased," she said to him, O king.

children.text: jahnur uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Jahnu</s> said:

children.text: kṛto mayāparādhas te gaṅge 'jñānāc ca mohataḥ ||
children.translated_text: "I have committed an offense against you, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, through ignorance and delusion.

children.text: tat pāpaṃ śamayādya tvaṃ varam etaṃ vṛṇomy aham
children.translated_text: "Quell that sin today; this is the boon I choose."

children.text: gaṅgovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgā</s> said:

children.text: jahno nāsti tvayi droho matprasādān na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "O <s>Jahnu</s>, there is no hostility in you, through my grace, without doubt.

children.text: āśvayujy asite pakṣe hy aṣṭamyām aruṇodaye
children.translated_text: "In the dark fortnight of <s>Āśvayuja</s>, on the eighth lunar day, at dawn,

children.text: nadīnadaiḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ siddhaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: "together with rivers and streams, all <s>tīrtha</s>s, perfected beings, and hosts of gods,

children.text: āvirbhavāmy atra nadyāṃ sarvapāpaharā nṛṇām
children.translated_text: "I shall become manifest here in the river, taking away all sins of human beings.

children.text: tasmād gaṅgāvalī nāmnā nadī khyātā bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: "Therefore this river will be famed by the name <s>Gaṅgāvalī</s>.

children.text: tasmin kāle 'tra yaḥ snātvā manmūrtiṃ pūjayen mune
children.translated_text: "At that time, O sage, whoever bathes here and worships my image

children.text: stotreṇa tvatkṛtenaiva mama nāma sahasrakaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: "with the hymn composed by you and with my thousand names,

children.text: iha datvā sarvabhogāṃstasmai dāsyāmi matpadam
children.translated_text: "to him I shall give every enjoyment here, and then I shall grant my own abode."

children.text: evam uktvā tadā gaṅgā tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, <s>Gaṅgā</s> then disappeared right there.

children.text: evaṃ labdhvā varaṃ jahnuḥ koṭitīrthodake nṛpa
children.translated_text: Having thus obtained the boon, <s>Jahnu</s>, O king, bathed in the water of <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>.

children.text: snātvā tatratyatīrtheṣu svāśramaṃ punar āyayau ||
children.translated_text: After bathing at the <s>tīrtha</s>s there, he returned again to his own hermitage.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā hiḍimbabhaginī hiḍimbā nāma rākṣasī
children.translated_text: Long ago there was a rākṣasī named <s>Hiḍimbā</s>, the sister of <s>Hiḍimba</s>.

children.text: gokarṇe tapa ādhāya bhartṛdrohodbhavādikāt ||
children.translated_text: At <s>Gokarṇa</s> she undertook austerity because of sin beginning with betrayal of her husband.

children.text: pāpād vimuktā vyāsoktayā hy āśramaḥ sa vimuktidaḥ
children.translated_text: She was freed from that sin; as stated by <s>Vyāsa</s>, that hermitage grants liberation.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: vājimedhaśataṃ kṛtvā nahuṣo nṛpasattamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having performed a hundred horse-sacrifices, <s>Nahuṣa</s>, best of kings,

children.text: prāpya śakrapadaṃ rājā cyuto 'gastyāvamānataḥ
children.translated_text: attained the office of <s>Śakra</s>; but, fallen because of his insult to <s>Agastya</s>,

children.text: vyālo bhūtvā tato mukto gokarṇe tapa ācarat ||
children.translated_text: he became a serpent, and then, freed, he practiced austerity at <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tato rudraprasādena punaḥ svargam avāptavān
children.translated_text: Then, by the grace of <s>Rudra</s>, he regained heaven.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: ambarīṣo nalo rājā nimir nābhāga eva ca ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ambarīṣa</s>, King <s>Nala</s>, <s>Nimi</s>, and <s>Nābhāga</s>,

children.text: ikṣvākuś ca yayātiś ca bāṇo nāma mahāsuraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Ikṣvāku</s>, <s>Yayāti</s>, and the great asura named <s>Bāṇa</s>,

children.text: ete cānye ca bahavas tapasā siddhim āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: these and many others attained perfection through austerity.

children.text: iti śrīskānde śrīgokarṇamāhātmye ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the eleventh chapter in the auspicious <s>Skanda</s>, in the auspicious <s>Gokarṇa-māhātmya</s>.

children.text: Chapter 12
sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā kailāsaśikhare samāsīno vṛṣadhvajaḥ
children.translated_text: Long ago, on the peak of <s>Kailāsa</s>, the Bull-bannered Lord, <s>Vṛṣadhvaja</s>, was seated.

children.text: pṛṣṭaḥ provāca pārvatyai skandāya ca maheśvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: When asked, <s>Maheśvara</s> spoke to <s>Pārvatī</s> and to <s>Skanda</s>.

children.text: gokarṇakṣetramāhātmyaṃ pramathās tatra śuśruvuḥ
children.translated_text: The attendants there heard the greatness of the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: maṇibhadras tataḥ siddho bhūtanāthaś ca bhārata ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Maṇibhadra</s>, <s>Siddha</s>, and <s>Bhūtanātha</s>, O <s>Bhārata</s>,

children.text: namaskṛtya haraṃ procus tatkṣetrasya ca darśanam
children.translated_text: bowed to <s>Hara</s> and spoke about seeing that sacred field:

children.text: yātrāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena kṣipraṃ yāsyāma te 'ntikam ||
children.translated_text: "Having made the pilgrimage according to rule, we shall quickly come to your presence."

children.text: rudra uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> said:

children.text: śīghraṃ gacchata gokarṇaṃ dṛṣṭvāyāta madantikam
children.translated_text: "Go swiftly to <s>Gokarṇa</s>; after seeing it, come back to my presence."

children.text: śambhunaivam anujñātā yayur gokarṇam añjasā ||
children.translated_text: Thus permitted by <s>Śambhu</s>, they went straight to <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: sarvadevātmakaṃ matvā gokarṇaṃ te kurūdvaha
children.translated_text: Thinking <s>Gokarṇa</s> to be the embodiment of all the gods, O descendant of <s>Kuru</s>,

children.text: prācyāṃ tatkṣetrasīmāyāṃ kṛtvāśramapadaṃ śubham ||
children.translated_text: at the eastern boundary of that sacred field, having made an auspicious hermitage,

children.text: siddhas tapaś carann āsīd dhyāyan viśveśvaraṃ prabhum
children.translated_text: <s>Siddha</s> stayed there practicing austerity and meditating on <s>Viśveśvara</s>, the lord.

children.text: prasannas tu haraḥ prāha varaṃ brūhīti taṃ nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Hara</s>, pleased, said to him, "Choose a boon," O king.

children.text: siddha uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Siddha</s> said:

children.text: sthitvā kṣetre tava vibho tvatsevāṃ kartum utsahe
children.translated_text: "Dwelling in your sacred field, O lord, I wish to perform service to you."

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: atraiva vasa siddha tvaṃ rakṣan prācīṃ diśaṃ sadā ||
children.translated_text: "Remain right here, <s>Siddha</s>, always guarding the eastern direction.

children.text: siddhakuṇḍam iti khyātam aṣṭasiddhipradaṃ bhavet
children.translated_text: It shall be famed as <s>Siddhakuṇḍa</s>, granting the eight siddhis."

children.text: iti datvā varaṃ tasmai tasmiṃl liṅge 'vasat tataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having given him this boon, he then dwelt in that <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: maṇibhadro 'py adhaḥśīrṣaḥ pādābhyāṃ bhūmim aspṛśan
children.translated_text: <s>Maṇibhadra</s> too, with his head downward and not touching the earth with his feet,

children.text: ūrdhvapādo nirālambaś cacāra suciraṃ tapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with his feet upward and unsupported, practiced austerity for a very long time.

children.text: śataśṛṅgataṭe ramye dhyāyañchivapadāmbujam
children.translated_text: On the lovely slope of <s>Śataśṛṅga</s>, he meditated on the lotus feet of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: tato rudro 'py uvācedaṃ varaṃ varaya kāṅkṣitam ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Rudra</s> also said, "Choose the boon you desire."

children.text: maṇibhadra uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Maṇibhadra</s> said:

children.text: atraiva vastum icchāmi kṣetre asmiṃs tava śaṅkara
children.translated_text: "I wish to dwell right here in this sacred field of yours, O <s>Śaṅkara</s>."

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: atraiva vasa bhadra tvaṃ pratīcīsīmni rakṣakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "Remain right here, good one, as guardian on the western boundary."

children.text: iti datvā varaṃ tasmai tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ
children.translated_text: Having given him this boon, <s>Hara</s> disappeared right there.

children.text: bhūtanāthas tapas taptvā pratyakṣīkṛtya śaṅkaram ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bhūtanātha</s>, having performed austerity and brought <s>Śaṅkara</s> before his eyes,

children.text: tasmāt siddhim anuprāpya tatrovāsa yathāsukham
children.translated_text: obtained perfection from him and lived there as he pleased.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ rakṣamāṇās te tatra hy āsan gaṇānvitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guarding <s>Gokarṇa</s>, they remained there, accompanied by their hosts.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: tato gokarṇamāhātmyaṃ śrutvā devī mudānvitā
children.translated_text: Then the Goddess, filled with joy after hearing the greatness of <s>Gokarṇa</s>,

children.text: athovāca svabhartāraṃ tat kṣetraṃ darśaya prabho ||
children.translated_text: said to her own husband, "Show me that sacred field, O lord."

children.text: tac chrutvā vacanaṃ devyāḥ śaṅkaraḥ pramathaiḥ saha
children.translated_text: Hearing the Goddess's words, <s>Śaṅkara</s>, together with the attendants,

children.text: vṛṣārūḍhaḥ sa ca yayau gokarṇaṃ siddhasevitam ||
children.translated_text: mounted on the bull and went to <s>Gokarṇa</s>, which is served by perfected beings.

children.text: darśayāmāsa pārvatyai dṛṣṭvā sā vismayaṃ yayau
children.translated_text: He showed it to <s>Pārvatī</s>; seeing it, she was filled with wonder.

children.text: pārvaty uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Pārvatī</s> said:

children.text: vastum icchāmy ahaṃ cātra kṣetre 'smin śaṅkarādhunā ||
children.translated_text: "I too now wish to dwell here in this sacred field, O <s>Śaṅkara</s>."

children.text: ity ukte priyayā sārdham uvāsa parameśvaraḥ
children.translated_text: When this was said by his beloved, <s>Parameśvara</s> dwelt there together with her.

children.text: umāvanam iti khyātam āśramaḥ so 'py abhūn mahān ||
children.translated_text: That great hermitage too became known as <s>Umāvana</s>.

children.text: tadāśramaḥ puṇyatamo gokarṇe bharatarṣabha
children.translated_text: That hermitage is most meritorious in <s>Gokarṇa</s>, O bull among the <s>Bhārata</s>s.

children.text: śilā tu kuṇḍikākārā samudropari vartate ||
children.translated_text: There is a stone, shaped like a water-pot, standing above the ocean.

children.text: darśanād eva tasyās tu sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati
children.translated_text: By the mere sight of it, all sin is driven away.

children.text: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni yāni svarge vasanti vai ||
children.translated_text: All the <s>tīrtha</s>s that are on earth and those that dwell in heaven,

children.text: tāni sarvāṇi śuddhyarthaṃ devyās tatra gatāni vai
children.translated_text: all of them went there for the Goddess's purification.

children.text: teṣāṃ hradād abhūt tīrtham umāhradam iti prabho ||
children.translated_text: From their pool there arose a <s>tīrtha</s> called <s>Umāhrada</s>, O lord.

children.text: umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma sthāpitaṃ liṅgam uttamam
children.translated_text: An excellent <s>liṅga</s> named <s>Umāmaheśvara</s> was established.

children.text: tattīrtheṣu naraḥ snātvā talliṅgaṃ paripūjayet ||
children.translated_text: A man should bathe in those <s>tīrtha</s>s and fully worship that <s>liṅga</s>.

children.text: sarvān kāmān avāpnoti sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
children.translated_text: He obtains all desires and is freed from all sins.

children.text: tasmin vane kalpataruś chāyāpādapanāmakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In that forest there is a wish-fulfilling tree named <s>Chāyāpādapa</s>,

children.text: sadā puṣpaphalopetaḥ saptahastocchritaś ca saḥ
children.translated_text: always endowed with flowers and fruits, and seven hastas high.

children.text: mṛtyuṃ jayanti taṃ prāpya jantavo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Creatures who reach it conquer death; there is no doubt about this.

children.text: krīḍāgirer adho bhāge mālinī nāma nimnagā
children.translated_text: Below <s>Krīḍāgiri</s> there is a river named <s>Mālinī</s>,

children.text: āste puṇyodakā rājan nṝṇāṃ puṇyavivardhinī ||
children.translated_text: with holy water, O king, increasing the merit of human beings.

children.text: svāyambhuve 'ntare cāsīc candradeva iti śrutaḥ
children.translated_text: In the <s>Svāyambhuva</s> interval there was one known as <s>Candradeva</s>.

children.text: mālinī nāma tasyāsīd bhāryā paramaśobhanā ||
children.translated_text: His wife was <s>Mālinī</s>, exceedingly beautiful.

children.text: tayā sārdhaṃ nṛpavaraḥ siddhim icchaṃs tapo 'carat
children.translated_text: Together with her, that best of kings practiced austerity, desiring perfection,

children.text: krīḍāśailād adhobhāge haram ārādhayan svayaṃ ||
children.translated_text: below <s>Krīḍāśaila</s>, personally worshiping <s>Hara</s>.

children.text: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān umayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the blessed <s>Śiva</s>, together with <s>Umā</s>, was pleased.

children.text: śaṅkara uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> said:

children.text: tuṣṭo 'smi tapasā te 'dya sapatnīkasya pārthiva ||
children.translated_text: "I am pleased today by the austerity of you together with your wife, O earthly ruler.

children.text: varaṃ varaya bho rājann ity ukte śambhunābravīt
children.translated_text: Choose a boon, O king." When <s>Śambhu</s> had spoken thus, he replied.

children.text: candradeva uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Candradeva</s> said:

children.text: tvayi sāyujyam icchāmi tad dehi bhagavan mama ||
children.translated_text: "I desire union with you; grant that to me, O blessed Lord."

children.text: mālinī cāpi pārvatyāṃ vavre sāyujyam añjasā
children.translated_text: And <s>Mālinī</s> too at once chose union with <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: tathāstv iti haraḥ proce devīṃ tām api pārthiva ||
children.translated_text: <s>Hara</s> said, "So be it," to her also, O earthly ruler.

children.text: vāyubhūtau viviśatur devaṃ devīṃ kurūdvaha
children.translated_text: Having become like wind, the two entered the god and the goddess, O descendant of <s>Kuru</s>.

children.text: candradevāśramo nāma khyāto muktiprado nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: The place famed as <s>Candradevāśrama</s> became a giver of liberation to people.

children.text: tataḥ śivaḥ pārvatī ca tatra krīḍāṃ pracakratuḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Pārvatī</s> played there,

children.text: suciraṃ rājaśārdūla yathākāmaṃ yathāsukhaṃ ||
children.translated_text: for a very long time, O tiger among kings, as they desired and in happiness.

children.text: tayoḥ sambhogajanitā śuklībhūtā mahānadī
children.translated_text: From their union a great river arose, turned white,
