children.text: śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā nirmalā pāpahāriṇī ||
children.translated_text: resembling pure crystal, stainless and remover of sins.

children.text: mālinī nāma vikhyātā nadī sarvarasānvitā
children.translated_text: It became famed as the river <s>Mālinī</s>, endowed with every essence.

children.text: dvādaśe dvādaśe varṣe phālgune māsi dṛśyate ||
children.translated_text: Every twelfth year, in the month of <s>Phālguna</s>, it is seen.

children.text: phālgunarkṣe kṛtaghnās tāṃ na paśyanti kurūdvaha
children.translated_text: Under the <s>Phālguna</s> asterism, the ungrateful do not see it, O descendant of <s>Kuru</s>.

children.text: tasmin kāle naro yas tu tatra snānaṃ karoti ca ||
children.translated_text: At that time, whatever man bathes there

children.text: so 'maratvam avāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam
children.translated_text: obtains immortality. Truth, truth, I have spoken.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: purā vyādhas tu duṣṭātmā sahyādriśikhare nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Formerly, O king, on a peak of <s>Sahyādri</s> there was an evil-natured hunter,

children.text: durmukho nāma tatrāste nirghṛṇaḥ pāpacetanaḥ
children.translated_text: named <s>Durmukha</s>, merciless and sinful-minded.

children.text: paśupakṣidvijān hanti māṃsagṛdhnur durātmavān ||
children.translated_text: He killed animals, birds, and twice-born men, greedy for flesh and wicked in soul.

children.text: sakuṭumbā hatā viprā hatā gāvaḥ savatsakāḥ
children.translated_text: Brahmins were killed together with their families, and cows were killed together with their calves.

children.text: tadbhītyā sarvabhūtāni taṃ deśaṃ nopacakramuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Because of fear of him, all beings did not approach that region.

children.text: evaṃ kālo mahān rājann atyagāt tasya durmateḥ
children.translated_text: In this way a long time passed for that evil-minded man, O king.

children.text: tato 'bhyagāt kauśikākhyas tīrthasevī dvijottamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then an excellent twice-born man named <s>Kauśika</s>, one who visited sacred tīrthas, came there.

children.text: gokarṇasthāni tīrthāni snātvā pūrya kamaṇḍalum
children.translated_text: Having bathed at the tīrthas situated at <s>Gokarṇa</s> and filled his water-pot,

children.text: sahyādrim agamat so 'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvābhyadravat khalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he too went to <s>Sahyādri</s>; seeing him, the villain ran toward him.

children.text: gṛhītvā carmakhaḍge ca tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt
children.translated_text: Taking up shield and sword, he said, "Stop, stop!"

children.text: tam āpatantam ālokya kauśiko bhayavihvalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeing him rushing upon him, <s>Kauśika</s>, shaken by fear,

children.text: tasyopari vicikṣepa bhrāmayitvā kamaṇḍalum
children.translated_text: whirled his water-pot and threw it upon him.

children.text: kamaṇḍalos tīrthajalasparśamātrāt tadā nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: From the mere touch of the tīrtha-water from the water-pot, O king,

children.text: pāpahānir abhūt tasya lubdhakasya durātmanaḥ
children.translated_text: the sins of that evil-souled hunter were destroyed.

children.text: daivavān abhavat sadyas tyaktvā svābhāvikīṃ matim ||
children.translated_text: At once he became divinely disposed, abandoning his natural state of mind.

children.text: nirasya carmakhaḍgaṃ ca pratijajñe tadā ca saḥ
children.translated_text: Throwing away the shield and sword, he then made this vow:

children.text: adya prabhṛti bhūtānāṃ svastyas tv abhayado 'smy aham ||
children.translated_text: "From today onward let there be well-being for beings; I am a giver of fearlessness.

children.text: mattas tava bhayaṃ māstu naivāśnāmi dvijottama
children.translated_text: Let there be no fear of me for you; I shall certainly not eat you, O best of twice-born men."

children.text: ity uktvā lubdhako rājan nanāma dvijapādayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having said this, the hunter, O king, bowed at the feet of the Brahmin.

children.text: utthāya prāñjalir bhūtvā idaṃ vacanam abravīt
children.translated_text: Rising and standing with folded hands, he spoke these words:

children.text: pāpo 'haṃ pāpakarmāhaṃ mām uddhara namo 'stu te ||
children.translated_text: "I am sinful; I am a doer of sinful deeds. Rescue me. Homage to you."

children.text: ity uktaḥ kauśikas taṃ vai dṛṣṭvā bhayam apāsya ca
children.translated_text: Thus addressed, <s>Kauśika</s>, seeing him and putting aside his fear,

children.text: uvāca madhuraṃ vipraḥ kim idaṃ tava ceṣṭitam ||
children.translated_text: spoke sweetly, the Brahmin saying, "What is this behavior of yours?"

children.text: tac chrutvā lubdhakaḥ prāha prasādaṃ kuru bho mayi
children.translated_text: Hearing that, the hunter said, "Show favor to me, sir.

children.text: mayā bahūni pāpāni kṛtāni dvijapuṅgava ||
children.translated_text: Many sins have been committed by me, O bull among twice-born men.

children.text: tvāṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ hantum agāṃ bhayāt tvaṃ kṣiptavān abhūḥ
children.translated_text: When I saw you I came to kill you; out of fear you threw the water-pot.

children.text: mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ vipra pāpahānir abhūt tataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The water was purified by mantra, O Brahmin; from that my sins were destroyed.

children.text: tapaś caritum icchāmi upadeśaṃ kuru prabho
children.translated_text: I wish to practice austerity. Give me instruction, lord."

children.text: iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kauśiko brāhmaṇo 'bravīt ||
children.translated_text: Hearing that speech, <s>Kauśika</s> the Brahmin said:

children.text: yady evaṃ niścitaṃ vīra tvayādya vyādhasattama
children.translated_text: "If this has indeed been firmly resolved by you today, O hero, best of hunters,

children.text: vrataṃ niraśanaṃ kṛtvā gokarṇaṃ yāhi sāmpratam ||
children.translated_text: undertake a vow of fasting and go now to <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā yaja viśveśvaraṃ haram
children.translated_text: There, making a hermitage, worship <s>Viśveśvara</s>, <s>Hara</s>.

children.text: yāvaj jīvaṃ mahābāho hy ante svargam avāpsyasi ||
children.translated_text: For as long as you live, mighty-armed one, do this, and at the end you will attain heaven."

children.text: evam uktvā tato vipro yathākāmaṃ jagāma ha
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the Brahmin then went wherever he wished.

children.text: vyādhas tyaktvā tu tat sarvaṃ gokarṇaṃ pratijagmivān ||
children.translated_text: But the hunter, abandoning all that, set out for <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: vṛkṣamūlam upāśritya nirāhāro 'carat tapaḥ
children.translated_text: Resorting to the root of a tree and fasting, he practiced austerity.

children.text: śivasaṃkīrtanāt tasya pāpahānir ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: Through the chanting of <s>Śiva</s>'s praise, his sins were destroyed.

children.text: tataḥ pañcatvam āpanno gokarṇe bharatarṣabha
children.translated_text: Then he reached the state of the five elements at <s>Gokarṇa</s>, O bull of the <s>Bhārata</s>s.

children.text: tena puṇyena mahatā vyādhaḥ kailāsam āptavān ||
children.translated_text: By that great merit the hunter reached <s>Kailāsa</s>.

children.text: vyādhāśramaḥ puṇyatamaḥ pavitraḥ pāpanāśanaḥ
children.translated_text: The hunter's hermitage is most meritorious, purifying, and destructive of sin.

children.text: divyaṃ vimānam āruhya divyastrīgaṇasevitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Mounting a celestial aerial chariot, attended by hosts of celestial women,

children.text: vyādhaḥ kailāsam agamat kiṃ tato 'dhikam ucyate
children.translated_text: the hunter went to <s>Kailāsa</s>; what more than this can be said?

children.text: svargamokṣapradaṃ rājan gokarṇaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Gokarṇa</s> grants heaven and liberation, O king; there is no doubt here.

children.text: tad āśritya purā sarve siddhāḥ siddhim upāgatāḥ
children.translated_text: Taking refuge there in ancient times, all the perfected beings attained perfection.

children.text: na tasya mahimā śakyo vaktuṃ varṣaśatair api ||
children.translated_text: Its greatness cannot be told even in hundreds of years.

children.text: śilāṃ gṛhītvā tatra sthāṃ ye yajanti kurūdvaha
children.translated_text: Those who take a stone standing there and worship it, O descendant of <s>Kuru</s>,

children.text: te rudralokaṃ gacchanti kimu liṅgārcanān nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: go to <s>Rudraloka</s>; how much more so from worship of the <s>liṅga</s>, O king?

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: saṃvartakaḥ api viprendro nāradān munipuṅgavāt
children.translated_text: <s>Saṃvartaka</s> also, lord of Brahmins, from <s>Nārada</s>, the foremost sage,

children.text: śrutvā gokarṇamāhātmyaṃ tīrthe snātvā svanirmite ||
children.translated_text: having heard the greatness of <s>Gokarṇa</s> and having bathed in the tīrtha made by himself,

children.text: talliṅgaṃ pūjayitvā tu nāradāt siddhim āptavān
children.translated_text: worshiped that <s>liṅga</s> and, through <s>Nārada</s>, attained perfection.

children.text: tapas taptvā tu suciraṃ yathākāmam uvāsa ha ||
children.translated_text: Having performed austerity for a very long time, he dwelt as he pleased.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: vaivasvatamanoḥ kāle dvāpare munipuṅgava
children.translated_text: In the time of <s>Vaivasvata Manu</s>, in the <s>Dvāpara</s> age, O foremost sage,

children.text: mathurāyāṃ dvijavaro hy atrigotrasamudbhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there was in <s>Mathurā</s> an excellent Brahmin, born from the lineage of <s>Atri</s>.

children.text: alijaṅgha iti khyāto hy āsīd devavivarjitaḥ
children.translated_text: He was known as <s>Alijaṅgha</s> and was devoid of devotion to the gods.

children.text: tasyāsīj jāriṇī bhāryā sadā niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇī ||
children.translated_text: He had an adulterous wife, always speaking harshly.

children.text: nāmnā cānaṅgalatikā patibhaktivivarjitā
children.translated_text: Her name was <s>Anaṅgalatikā</s>, and she was devoid of devotion to her husband.

children.text: alijaṅgho 'pi durmedhā nityaṃ durjanasaṅgataḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Alijaṅgha</s> too was foolish and constantly associated with wicked people.

children.text: pānāsakto dyūtakārī parastrīgamane rataḥ
children.translated_text: He was addicted to drinking, a gambler, and delighted in going to other men's wives.

children.text: devabrāhmaṇavidveṣī pitṛbhaktivivarjitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He hated gods and Brahmins and lacked devotion to the ancestors.

children.text: asaṅkhyātāni pāpāni kṛtavān sa dine dine
children.translated_text: Day by day he committed countless sins.

children.text: tathaiva tasya patnī ca svadharmaparivarjitā ||
children.translated_text: Likewise his wife, abandoning her own dharma,

children.text: sāpi pāpāny anekāni cakāra ca dine dine
children.translated_text: also committed many sins day by day.

children.text: evaṃ dineṣu gacchatsu keṣucid dvijadampatī ||
children.translated_text: As the days passed in this way, the Brahmin couple

children.text: jagmatuḥ karmavaśataḥ śrīraṅgaṃ kṣetram uttamam
children.translated_text: went, through the force of karma, to the excellent sacred field of <s>Śrīraṅga</s>.

children.text: tulāsaṃsthe dinakare kārtike māsi puṇyade ||
children.translated_text: When the sun was in <s>Tulā</s>, in the merit-giving month of <s>Kārttika</s>,

children.text: bahavas tatra gacchanti yātrārthaṃ bharatarṣabha
children.translated_text: many people go there for pilgrimage, O bull of the <s>Bhārata</s>s.

children.text: yātrāvyājena tau cāpi taiḥ sākaṃ cāgatau nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: Under the pretext of pilgrimage, those two also came together with them, O king.

children.text: tatra snātvā ca kāveryām uṣaḥkāle samāhitau
children.translated_text: There, having bathed in the <s>Kāverī</s> at dawn, composed in mind,

children.text: tatra sthitvā māsam ekaṃ chadmanā dhanakāṅkṣayā ||
children.translated_text: they stayed there for one month deceptively, out of desire for wealth.

children.text: raṅganāthaṃ ca sampūjya śrutvā harikathāṃ niśi
children.translated_text: After fully worshiping <s>Raṅganātha</s> and hearing the story of <s>Hari</s> at night,

children.text: māsānte devatādravyaṃ muṣitvā prayayau dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the end of the month the Brahmin stole the deity's property and went away.

children.text: patnyā sahaiva śanakair mārgamadhye gato dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: The Brahmin, together with his wife, went slowly along the road.

children.text: cārā mārgayituṃ jagmū raṅgakṣetrād drutaṃ bhaṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guards quickly went from the field of <s>Raṅga</s> to search for the thief.

children.text: dadṛśur mārgamadhye taṃ sadevadravyakaṃ dvijam
children.translated_text: On the road they saw that Brahmin together with the deity's property.

children.text: baddhvā rājāntikaṃ dūtā ninyus taṃ vai dvijādhamam ||
children.translated_text: Binding that lowest of Brahmins, the messengers brought him before the king.

children.text: rājānam ūcus te dūtāś coro 'yaṃ brāhmaṇādhamaḥ
children.translated_text: The messengers said to the king, "This thief is the lowest of Brahmins."

children.text: dṛṣṭvā tau dampatī rājā tayoḥ śikṣām akārayat ||
children.translated_text: Seeing that couple, the king ordered punishment for the two of them.

children.text: tatas tenaiva duḥkhena pīḍitau dvijadampatī
children.translated_text: Then the Brahmin couple, afflicted by that very suffering,

children.text: kiṃcit kālāntare rājaṃs tatraiva maraṇaṃ gatau ||
children.translated_text: after some little time, O king, died right there.

children.text: tato yamabhaṭā baddhvā ninyur vaivasvataṃ puram
children.translated_text: Then the servants of <s>Yama</s> bound them and led them to the city of <s>Vaivasvata</s>.

children.text: yamas tayor vicāryātha kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Yama</s>, having examined the good and bad karma they had done,

children.text: dūtān ājñāpayāmāsa pātyetāṃ narake tv imau
children.translated_text: commanded his messengers, "These two must be cast into hell."

children.text: tato yamājñayā dūtāḥ pecus tau narakāgniṣu ||
children.translated_text: Then, by <s>Yama</s>'s command, the messengers cooked those two in the fires of hell.

children.text: paścāt sānaṅgalekhā tu babhūva nakulī dvija
children.translated_text: Afterwards <s>Anaṅgalekhā</s> became a female mongoose, O Brahmin,

children.text: alijaṅghaś ca bhaṣakaḥ gokarṇe janim āpatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Alijaṅgha</s> became a dog; the two took birth at <s>Gokarṇa</s>.

children.text: vyājenāpi ca kāverīsnānād ūrjavratādikāt
children.translated_text: Even indirectly, through bathing in the <s>Kāverī</s> and through the <s>Ūrja-vrata</s> and the like,

children.text: jātismaratvaṃ samprāpya gokarṇe suciraṃ sthitau ||
children.translated_text: they attained remembrance of their former births and remained at <s>Gokarṇa</s> for a long time.

children.text: tataḥ karmavaśād eva saṃvartasyāśrame śubhe
children.translated_text: Then, by the force of karma itself, in the auspicious hermitage of <s>Saṃvartaka</s>,

children.text: gokarṇakṣetramāhātmyaṃ nāradena prabhāṣitam ||
children.translated_text: the greatness of <s>Gokarṇa-kṣetra</s> was proclaimed by <s>Nārada</s>.

children.text: saṃvartakāya rājendra sarvaṃ tābhyāṃ śrutaṃ hy abhūt
children.translated_text: All of it, O king, as spoken to <s>Saṃvartaka</s>, was indeed heard by those two.

children.text: tato viyonijād duḥkhād vimuktau tau babhūvatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then those two became freed from the suffering of birth in a lower womb.

children.text: devalokāt tato dūtāḥ pākaśāsanaśāsanāt
children.translated_text: Then messengers from the world of the gods, by the command of <s>Pākaśāsana</s>,

children.text: divyaṃ vimānam ādāya tayor nikaṭam āyayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: came near them, bringing a divine aerial chariot.

children.text: tābhyāṃ datvā kuruśreṣṭha divyaṃ dehaṃ vibhāsvaram
children.translated_text: After giving those two, O best of the Kurus, a shining divine body,

children.text: vimānavaram āropya gokarṇān niryayur divam ||
children.translated_text: and placing them in the excellent aerial chariot, they set out from <s>Gokarṇa</s> to heaven.

children.text: devaiḥ sākaṃ devapure bhuktvā bhogān anekaśaḥ
children.translated_text: Having enjoyed many pleasures with the gods in the city of the gods,

children.text: uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ patnyā sākaṃ dvijottamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that excellent Brahmin lived for a very long time together with his wife.

children.text: tataḥ puṇyāvaśeṣeṇa punar bhūlokam āgatau
children.translated_text: Then, because some merit remained, they returned again to the earthly world.

children.text: aṅgadeśādhipaḥ so 'bhūt kanakāṅgadanāmavān ||
children.translated_text: He became the ruler of <s>Aṅgadeśa</s>, bearing the name <s>Kanakāṅgada</s>.

children.text: tatpatnī cāpi sañjātā gorāṣṭrādhipateḥ sutā
children.translated_text: His wife too was born as the daughter of the ruler of <s>Gorāṣṭra</s>.

children.text: nāmnā kalāvatī rājaṃs tam eva kanakāṅgadam ||
children.translated_text: Named <s>Kalāvatī</s>, O king, she obtained that same <s>Kanakāṅgada</s>

children.text: patim āpa ca cārvaṅgī mudā paramayā yutā
children.translated_text: as her husband; the lovely-limbed woman was filled with the highest joy.

children.text: kanakāṅgadabhūpālaḥ prāpya patnīṃ kalāvatīm ||
children.translated_text: King <s>Kanakāṅgada</s>, having obtained <s>Kalāvatī</s> as his wife,

children.text: rājyaṃ cakāra suciraṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan
children.translated_text: ruled for a very long time, protecting his subjects according to <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: putrān utpādayāmāsa trīn devasadṛśān nṛpa ||
children.translated_text: He begot three sons, O king, who were like gods.

children.text: vivṛddhim agaman sarve te bālāḥ piturantike
children.translated_text: All those boys grew to maturity at their father's side.

children.text: aśvamedhādibhir yāgair bahubhir dakṣiṇāyutaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With many sacrifices such as the horse-sacrifice, accompanied by sacrificial fees,

children.text: kṛtvā vratāni sarvāṇi datvā dānāni sarvaśaḥ
children.translated_text: having performed all vows and given gifts in every way,

children.text: bhuktvā bhogān yathākāmaṃ putrapautrādibhir yutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and having enjoyed pleasures as he wished, together with sons and grandsons,

children.text: tato vairāgyam āpanno rājyabhogeṣu bhūmipaḥ
children.translated_text: then the king became detached from the pleasures of sovereignty.

children.text: tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena prayayau bhāryayā saha ||
children.translated_text: On the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred places, he set out together with his wife.

children.text: gokarṇaṃ kṣetram āsādya patnyā saha kurūdvaha
children.translated_text: Having reached the sacred field of <s>Gokarṇa</s> with his wife, O descendant of <s>Kuru</s>,

children.text: tatra sthiteṣu tīrtheṣu snātvā rājā yathākramam ||
children.translated_text: the king bathed in due order in the sacred bathing places situated there.

children.text: mahābalaṃ ca sampūjya tatra sthitvācarat tapaḥ
children.translated_text: After fully worshiping <s>Mahābala</s>, he stayed there and practiced austerity.

children.text: suciraṃ rājaśārdūla hy ante nirvāṇam āptavān ||
children.translated_text: For a very long time, O tiger among kings, he did so, and at the end he attained liberation.

children.text: sūta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: sakṛc chrutvā cālijaṅgho dvijendrāḥ san māhātmyaṃ gośruteḥ strīsametaḥ
children.translated_text: Having heard even once, O best of Brahmins, the true greatness of <s>Gośruti</s>, <s>Alijaṅgha</s> together with his wife

children.text: duryonitvān muktim āsādya bhūyo gatvā puṇyaṃ devalokaṃ yatheṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: was freed from birth in a bad womb and then, having gained release, went again as he wished to the blessed world of the gods.

children.text: bhogān bhuktvā devavat tatra labhyān kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ prapadya
children.translated_text: After enjoying there the pleasures obtainable like a god, when his merit was exhausted, he entered the mortal world.

children.text: rājā bhūtvā hy aṅgadeśe dvijendrāḥ patnyā sārdhaṃ bhūtale bhūri bhogān ||
children.translated_text: Becoming king in <s>Aṅgadeśa</s>, O best of Brahmins, he enjoyed many pleasures on earth together with his wife.

children.text: bhuktvā putre rājyabhāraṃ samarpya kṛtvā yāgān aśvamedhādikāṃś ca
children.translated_text: After enjoying them, he entrusted the burden of kingship to his son and performed sacrifices beginning with the horse-sacrifice.

children.text: kṛtvā dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaś ca sarvaṃ vrataṃ tadvad vividhaṃ caiva kṛtvā ||
children.translated_text: He gave gifts to Brahmins and likewise performed every kind of vow.

children.text: paścāt sarvakṣetrayātrāṃ samāpya patnyā sārdhaṃ gośrutikṣetravaryam
children.translated_text: Afterwards, having completed a pilgrimage to all sacred places, he went with his wife to the excellent sacred field of <s>Gośruti</s>.

children.text: gatvā tatra kṣetrayātrāṃ ca kṛtvā tapas taptvā hy acirāt siddhim āpa ||
children.translated_text: Having gone there, made the pilgrimage of that sacred field, and practiced austerity, he soon attained perfection.

children.text: idaṃ yaḥ kṣetramāhātmyaṃ śṛṇoti paṭhati dvija
children.translated_text: Whoever, O Brahmin, hears or recites this greatness of the sacred field,

children.text: ekavāraṃ dvivāraṃ vā trivāram atha vā naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: whether once, twice, or else three times,

children.text: tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ varṣaśatair api
children.translated_text: even in hundreds of years one would not be able to tell the fruit of that person's merit.

children.text: yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
children.translated_text: Whatever desire a person longs for, that very thing he obtains, without doubt.

children.text: sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yat phalam
children.translated_text: The merit that exists in all sacred bathing places, the fruit that exists in all sacrifices,

children.text: sarvavrateṣu yat puṇyaṃ tat sarvaṃ labhate dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: and the merit that exists in all vows, all of that he certainly obtains.

children.text: sarvāmayavināśaḥ syāt sarvabhūtādināśanam
children.translated_text: It brings the destruction of all diseases and the destruction of all harmful spirits and the like.

children.text: putrakāmo labhet putraṃ kīrtikāmo labhed yaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: One who desires a son obtains a son; one who desires fame obtains renown.

children.text: rājyakāmo labhed rājyaṃ dhanakāmo labhed dhanam
children.translated_text: One who desires a kingdom obtains a kingdom; one who desires wealth obtains wealth.

children.text: vidyākāmo labhed vidyāṃ baddho mucyeta bandhanāt ||
children.translated_text: One who desires knowledge obtains knowledge; one who is bound is released from bondage.

children.text: āyuṣkāmo labhed āyuḥ strīkāmaḥ strīm avāpnuyāt
children.translated_text: One who desires long life obtains long life; one who desires a woman obtains a woman.

children.text: svargakāmo labhet svargaṃ mokṣārthī mokṣam āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: One who desires heaven obtains heaven; one seeking <s>mokṣa</s> obtains <s>mokṣa</s>.

children.text: idaṃ rahasyam atyantaṃ nābhaktāya vadet kvacit
children.translated_text: This is an extreme secret; one should never tell it to a person without devotion.

children.text: satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyam uddhṛtya bhujam ucyate ||
children.translated_text: Truth, truth, again truth: this is declared with arm upraised.

children.text: gokarṇakṣetranilayaḥ siddhido dvibhujānvitaḥ
children.translated_text: Dwelling in <s>Gokarṇa-kṣetra</s>, granting perfection, endowed with two arms,

children.text: bhaktānām iṣṭado nityaṃ pātu vo gaṇanāyakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the lord of hosts, <s>Gaṇanāyaka</s>, always granting what devotees desire, may he protect you.

children.text: cintāmaṇiḥ praṇamatāṃ niśāmaṇiśiromaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: A wish-fulfilling jewel for those who bow, whose crest-jewel is the moon,

children.text: kapālī lokapālī vaḥ pātu nityaṃ mahābalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kapālī</s>, protector of the worlds, <s>Mahābala</s>, may he always protect you.

children.text: iti śrīskānde gokarṇakhaṇḍe śrīgokarṇamāhātmye sāroddhāre dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus ends the twelfth chapter in the auspicious <s>Skanda</s>, in the <s>Gokarṇa-khaṇḍa</s>, in the auspicious <s>Gokarṇa-māhātmya</s>, in the <s>Sāroddhāra</s>.
